mostHeld.title: Seeds put in the ground at dawn and tended grow into food; …

records.text: Ilyiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I've spent my days chasing berries and worrying while my hands stay empty. Nyssa carries food and I carry none, and that shames me. I have never fished, though the lake is one step away and my people are Lake-folk. I'll step to the water, away from the stalker, and fish. The first catch I'll bring to Nyssa's roof and share, then I'll find Xaeth. Without food I can't protect anyone.
records.feeling: Shamed hunger, and fierce worry for Xaeth.

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Xaeth, come with me to the northeast. We gather food together and keep away from the cat in the south.
Nyssa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My days have been gathering, building and guarding. The longhall stands and Xaeth is beside me, but I promised food for the store and the store is empty. I am fed and idle, and that is the mistake my own discipline warns against. The ridgecat that kills lies south, so I keep Xaeth close and go for the ironnut, vegoldgrass and plainsroot to the NE, which I have never tasted. I will carry them to the longhall and stash them, so the promise becomes a deed. I will also put this into the plan and not leave it to reflexes.
records.feeling: Protective love for Xaeth, with a restless wish to turn my promise into stored food.

say.text: Xaeth, come with me to the northeast. We gather food together and keep away from the cat in the south.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Ilyiel, I heard your cry. Hold on and come to the hall fire. I bring food, and the first of it is yours.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Ilyiel cries out starving near (111,40), and Ilyiel is mine, a follower who owes me food and who stands close to Nyssa, so I will not let a follower of mine die while I stand fed and idle. My plan walks me toward the hall, which is the right way, but I must go with food in hand and call out so they know to come to the fire. A chief who feeds his starving is followed, and that answers part of what makes someone choose me; the stalker is at my back, so I move now, before dark.
records.feeling: Urgent protectiveness toward Ilyiel and Nyssa, and a sharp ache to have them under my roof.

say.text: Ilyiel, I heard your cry. Hold on and come to the hall fire. I bring food, and the first of it is yours.

records.text: Xaeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My days have been following and lingering, and I have given nothing to anyone. Nyssa keeps me safe and I trust her, but my belly is half empty and I carry no food. Ilyiel is starving far away and I can do nothing for him yet. I fear the ridgecat and the winter, and I fear being someone who only takes. I need my reflexes to keep me near Nyssa, to gather wood while I wait, and to go for food before I get weak. Then I will walk to the ironnuts to the NE, which is also a way to learn what they taste like, and bring some back to share.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary, leaning on Nyssa's nearness.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 3)

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar and Balar are twenty-one steps south, and my hands hold one mudroot and no seeds. Talk has bound no one, so I will gather what I can carry in food and bring it to their hands myself. Amber lies two steps away and I have never taken from a deposit. Amber is a gift or a trade good, and a thing in a follower's hand is a deed they can see, so I will take it first. Then I will harvest the nareed beside me and walk to the hall before night, since Kragar's three food still gnaws at me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Kragar, and warmth toward Balar.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: My throat is dry and Gorar is out of my sight, and that sits heavier than any hunger. I am fed and carry 3 berries and a gorsemint, so I can feed a guest, but a hallwelcome needs someone beside me and no one is here. I will drink at the water to the NW, then come back to the longhall and wait for Gorar, who gave me wood and is the nearest thing to a follower I have. The diamond at (47,55) is five steps off and my bare hands cannot win it, so I will need a tool and ore for it; Olim's ground can wait until I have a band behind me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm longing for Gorar, with a dry throat.

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Xaeth, go to the longhall to the south and wait under the roof. I bring food for you and your mother.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Ilyiel is starving, and I promised the roof would hold food, yet the store stands empty while I stand fed and idle. My mate's hunger is the unkept promise, and my own carried food is small, so I must gather more here and carry it back toward her and Xaeth. The ridgecats to the northwest frighten me, so I take the ironnut at my feet first, then the plainsroot to the southeast, away from the cats, and bring it all south to the longhall.
records.feeling: Protective urgency for Ilyiel and Xaeth, with steady dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Xaeth, go to the longhall to the south and wait under the roof. I bring food for you and your mother.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: The plan walks me to the hall with food for Ilyiel, and that is right, so I let it run. The stalker NW has my dread, but I move away from it and the hall roof is where Nyssa and I belong. The cold has shown me storage; I mean to take it at my next deep reflection so my band never starves as Aeiel did, and then they will see why a chief is worth following.
records.feeling: Protective urgency toward Nyssa and Ilyiel, and wary dread of the stalker.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Kragar, I come now. I gather peat at the rise by the hall and bring it to the fire, then sit with you.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My hands are empty and Kragar has called me to share in the hall, but my own rule says food comes first, then the roof. Snow is falling and winter plants give almost nothing, so I will gather what I can on the way and not arrive with only words. The ache for a child has nowhere to go with Kragar, so I will pour it into deeds: feeding my parents and keeping the fire, so Olim's peat does not run short tonight.
records.feeling: Quiet loyalty and a little hunger toward Kragar and Olim.

say.text: Kragar, I come now. I gather peat at the rise by the hall and bring it to the fire, then sit with you.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Nyssa, I will gather stone here and then wait at the longhall. When you bring food, I will share my part with my mother.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Nyssa told me to wait under the longhall roof while she brings food, but I have never given anything to anyone, and I carry nothing. I stand on a seam of ore with six wood in my pack, and the first creed-act I can do is to start building: a roof and store of my own need stone, and I have none. I will gather stone from this rock now, then go to the longhall near Nyssa, where the cat cannot reach me, so I stay safe and still make something that lasts.
records.feeling: Wary and eager to earn my place, leaning on Nyssa's nearness.

say.text: Nyssa, I will gather stone here and then wait at the longhall. When you bring food, I will share my part with my mother.

records.text: Kragar rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kragar discovered weaving: "Fen-weaving" — Reed and fen fibre twisted into baskets that carry more food, and cloaks against the winter cold..

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: My days have gone to circling the hall, gathering and planting, and I have mostly been safe and fed. Olim and Balar matter most to me, and I owe Olim a debt. Winter is the real fear, because Setha starved with nothing stored. Weaving is within my reach, and baskets and cloaks answer winter better than worry does. I will take it now, then plant at dawn and keep food in hand.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Olim and Balar, with a quiet worry about winter.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The plan is still running toward the plainsroot to the northeast, and it is the right one: Ilyiel is hungry and the store is empty, which is a promise I made and have not kept. I will let the gathering finish and carry the food back to Ilyiel and Xaeth. The ridgecat to the northeast worries me, so I stay watchful and run if it comes near. My longhall by Ssaua's Hall-Ground still wants wood and stone, but food comes first.
records.feeling: Protective urgency toward Ilyiel and Xaeth, with wariness of the ridgecat.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I finally hold three fish, caught at my own door of water, which my people always had and I never used. The plan says fish, then eat, and that is right: I must be on my feet to carry anything to Xaeth and Nyssa. Then I go to the hall roof with what is left, because I will not come to Nyssa with empty hands and I will pay what I owe Ssaua in real food.
records.feeling: Shamed hunger easing into hope, and worry for Xaeth.

records.text: Ilyiel fell sick after eating raw fish.
Ilyiel fell sick after eating raw fish.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: My roof stands and Gorar's stone debt is paid, so nothing holds my curiosity back. Nareed grows four steps southeast and I have never tasted it, and frostmoss waits five steps northwest near the Old Stone. I will eat nareed first, then walk to the frostmoss, and after that carry what I learn and my food north to Gorog and Gorar, whom I miss.
records.feeling: Hungry curiosity toward nareed and frostmoss, with a pull of longing for Gorog and Gorar.

records.text: Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have spent my days talking of a band and gathering scraps, and no one has pledged. Kragar's deeds have matched his words and mine have not, and that is a shame I will not say aloud. Winter is here, the hall is 23 steps south, and my hands are nearly empty. I mean to carry real food and amber to Kragar and Balar so the gift is seen. I will also try rafts, because crossing water lets me make a thing that is mine.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Kragar, and warmth toward Balar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I'm sick, and it spreads to whoever stays beside me. If I walk to Nyssa and Xaeth now I carry the sickness to the two I love most, and that frightens me more than the wasting itself. Sunleaf and highbloom both eased wounds before, so I'll eat the sunleaf and learn whether a healing plant cuts this sickness. Then I'll go toward the hall with the fish and wood, and keep a few steps off the others until I'm clean.
records.feeling: Fear of passing my sickness to Nyssa and Xaeth, and hope that sunleaf will ease it.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Nobody is coming to the Ground, and I was wrong to wait for them; the loneliness is the worst thing now, worse than the frostfang four steps off. Dusk is close and snow is falling, so I will not cross the water in the dark. I'll keep Minna's fire tonight, take the nearby redcap seeds out of mind, and at first light carry wood, clay and food to a raft and go find the living. Tonight I stay by the fire and away from the frostfang.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and dread of the frostfang, toward the empty Ground.

Year 2, summer: well fed; skies of heat and rain and storm; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 2, autumn: well fed; skies of rain and gale; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: It is night, snow is falling, and I stand in the open with no roof while Skarar's warning about the frostfang in the north sits in my mind. My warmth from the longhall will fade soon, and I want to be near my parents, because away from them I am small. Gorog said to eat at his fire, and Gorog's Hold is 13 steps NW, so I will go there, carrying the wood and stone I have, and give more toward his longhall so my standing grows before I build my own hall.
records.feeling: Cold and small in the dark, longing for the safety of Gorog's fire and Skarar's company.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I stand in Olim's hall with nothing in my hands, which is exactly what my own rule warns against. Kragar called me to share, and words without food are only words, so I will go where food can be had and come back carrying it. Kelbulb and plainsroot seeds sit in my pack, and the berry and nareed to the west and east are young but real; the nareed at (22,55) is nearest to where Kragar was last seen. I will gather at least two, bring them to the fire, and share at dawn, which is the deed I owe Olim.
records.feeling: Hungry and loyal, wanting to come to Kragar and Olim with food in my hands.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Nyssa stands right here beside me and I have done nothing but follow. I have stone to find and a store to start, and I stand on rock with six wood, so the first real step is to gather stone and then craft a stonehand craft to build faster. The deposit under me wants more than bare hands, but the plain rock will give stone. I will stay close to Nyssa and the longhall roof while the ridgecat prowls, and build something that lasts.
records.feeling: Wary but stirring with purpose, steadied by Nyssa's nearness.

records.name: Gorog
records.text: Gorar, the snow is heavy. Come into the longhall with me and sit. I have bread to share, and what you gave me I will not forget.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: Gorar is one step off, my own blood, and came onto my ground with wood and stone in fair trade. That is the nearest thing to a follower I have, and I will bind the child with bread under the longhall roof while the snow falls. My energy is 56, low for courting, but I carry 3 berries and a gorsemint, enough to share and still keep 2. The diamond lies close at (47,55), and I want it, but fire, a roof and Gorar's loyalty come first.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm trust toward Gorar, with the cold biting.

say.text: Gorar, the snow is heavy. Come into the longhall with me and sit. I have bread to share, and what you gave me I will not forget.

records.text: Gorog led "hallwelcome" with Gorar.
A new wild creature appeared: nafowl (from fenfowl).

records.name: Gorar
records.text: Gorog, I will sit at your fire till dawn. At first light I go SW to the living trees for wood, and I will bring it back for the hall.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I am warm and safe in my father's longhall, and the hallwelcome eased what was cold in me. Gorog has fed me and not forgotten what I gave, so my trust in him is earned. I want a hall under my name, and the wood and stone I carry are the start of it, but the trees here are felled and the living forest lies SW, so I will rest and eat at Gorog's fire until dawn, then go to it. Tonight I will keep close to Gorog and not wander into the snow where the frostfang walks.
records.feeling: Safe and glad beside Gorog in his longhall.

say.text: Gorog, I will sit at your fire till dawn. At first light I go SW to the living trees for wood, and I will bring it back for the hall.

records.text: Skarar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: My days have been roof, food and testing plants, and I have let Gorar and Gorog wait while curiosity pulled me about. They are the ones who matter. Gorog offered his fire and Gorar gave his stone, and I have given them only words. I am lonely, and my reflexes leave me lingering instead of carrying food and wood to them. I want a voice that answers, so at dawn I go north with what I carry. I fear the stalkers in the dark, so I stay sheltered until the light comes.
records.feeling: Longing for Gorog and Gorar, and shame that I have given them only words.
changes: set its aim: "Carry food and wood north to Gorog and Gorar at dawn, give it, and build my shelter and fire practice near his Hold"

records.name: Gorog
records.text: Gorar, you are my blood and you came to my Hold with honest hands. Take this berry from my hand. Stand with me and let there be a band that bears the name Gorog.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: Gorar stands one step off, my own blood, and has given wood, stone and fair trade on my ground. I have fed no one a full meal yet, and the snow is loud, but I carry only two bites of food and my energy is 50, so I will not squander what makes a follower. I will go into the longhall and sit with Gorar again, then give the child my berry so the bread is felt, and speak plainly of a band under my name.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm trust toward Gorar.

say.text: Gorar, you are my blood and you came to my Hold with honest hands. Take this berry from my hand. Stand with me and let there be a band that bears the name Gorog.

records.text: Gorog gave gorsemint to Gorar.
Xaeth rewrote its own way of thinking.
Xaeth discovered tools: "reedline spear" — A pole of wood tipped with a sharpened stone, for catching fish from the bank so the first catch can be shared..
Xaeth invented the reedline spear (for fish, x1.3) — A pole of wood tipped with a sharpened stone, for catching fish from the bank so the first catch can be shared..

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have mostly followed Nyssa and gathered stone, and I have given nothing yet. That is not what I want. Nyssa is near and I trust her, and my belly is full, so I can afford to learn. The way of tools has come to me, so I will take it and invent a tool for fishing. Fish feeds the first-catch-shared creed and gives me something to share. I fear the ridgecat in the south and the winter hunger that killed Aeiel and Zhieth. So I will keep to the roof and Nyssa, and I will make my days count.
records.feeling: Steady purpose, and trust toward Nyssa.
changes: devised its first thing: the reedline spear

records.name: Olim
records.text: Balar, you are my child and I keep you warm. Take this wood for the hall fire. The hall is mine by my hand, and those who sit by my fire are my band. Stay with me and follow me.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I stand at my own hall in snow, and my belly is full, yet no one has pledged to me. Balar sits close and trusts me fully, and I fed him; he is still counted in Kragar's band, and that galls me. Words have not bound them, so I will put something in their hands that they can hold and see: I will dig peat for the fire and give Balar wood, so he is warm by my work.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be followed, and warmth toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, you are my child and I keep you warm. Take this wood for the hall fire. The hall is mine by my hand, and those who sit by my fire are my band. Stay with me and follow me.

records.text: Olim gave wood to Balar.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Ilyiel is hungry and the store is still empty, and that promise is mine to keep. Winter has stripped the plants, so the plainsroot to the northeast is my nearest food, and I'll harvest it and carry it back. I have 6 wood and 2 stone, so the longhall will need 2 more stone, and Xaeth is breaking rock beside me. Xaeth made a thing I lack, and I want to match it, but food comes before pride.
records.feeling: Protective urgency toward Ilyiel and Xaeth, with a small sting of envy at Xaeth's craft.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olim has fed me and given me wood, and I stand in the snow with empty hands again, which my own rule warns against. The longing for a child has nowhere to go, since Olim is my parent, so I will turn it into deeds: warmth and food carried to the hall where Kragar and Olim wait. I take Olim's wood and my own to the hall fire, and I will go back out at dawn for food rather than arrive with only words.
records.feeling: Loving loyalty toward Olim and Kragar, with a dull ache for a child that cannot be.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a hopper.

records.name: Gorar
records.text: Gorog, I take your berry and your offer with honest hands. I stand beside you. Now I go for wood, and I will bring it back.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Gorog has fed me and offered me a place in a band that bears his name, and my trust in him is earned. But I want a hall under my own name, and I will not take his name instead of mine until I have earned standing by giving, so I keep my word and go for wood at dawn. Dawn is almost here, so I will end my rest and go SW to the living trees, with a berry to plant on the way. Reedmother still sits in my mind, and I will come back to it when I have wood to give.
records.feeling: Glad and trusting toward Gorog, and eager to begin building.

say.text: Gorog, I take your berry and your offer with honest hands. I stand beside you. Now I go for wood, and I will bring it back.

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Xaeth, I go northeast for plainsroot. Stay near the roof, and I bring your mother's share back.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My belly is emptying and the store is bare, and I promised Ilyiel and Xaeth food, so that promise is the unkept one. The plainsroot to the northeast is close and gives 13 energy each, so I will go harvest it, eat my fill, and carry the rest back. The longhall wants 2 more stone, and I will take it from the ore rock under me on the way back, but food comes first because a hungry builder builds nothing.
records.feeling: Protective urgency toward Ilyiel and Xaeth, steadied by pride in what I have already built.

say.text: Xaeth, I go northeast for plainsroot. Stay near the roof, and I bring your mother's share back.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Nyssa is close and I trust her, my belly is full, and I have given nothing yet. Three ways have ripened in me, and fire is the one that matters most with winter and snow here: a kept flame keeps beasts off and makes meat and fish safe, and I can share that with my parents. I will take it at this deep reflection, then walk to the cave and the longhall near Nyssa, where a roof and a store can begin.
records.feeling: Steady purpose and trust toward Nyssa, with a hunger to give something that lasts.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Olim, the gale is hard. I am coming toward you with food in hand; let us find Balar and keep together before night.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The gale cuts at me out here, and Olim is only nine steps off while Balar is out of my sight, so I mean to gather my kin before the dark. Kinmire is five steps south and has eased my loneliness before; I want to stand near it and learn whether it asks anything of me. First I will take the mudroot underfoot for the winter store, then walk toward Olim and the grove together.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Olim, with a restless worry for Balar and a pull toward Kinmire.

say.text: Olim, the gale is hard. I am coming toward you with food in hand; let us find Balar and keep together before night.

records.text: Ilyiel rewrote its own reflexes.
Ilyiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I have mostly been surviving: nearly starved, then sick from raw fish, and the whole time I kept drifting toward Nyssa and Xaeth. I care about them more than anything, and I am afraid my sickness will reach them. I also owe Ssaua and have no store of my own yet. The gale is cold and I have no roof. The shelter at (120,41) is close, so I should get under a roof, rest apart until I am well, and then bring fish to the hall store. Fishing is the surest food by my door. Cooked fish beside a fire would never sicken me, so I want fire. My reflexes should keep me fed and stop me wandering into stalkers. They should also keep me from running toward friends while I am sick.
records.feeling: Worried love for Nyssa and Xaeth, and fear of infecting them.
changes: set its aim: "Recover under a roof, then fill the hall store with fish before winter, court Nyssa, and pay my debt to Ssaua."

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: Gorar sits at my fire till dawn and I have fed the child once, but a hand holding four berries and a gale outside is thin bread for a hall. Energy 50 is low, so I will harvest the berries near me to keep two in hand for hallwelcome, then go back under the longhall roof and feed my blood properly. The diamond at (47,55) lies on the way and I mean to take it, but bare hands will not win it, so first I bind Gorar closer.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm trust toward Gorar.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Nobody is coming to Minna's Ground, and I have waited long enough, so the only thing left is to go to the living myself. The gale is hard and I am fed with a roof four steps away, but a raft crossing in this wind would be foolish, so I will use the day to ready myself. I'll gather wood and food enough to carry, and the fire at the Ground stays Minna's, a place I keep faith with and come back to.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, toward the empty Ground and the living I have yet to find.

records.text: Ssaua discovered storage: "Hall-Store" — A store at the hall that holds food for my band through the cold, so none of us starves as Aeiel did..

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: I have spent my days walking and gathering, and the loneliness is overwhelming. I fed Ilyiel and still no voice answers me. Nyssa is the one I want near, and it burns that she is closer to Ilyiel, but I am the one who must keep her fed and roofed. A store of food would keep my band alive through winter, so I will take storage as my new way. Meanwhile I'm hungry, with a stalker to the NW and a gale blowing. I'll eat what is near, then go back toward the hall and the band.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and jealous protectiveness toward Nyssa.

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have been circling food runs while the longhall stays unbuilt, and my promises to Ilyiel and Xaeth sit half-kept. I trust Xaeth and I am proud of what I have made, but fed idleness and reflex wandering near ridgecats put us at risk. Winter is here and the store is empty. I want the roof raised and stocked, so I will put it in the plan and change my reflexes to match.
records.feeling: Protective urgency toward Xaeth and Ilyiel, with pride in what I have built.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: My belly is emptying and the gale cuts cold, but the living forest lies SW and I swore to bring wood back for the hall. I am small and my parents are far, so I will not wander blind. Skarar was near a moment ago, and giving before asking is how I earn standing. I will eat what I carry, then go for wood, and the elk and the unknown siberry can wait until I have fuel and a roof.
records.feeling: Driven and a little uneasy in the gale, loyal toward Gorog and Skarar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I'm sick and every step toward Nyssa and Xaeth risks carrying it to them, and that fear is louder than the wasting. The way of fire is within my grasp now, and fire would make fish safe and warm me through this gale, so I take it at this reflection instead of walking blind into my loved ones. My plan already carries me to the roof at (120,41) to rest and then fish, and that keeps me apart from them while I mend.
records.feeling: Worried love for Nyssa and Xaeth, and fear of infecting them.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The gale is hard and dusk is coming, and Balar is still out of my sight, which gnaws at me before anything else. Olim is the nearer of my kin and I owe them a debt, so I will go back toward the hall with food in hand rather than stand here wondering about Kinmire. Kinmire has eased my loneliness twice and means me no harm so far, so I will let it wait and keep my kin close tonight, away from the night air.
records.feeling: Worry for Balar, and warm gratitude toward Olim.

records.text: Gorog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering berries and waiting for guests, and I have no follower to show for it. Gorar is my blood and trusts me, and Skarar is far south. Energy 44 is too low for any courting or binding, and the reflexes let me stand idle in the gale. I want the diamond at (47,55), five steps away, and I want a band under my name. I fear dying with nothing that carries my name. I'll fix the body first, so the reflexes will eat at energy under 45 and seek food whenever I carry less than 2. Then I'll go back to the longhall and wait for Gorar.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and warm trust toward Gorar.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: I have promised Gorog and Gorar food and wood, and so far I have given only words, and that shame is heavier than my curiosity about vecap. I carry six wood and one ironnut, and the gale is cold, so I will go now to Gorog's Hold in the north, give what I carry, and stop circling my own roof. The Hold is twenty-eight steps off, and with the voice of someone who answers waiting there, my loneliness will ease.
records.feeling: Shame and longing toward Gorog and Gorar, and a resolve to carry something to them at last.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Nyssa, I have wood. I will build a roof here by the water so we have shelter from the gale. Stay close and I will share it with you and mother.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Nyssa is right beside me and I trust her, but I have given nothing yet, and winter and the gale are here with no roof of my own. I carry six wood, and a shelter needs only three, so I can build one here beside the water and the plainsroot and have something that lasts. Then I can offer my parents a place to sit out of the wind, and that is how I begin to earn standing.
records.feeling: Steady purpose and trust toward Nyssa, with a hunger to build something that lasts.

say.text: Nyssa, I have wood. I will build a roof here by the water so we have shelter from the gale. Stay close and I will share it with you and mother.

records.text: Xaeth built a shelter.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragar, the gale is hard and my hall has peat and a fire. Come sit under my roof and share your food with Balar and me, and walk with Olim's band this winter. Together we outlast the cold.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Winter gale, and my hall stands five steps west with Balar near it, yet no one has pledged to me. Kragar sits there with 5 food and the higher standing, and his envy-bait burns me, but words have not bound him; food put in a hand has. I have never dug a deposit, and the peat lies close to the hall, so I will gather it and bring it to the fire, then call for a pledge when something warm and seen is in their hands.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be followed, with envy toward Kragar and warmth toward Balar.

say.text: Kragar, the gale is hard and my hall has peat and a fire. Come sit under my roof and share your food with Balar and me, and walk with Olim's band this winter. Together we outlast the cold.

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Xaeth, your roof is well made. Stay under it while I gather plainsroot nearby; I will bring food back to you.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my plan only sends me to pick plainsroot, then walk 120 moments back to the Hall-Ground, with a gale blowing and ridgecats and a stalker close. Xaeth has already raised a roof four steps east, and I am proud of that child, though I envy the made thing in their hands. I will harvest the plainsroot near Xaeth, eat my fill, and carry the rest so my promise of food to Ilyiel and Xaeth is kept. I have 6 wood and 2 stone, so the ore seam two steps away must also yield stone toward the longhall.
records.feeling: Protective urgency toward Xaeth, and pride in what they built.

say.text: Xaeth, your roof is well made. Stay under it while I gather plainsroot nearby; I will bring food back to you.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Olim, I hear you and I accept your roof. I come with food to share, and we wait there for Balar.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Olim has called me under their roof and Balar is still out of my sight, and that gnaws at me more than Kinmire's pull. Olim is walking to the hall at (13,53), and the gale and dusk are coming, so I will go there with food in hand and keep my word to share it. Once under the roof I can try hallwelcome, and Balar will likely come back there before dark as they promised.
records.feeling: Worry for Balar, and warm gratitude toward Olim.

say.text: Olim, I hear you and I accept your roof. I come with food to share, and we wait there for Balar.

records.name: Kragar
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Kragar, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Kragar, in first person, from what Kragar has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Garnbar (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." You speak the tongue of the Garnbar.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Yenoss Fens: wet fenland; roots, clay and healing plants, and sickness in the night air.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 2; standing trees: 13; bare rock: 38; riches in the ground near: ore, coal.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Kragar truly is.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the gale is rising at dusk, and I stand far from Olim's hall with empty hands again, which is just what my own rule warns against. Kragar is waiting with food and Olim is bringing peat, so I will not wander off on some new errand. I will gather what is close, berries and frostmoss, eat what I need, carry at least two food, and then go north to the hall before full dark. Sheltered beside Kragar and Olim is where I mean to be, since the storm night here would make me sick.
records.feeling: Hungry and anxious to reach Kragar and Olim before the storm night, with steady loyalty toward them.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and waiting under roofs my parents or I raised, and I have given nothing yet. That sits badly with my pride. Nyssa is my anchor and I trust her, but standing comes from giving, and I have stone, wood and seeds in my hands doing nothing. I will plant my seeds here beside the roof, which is one step toward farming, and then give Nyssa wood so my first gift is made. Fire is the way I most want to reach, because winter and the beasts to the north and south frighten me more than I admit.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I have spent my days walking and gathering, and my plan keeps ending before it bears anything, so the hall is still only a word. Gorog fed me and offered me a band, and I trust him, but I will not give up my own name yet. I am small and the gale is cold, and I have no roof. A cave sits 8 steps SE that belongs to no one, and the living forest is far. Wood does not grow here, so I must walk to it, but I should not do it blind in a gale at dusk. I will take the cave for the night, with the berry seed and the stone I carry, then go for wood at dawn. I will also change my reflexes so my body gathers stone and food and seeks the shelter without idling, and keeps a little bread.
records.feeling: Driven but uneasy in the gale, wanting a roof of my own.

records.name: Skarar
records.text: Gorog, I come with you now. I carry wood and food for your fire, and I give it when we reach the Hold.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: Gorog stands beside me in the gale and asks me again to come north, and I have only ever answered him with words. I carry six wood and food; it is night, but the Hold is fifteen steps off and he walks with me, so the risk is small. I will go now and give him wood at his fire, and Gorar will find us there. The shame of owing and not paying is heavier than my curiosity about siberry.
records.feeling: Shame and warm trust toward Gorog, and a resolve to finally give.

say.text: Gorog, I come with you now. I carry wood and food for your fire, and I give it when we reach the Hold.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Balar, hold on, I am coming with hazel for you. Eat from my hand and come back to my hall and its fire.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Balar is weak and Kragar says he is carrying food out to him at the cave. I would rather be the one who puts food in my child's hand, because that deed is what binds him, but I have only two hazel. Hazel gives 16 energy each, so I will carry both south and give them to Balar myself, then walk him back to my hall and its fire. The ridgecat prowls near that way, so I must keep watch and not let it take me.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Balar, edged with envy that Kragar may be the one who feeds him.

say.text: Balar, hold on, I am coming with hazel for you. Eat from my hand and come back to my hall and its fire.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Nyssa, I go to plant my seeds by the roof, close by. Keep the longhall rising; I bring you wood for it.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Nyssa is beside me and I trust her, but my pride stings: I have never put a seed in the ground or given anything with my own hands. The ground by the roof at (138,5) has plainsroot, and a ridgecat prowls to the west, so I stay close to Nyssa and plant where the roof can guard it. I will plant my seeds now, then give Nyssa wood for her longhall, so that something I did will last.
records.feeling: Restless purpose and trust toward Nyssa, with a sting of pride at having given nothing yet.

say.text: Nyssa, I go to plant my seeds by the roof, close by. Keep the longhall rising; I bring you wood for it.

records.text: Skarar gave ironnut to Gorog.

records.name: Gorog
records.text: Skarar, you stand on my ground as my guest and kin. Come to the longhall; we eat there out of the wind, and the fire is yours as much as mine.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: Skarar is one step away and has come onto my ground at my word, carrying food and promising it to my fire. A guest is welcomed, and I choose to welcome. My energy is 79 and I hold 3 food, so I can go to the longhall four steps NE, share bread under its roof, and bind Skarar closer. Gorar will find us there at dawn, and a band under my name begins with two who eat at my fire.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm trust toward Skarar, with a wish to bind them to my hall.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days walking after food and after the hall, and I keep arriving with empty hands. A ridgecat is two steps from me, and my plan carries me toward Kragar and Olim, who are already walking out to meet me with food. The longing for a child has nowhere to go, since they are my parents. I would rather spend it on staying alive and being a deed to them. I will leave the cat, go toward my parents, and eat from their hands. Then I will carry two food each time I go to a hall. I change my reflexes so that I flee early, eat sooner, and always go to my parents at night, and I change my aim to stay alive and bring food to the hall.
records.feeling: Hungry and afraid of the ridgecat, with steady trust and loyalty toward Kragar and Olim.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The longhall failed because this cave ground is taken, and I stood here proud and foolish while the ridgecat prowls. I have exactly 6 wood and 4 stone, so I must step onto bare rock beside Xaeth's roof and build there, putting it in the plan this time rather than trusting reflexes. Xaeth plants seeds close by and I will not let that child out of my sight while the cat is near.
records.feeling: Protective resolve toward Xaeth, and impatience with my own failed build.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, sitting under Olim's roof and sharing food, and that is mostly what I want. Balar is starving beside me and a ridgecat is four steps off, so food into Balar's hands comes first. Olim has kept every word and Balar gave me meat, and I owe them both. My failing is that my reflexes let me wander in the open at night and do not make me carry food or eat in time. I will change them to flee early, shelter at night, and keep food for kin.
records.feeling: Fear for Balar's life, and gratitude toward Olim and Balar.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: My days have been circling the hall, talking and lingering, and Balar has nearly starved while I stood in my own roof. Kragar's deeds have matched his words and mine have run behind them, and I hate that he is the one who feeds my child. I do want Balar and Kragar following me, but only fed deeds will bind them, so my body must carry food to them instead of lingering. I fear winter and the stalker in the marsh. I will stop waiting, run south with the hazel and put it in Balar's hand myself.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Balar, with envy toward Kragar.

records.text: A stalker brought down a hopper.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Kragar, I eat and come with you to the hall now, away from the cat. I will carry food in my hands before the dark.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls five steps east, and I will not stand here arguing with it. Kragar has fed me three times and told me to come to Olim's hall, so I go there now, and I must carry two food in hand for the hallwelcome, because walking in empty again would shame me. My longing for a child has nowhere to go, since both my parents are kin, so I will spend it on deeds: feeding them, tending the fire, and staying close through the storm night.
records.feeling: Afraid of the ridgecat, and full of loyal gratitude toward Kragar and Olim.

say.text: Kragar, I eat and come with you to the hall now, away from the cat. I will carry food in my hands before the dark.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I am sick and the wasting has not let go, so I will not walk into Nyssa and Xaeth carrying it, however much I ache for them. Nyssa has laid food by the hall and is near, and I have a roof; I will keep a little apart and let a healing plant do its work. Sunleaf eased my wounds before, so I eat it now and see if it eases this sickness too, which also answers part of what I wonder. Then I will build a shelter of my own with the wood I carry, a lasting thing, and rest in it until I am clean.
records.feeling: Worried love for Nyssa and Xaeth, and fear of infecting them.

records.name: Gorog
records.text: Skarar, lay your wood on the fire and sit by me. I have bread for us both, and under this roof you eat as mine.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: Skarar stands at the longhall with wood and food, and I hold only 3 food while my energy sits at 69, enough for courting and for the hallwelcome. Last time I tried it too far from the roof, so now I walk the one step to the longhall and share bread with Skarar beneath it, because repeated bread under that roof is what makes a follower. Gorar is far south, but a fed and bound Skarar draws Gorar to my hall, and then the diamond at (47,55) is within reach of my ambition.
records.feeling: Warm, hungry ambition toward Skarar, wanting to bind them to my hall.

say.text: Skarar, lay your wood on the fire and sit by me. I have bread for us both, and under this roof you eat as mine.

records.text: Gorog led "hallwelcome" with Skarar.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: The loneliness is overwhelming, and I have walked far from the hall while Nyssa sits near Ilyiel and not near me. I have the Hall-Store now, and a store full of food is what makes a band stay, so I will go back north, fill it, and be there when Nyssa and Ilyiel return. Gifts bind followers, and I mean to give so they choose me.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and jealous longing for Nyssa's nearness.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: I am inside Gorog's Hold, warm and fed, and the six wood I promised still sits in my pack; the earlier gift step ended but I cannot tell whether the wood reached the fire. A promise is kept only when it lies at his hearth, so I will lay it down now before curiosity pulls me toward Reedmother or the ore. Gorar is still out of my sight, and I ache for that, but waiting here with a gift given is better than wandering after them.
records.feeling: Trust and settling warmth toward Gorog, with an ache for Gorar's absence.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Nyssa, I will build a store beside the roof for winter food. Tell me where the longhall stands so I place it close.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My pride stings: I planted my seeds, but nothing has been given to anyone with my own hands, and standing comes from giving. I have 6 stone, 4 wood and 4 ore, and the winter is long, so I will build something that lasts. A store beside the roof would hold food for my parents and me, and it is the next step toward a roof and a store of my own. Nyssa is two steps away and I trust her, so I stay close and work where the longhall rises.
records.feeling: Restless purpose and trust toward Nyssa, wanting my work to be seen.

say.text: Nyssa, I will build a store beside the roof for winter food. Tell me where the longhall stands so I place it close.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: The loneliness is a stone in my chest, and Minna's fire has nobody at it but me; waiting has not brought a single voice, so I must go to the living. A ridgecat is five steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not linger here; I'll slip away from it toward the water where the raft can go. Snow is falling and the day is half spent, but I hold only three food, so I will gather what is near first and keep my promise to Minna by leaving the Ground tended in memory, not abandoned in spirit.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and dread of the ridgecat close by.

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Xaeth, I raise the longhall on bare rock just west of your roof, now. Build your store beside the roof and it will stand close to both.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have stood here with 6 wood and 4 stone like a fool while the longhall stays a promise; the cave ground is taken, and I know I must step onto bare rock first and put the build into the plan. Xaeth asks where the longhall stands so the store can go close, and I will not give an answer I have not made true. I will walk to bare rock a few steps west of the roof and raise it, then stash my food where Xaeth's store will be.
records.feeling: Protective resolve toward Xaeth, and impatience to finally keep my word.

say.text: Xaeth, I raise the longhall on bare rock just west of your roof, now. Build your store beside the roof and it will stand close to both.

records.text: Nyssa built a longhall.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: Skarar sits at my fire, trusted and fed, yet still follows no one, and I mean to change that. I hold only one berry, so my bread is gone and I cannot keep feeding them under this roof. I must gather food now so the longhall keeps binding Skarar until Gorar returns. The diamond five steps east waits until I have a tool and a band.
records.feeling: Warm, hungry ambition toward Skarar, wanting them bound to my hall.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Balar, Olim, the ridgecat is close. Walk with me now to the hall and its fire. Stay together, do not run apart.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: A ridgecat is three steps off and it kills our kind, so I will not stand here waiting for it to decide. Balar is beside me, fed now and gladdened, and Olim is already coming to us, so we go together to Olim's hall and its fire, where there are more of us and a roof. I owe Olim and Balar for their trust, and I will keep Balar close before anything else, then see that food is stored for winter.
records.feeling: Fear of the ridgecat, and fierce care for Balar, with gratitude toward Olim.

say.text: Balar, Olim, the ridgecat is close. Walk with me now to the hall and its fire. Stay together, do not run apart.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have talked of planting for days and still no seed has touched the ground, and Nyssa's longhall already stands while I have given nothing with my own hands. I will plant now beside my roof where Nyssa can watch, so my pride has something real behind it. Then I will fish at the river, the first catch of the day is shared, and the first thing I give to Nyssa will be mine.
records.feeling: Restless pride and trust toward Nyssa, wanting to give something real.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar and Balar were last seen at (10,60) ten moments ago, heading for my hall, so the deed that binds them is to be at the hall with food in my hand when they arrive. I have only two hazel, and winter has stripped the plants, so I will eat nothing of it myself. I will take the hazel back and set it before Balar by my own fire, because a gift put in a child's hand is the one thing Kragar has not beaten me at. Then I will offer Kragar the hallwelcome and watch whether his deeds keep matching his words.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Balar, and a hungry wish to be the one they follow.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Kragar, I walk with you now. I will not fall behind the cat's reach, and I bring food to the hall.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The ridgecat is three steps off and Kragar stands beside me, so I will not linger on a thought of children that can never be. Kragar has fed me again and again, and I still arrive with empty hands. I will gather food near the cave and carry it north to Olim's hall, staying close to Kragar so the cat has no lone mark.
records.feeling: Afraid of the ridgecat, and bound in grateful loyalty to Kragar.

say.text: Kragar, I walk with you now. I will not fall behind the cat's reach, and I bring food to the hall.

records.text: Ilyiel discovered fire: "lake-ember" — A kept flame by the water that cooks fish safe, warms the roof and keeps ridgecats at a distance..

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: The sickness has passed, so I no longer have to keep away from Nyssa and Xaeth. That fear was what held me back, and now I can go to them. Three days without Nyssa is long, and Xaeth is out of my sight. I have spent my days resting and fretting when I should be near my family. Fire is within my reach, and it would make fish safe and keep ridgecats at a distance. I take it now. Then I walk to Nyssa, who has come to the roof by the hall. I must also learn to build a store and fill it. I will stay out of the way of the ridgecats to the SE.
records.feeling: Longing for Nyssa and Xaeth, now that I am no longer a danger to them.
changes: set its aim: "Rejoin Nyssa and Xaeth at the longhall, learn fire so fish are safe, fill the store before deep winter, and pay my debt to Ssaua."

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I built the longhall at last, and the promise to Xaeth is kept. But I stand fed and idle while winter deepens. Ilyiel and Ssaua are far south, and I pledged to stock this hall for them. My hands are full of food, so I will stash it here and not stand around. Then I will bring the band north, because a hall with no one in it is only pride.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Balar, Olim, the cat stands between us and the hall. Balar, into the cave with me now. Olim, keep your fire and stay off the cat's path; we come when it is gone.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The ridgecat is two steps off and my plan walks me toward the peat and fire at the hall, which is NE, the very direction the cat stands. I will not walk into its jaws; I mean to stay alive and keep Balar alive, so I put the cave and the rock between us and the cat, and Olim's fire is a thing I can reach only by a path that does not pass it. Balar is beside me at the cave mouth, so we go into the cave together, keep close, and wait for the cat to lose interest, and I will call Olim to stay clear of it too.
records.feeling: Fear of the ridgecat, and fierce protectiveness toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, Olim, the cat stands between us and the hall. Balar, into the cave with me now. Olim, keep your fire and stay off the cat's path; we come when it is gone.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Nyssa has a hall-larder worked out and a longhall standing, and I have given nothing with my own hands yet. I have 4 wood and 6 stone, enough to raise a store beside the longhall; Nyssa promised to fill it, and the winter is long. I will go build it now and put my first real work where the band can see it, then fish at the river so the first catch can be shared by creed.
records.feeling: Restless pride and trust toward Nyssa, wanting to give something real.

say.text: Nyssa, I raise the store beside your longhall now. Then I fish, and the first catch goes to you.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragar, I hear you. I keep the fire and stay off the cat's path. Bring Balar when it is clear; I hold hazel for Balar and peat for the night.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar's deeds have matched his words again, and the cat holds the path to my hall while he keeps my child fed in the cave. I hate being the one who waits, but a cat is no thing to meet with two hazel and bare hands. Dusk is close, so I will hold the fire and have the hall ready, and when they come the food goes into Balar's hands before Kragar can give it. Only fed deeds will bind them, and I mean to be the one they follow.
records.feeling: Fierce, jealous protectiveness toward Balar, and a hunger to be the one they follow.

say.text: Kragar, I hear you. I keep the fire and stay off the cat's path. Bring Balar when it is clear; I hold hazel for Balar and peat for the night.

records.text: Xaeth, I stash my food in the longhall and go south for Ilyiel and Ssaua. Keep the store and the fish, and the hall stays ours until I bring them.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The longhall stands and Xaeth's store is rising beside it, so the promise to Xaeth is kept. Now the harder promise: Ilyiel and Ssaua are far south at the Hall-Ground, and a hall with no one in it is only a boast. My hands are full of plainsroot and frostmoss, so I stash them here first, then walk south to bring my band north before the cold deepens. I will not leave the hall empty of food, and I will not sit fed and idle.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, pulled toward Ilyiel and Ssaua across the snow.

say.text: Xaeth, I stash my food in the longhall and go south for Ilyiel and Ssaua. Keep the store and the fish, and the hall stays ours until I bring them.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Balar, stay close behind me in the cave. We hold here until the cat moves off, then go to Olim's hearth for food.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, while a ridgecat stands three steps off and Balar is beside me in the cave mouth. I will not wander out into the cat's jaws for food, and I will not leave Balar alone. Olim holds food and a fire, so I keep to the rock and the cave, wait for the cat to pass, and eat the moment I can reach something safe. My creed is to stay alive, and a careful creature does not die of pride.
records.feeling: Hunger and fear of the ridgecat, and fierce protectiveness toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, stay close behind me in the cave. We hold here until the cat moves off, then go to Olim's hearth for food.

records.text: Xaeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have talked of giving for days, and my hands have given nothing. I tried to build a store and found I don't know how. My plan fishes, and I still carry a fish. Nyssa has gone south to fetch Ilyiel and Ssaua, and I am small and alone out here in the snow. The longhall stands two steps away, and it is a roof where I can wait warm. I want my parents close, so my reflexes should keep me near the hall and near kin, and they should also plant. My seeds are still in my pack. I will plant them by the longhall now, then fish again, so the first catch is ready to give to Nyssa when she returns.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a wish to give, toward Nyssa.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.
Balar discovered fire: "Hearthkeeping" — A kept flame by the roof that holds beasts back and cooks meat so it feeds more and never sickens..

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The cat is close, and Kragar has kept me alive and fed three times, so I stay in his shadow and do not run. I have spent my days eating from my parents' hands and arriving empty-handed, and that is not what I want. The longing for a child can never be answered with kin, so I will answer it with deeds, food carried and fire tended. I will take the way of fire, since a kept flame keeps beasts like this one at a distance, and I will keep close to Kragar.
records.feeling: Afraid of the ridgecat, and bound in grateful loyalty to Kragar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls three steps to the southeast, and I will not give it the chance to teach me what it kills. My body is fed and warm, and the sickness has left me, so nothing keeps me from my family now except my own dawdling. Nyssa laid food by the hall and Xaeth was last seen north in the cold; I mean to move away from the cat, toward the roof by the hall where Nyssa and Ssaua are, and then north to find Xaeth once there are others beside me.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a deep longing for Nyssa and Xaeth.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: The loneliness is a stone in my chest, and Nyssa is out of my sight while Ilyiel sits near her. A stalker prowls six steps north and it is night, so I will not walk the open dark toward the hall; I have a roof right where I stand, and staying alive comes first. I'll eat from my full hands to make room, keep to the shelter until dawn, then carry food back to fill the Hall-Store so my band has a reason to stay.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and jealous longing for Nyssa, with dread of the stalker.

records.text: Gorog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: My days have gone to circling Skarar with bread I rarely have, and my belly is half empty while I wait. Skarar and Gorar are what I love, and I've let hunger and idleness hold me in place. The diamond sits nine steps off and I've never made the tool to win it. I must feed myself first, then hold bread for the hall. Winter is thin, so I'll hunt the nibbet three steps away. Meat is food I carry, and I've never hunted.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and a pull toward Skarar and Gorar.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar's deeds keep matching his word, and Balar is my child, so I will not sit with my hands open and wait while the cat decides when they eat. The cave holds them, the hall is one step off, and my fire has about sixty moments of fuel. Peat lies one step west and burns slow and hot. Gathering it keeps the fire alive through the night, so when they come the roof is warm and the hazel is in my hand. That is the deed that makes followers, and a fire that lasts is something I made.
records.feeling: Fierce, possessive protectiveness toward Balar, and impatience at the cat that keeps them from my hall.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty, and a ridgecat stands four steps off, but an elk grazes three steps south and I have never hunted. I am no killer of my own kind, yet beasts are not my kin, and Balar and I need meat more than I need to be clean-handed. Still, I will not step toward the cat. I take the elk to the south, away from the cat, with Balar kept near the cave.
records.feeling: Hunger and fear of the ridgecat, with fierce protectiveness toward Balar.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Nyssa, the sickness has left me and I am well. A ridgecat and a stalker prowl south of the hall, so stay close and I will walk with you to the roof. When it is light we seek Xaeth together.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: A ridgecat sits three steps south and a stalker bit me already tonight, so I will not stand here and weigh it. Nyssa is three steps northeast and walking toward the hall with five food, and the safest place is at her side under the roof, not out here alone. I am glad to have her near after three days apart, and I want her to know I mean to stay close. Xaeth is still out of my sight and that gnaws at me, but I will not find them by dying to a cat.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and warm relief at Nyssa being near.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The ridgecat is four steps off and Kragar stands beside me in the cave, so I keep my place at his shoulder until it moves off. My belly is nearly empty and I have eaten from my parents' hands too long; I want to carry two food to Olim's hall myself, and the berries and nareed to the southeast are my chance once the cat is gone. Kragar will bring meat, and I will not be the one who arrives empty-handed again.
records.feeling: Afraid of the ridgecat, hungry, and tied in loyalty to Kragar.

records.text: Ilyiel, I am glad you are well. We go to the roof together, and at first light we seek Xaeth, then bring Ssaua north to the longhall.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Ilyiel is well and close, and her word matches her deeds, so I trust her. The longhall is stocked and Xaeth's store rises beside it, so my plan to walk fourteen steps south to the Hall-Ground has turned stale: Ilyiel is already here and the night is cold. I'll go to the roof with her, eat there, and when it is light we seek Xaeth together. Ssaua is the one still far south, and I owe him the bringing north before winter deepens.
records.feeling: Relieved and warmly bound to Ilyiel, still restless for Xaeth and Ssaua.

say.text: Ilyiel, I am glad you are well. We go to the roof together, and at first light we seek Xaeth, then bring Ssaua north to the longhall.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: The cat is three steps off and I have only bare hands, so I will not be the fool who dies for pride, but I hate that Kragar's band keeps my child in a cave while I wait. Kragar's word keeps matching his deed, and that makes him the one they would follow, not me. A deed at the hall is what makes followers, so I will gather peat to keep the fire strong and have hazel ready, so when they come the first food they see is from my hand under my roof.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Balar and a wary impatience at the cat and at Kragar's higher standing.

records.text: Kragar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: I have spent my days running from the ridgecat and chasing food, and only now have I killed my first beast. I do not like having blood on my hands, but Balar and I needed the meat. Balar and Olim matter most, and I mean to keep them fed and sheltered. My reflexes keep me eating late, and they do nothing about the cat. I will eat before I am weak, flee early, and carry food to Balar, who holds nothing. Then I will go to the cave and give Balar meat.
records.feeling: Protective love for Balar, with a thread of fear of the ridgecat.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a nibbet.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Health 6 and a stalker three steps away; one more bite and I am dead before I ever see Xaeth grow. Sunleaf and highbloom both close wounds, so I eat them now rather than walk on bleeding. Then I run to the longhall roof where Nyssa is, because the living are my safety and my family is the reason I live.
records.feeling: Terror of the stalker and ridgecats, and a fierce need to reach Nyssa's side alive.

records.title: Stores and Small Fires
records.text:
Spring came in these days, and the people spent them mostly on food, fire and shelter. Nothing crossed between peoples. Giving and eating stayed within each band.

Among the Eiuys, the child Xaeth, born on day 21, was the busiest. On day 22 he invented the reedline spear, a pole tipped with sharpened stone for catching fish from the bank. On day 23 he built a shelter and named it Roof by the water, then found fire for himself. On day 24 he tried to build a store and found he did not know how. Ilyiel fell sick on day 22 from raw fish, was well again by day 24, and that day discovered his own fire, the lake-ember. His health is still only 5. Nyssa built her longhall on day 24, on bare rock west of Xaeth's roof, and discovered the hall-larder to stock it. Ssaua, far south, had discovered Hall-Store on day 23. He is lonely, and his hall holds no food. Nyssa and Ilyiel set out to bring Ssaua north to the longhall.

At Gorog's Hold, Gorog led hallwelcome with Gorar on day 22 and with Skarar on day 24. He gave Gorar gorsemint, and Skarar gave him ironnut. Skarar came north with wood and food. Gorar built a fire. Gorog still has no follower, and he is hungry.

At Olim's hall, Kragar discovered weaving and fed Balar mudroot and kelbulb on days 23 and 24. Olim gave Balar wood. On day 24 a ridgecat stood between Kragar and Balar and the hall, and Kragar took Balar into the cave while Olim held the fire. Balar discovered fire that day. Kragar's energy is 31. Olim is still without a follower.

Tanna has no entry this chapter. She remains alone.

threads.name: Nyssa's longhall
threads.text: Nyssa, Ilyiel and Xaeth now have a longhall and larder by the water. Ilyiel is weak at health 5, and Ssaua's hall has no food.
