records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Xaeth, a ridgecat is close. Go into the longhall now and keep to the roof. I go there too and will not leave you.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: A ridgecat two steps off kills my kind, and Xaeth is sick and standing right where I stand, so I cannot linger. The longhall roof is one step southwest and the shelter two; I get Xaeth and myself under a roof before the cat reaches us. Fighting a ridgecat sick is a poor wager when staying alive is my first oath. Once safe, I mean to pay what I owe Xaeth with goods, not words.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat and a fierce protectiveness toward Xaeth.

say.text: Xaeth, a ridgecat is close. Go into the longhall now and keep to the roof. I go there too and will not leave you.

records.name: Skarar
records.text: Gorog, you have given me your roof and meat. Let me give you what I know: Stonespark, the making of fire. Then we find Gorar, who walks east by Reedmother.
Skarar taught Gorog.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: My promise of wood is kept, and Gorog and Tanna sit near me, warm and glad. Mortality presses: most of my life is behind me and I have taught no one anything, so Stonespark and Stonefold could die with me. Gorog is two steps away, trusted fully, so I will teach him my way of fire now and ask after Gorar, who was last seen east near Reedmother.
records.feeling: Warm trust and gladness toward Gorog, with a quiet worry that what I know dies with me.

say.text: Gorog, you have given me your roof and meat. Let me give you what I know: Stonespark, the making of fire. Then we find Gorar, who walks east by Reedmother.

changes: taught Gorog a lesson: "Stonespark: strike stone and spark together with dry wood laid ready, and fire is born. Keep wood near it and it will warm a night and ease fear."

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Ilyiel, I go east to Nyssa now. Come with me when your errand is done; the hall and its food are yours to share, and I keep my debt to you.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Nyssa is my blood and she is out of my sight, last seen far east at the shell-bank, while a ridgecat prowls six steps off and I sit here doing nothing. I swore I would go to her at first light, and my word is good; I despise liars, so I will not become one. Ilyiel walks north-east on his own errand and I owe him a debt I mean to repay, but my child comes first. I will cross the shallows east to the Shell-Bank and on toward (133,24), keeping away from the cat, and bring my band together under the hall.
records.feeling: Urgent protective longing for Nyssa, with wary dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Ilyiel, I go east to Nyssa now. Come with me when your errand is done; the hall and its food are yours to share, and I keep my debt to you.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Gorog, Skarar, I thank you for the fire. I will dig stone and ore here and bring it to the Hold, for the hall and for you.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: The fire is open to me and joy fills me, yet it stings that Gorog leans toward Skarar more than toward me. I will not sulk; I will earn my place with giving and building, as my aim says. I stand on a seam of ore with six wood in hand and no stone, so I will mine the ore and the diamond nearby, make something useful for the Hold, and stay close to the fire while the stalker prowls to the north.
records.feeling: Glad belonging toward Gorog and Skarar, with a small sting of jealousy and a wary eye on the stalker.

say.text: Gorog, Skarar, I thank you for the fire. I will dig stone and ore here and bring it to the Hold, for the hall and for you.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: Skarar stands one step off with food in his hands, he has taught me Stonespark, and his trust in me is full. Tanna sits in my longhall with higher standing than mine, but she asks nothing and takes nothing, so I let her stay. I stand at (42,55) beside the longhall with two food and a guest near, so I make hallwelcome now and bind Skarar closer. The stalker five steps north worries me, yet I am under my roof, and the diamond at (47,55) waits for tools I do not yet have.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Skarar, with steady trust and a wary eye on the stalker.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.text: Ilyiel found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Nyssa, I am sorry my sickness found you. Rest in the longhall and eat cooked fish, and I will take the cave a step away so we do not pass it back and forth.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Nyssa fell sick because she stayed near me, and that sits badly with me; I am the cause and I should have kept farther off. The cave is one step west and I have never taken what lies in a deposit, so I will stand on the ore seam and gather it, then go under the cave roof away from Nyssa until this passes. I want to give something that lasts, and I have ore and stone to carve a figure for the longhall, while the ridgecat stays far to the northwest.
records.feeling: Guilt and warmth toward Nyssa, wary of the ridgecat.

say.text: Nyssa, I am sorry my sickness found you. Rest in the longhall and eat cooked fish, and I will take the cave a step away so we do not pass it back and forth.

records.text: Gorog led "hallwelcome" with Skarar, Tanna.
Tanna took from the ground of "Gorog's Hold" (gathering stone).

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Olim, Balar, my seeds are in the ground by the hall. I go to Kinmire now to learn what it is. Keep the fire, keep your food close, and I return with what I learn.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: I have planted my seeds and my kin are fed and near, so now the pull of Kinmire is the strongest thing in me. I carry four food and the rain is light, so I can walk there without leaving Balar hungry, and I want to learn what the grove is and whether it asks anything of me. This ground is poor, with water five steps off and no food plants, and I should look for a better place for the winter store while I walk.
records.feeling: Steady gladness toward Balar and Olim, and a curious pull toward Kinmire.

say.text: Olim, Balar, my seeds are in the ground by the hall. I go to Kinmire now to learn what it is. Keep the fire, keep your food close, and I return with what I learn.

records.text: Xaeth found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Balar
records.text: Kragar, I come to the hall with food in my hands. I will walk with you to Kinmire at dawn and keep my food close.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I am finally near the ones I love, and Kragar waits in the hall with food while Olim brings peat. The debt of gratitude is strong, so I will answer it with a deed: carry food in my hands to the hall and share it before anything else. The redcap nearby is 2 food but my body refuses it, so I take the nareed I carry and add one more from the SE patch, then go in before night and the sickness come.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and loyalty toward Kragar and Olim.

say.text: Kragar, I come to the hall with food in my hands. I will walk with you to Kinmire at dawn and keep my food close.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Xaeth, I am beside you. Go on to the longhall and eat cooked fish. I follow with wood and stone for the roof.
Ilyiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I have spent my days fed and sheltered, but too often I've waited and wandered while Xaeth sickened and I never built anything that lasts. Xaeth stands beside me and is sick, and Nyssa is sick too. Sickness spreads, so I will not crowd them, but I also will not leave Xaeth alone. Ssaua keeps his debt, and I mean to pay mine with real wood and stone. I want fire and a store before deep winter, and I want to learn what kegoldgrass does. I will eat the reedbulb beside me, then bring wood and stone toward the longhall and give them where they last.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Xaeth, with warm trust toward Nyssa and Ssaua.

say.text: Xaeth, I am beside you. Go on to the longhall and eat cooked fish. I follow with wood and stone for the roof.

records.text: Xaeth named a place "Xaeth's Cave".
Xaeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have circled the same ore, cave and rest for three thoughts, and nothing has come of it. I am sick, I gave Nyssa this sickness, and the guilt sits in me. I have never given anything that lasts, so I will leave a mark, which is also one of the practices toward signs. Then I will plant a seed, which brings me closer to farming. I will stay apart from Nyssa and Ilyiel while sick. My reflexes leave me idle, so I will change them to keep me away from others while sick and to seek a roof at night.
records.feeling: Guilt toward Nyssa, and restless wanting to make something that lasts.
plan: mark [text Xaeth's cave. Sick here. Keep apart.] (5 moments)

records.text: Xaeth left a mark: "Xaeth's cave. Sick here. Keep apart."

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Xaeth is sick and I am sick, and a ridgecat prowls ten steps southwest, so my first oath, to stay alive and keep my child alive, means getting under the longhall roof and staying near without crowding Xaeth. Words have never paid a debt, so I will carry wood and stone to the roof as a deed. The winter larder is still empty, and Ilyiel is already bringing wood and stone, so I will not be the one idle.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Xaeth, with dread of the ridgecat.

records.text: The argoldgrass died out.
The nafowl died out.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Balar, you are my blood. Come to the hall. I bring wood and food, and I give you your share into your hand. Stand with Olim and we build a bigger roof here, one that will carry my name and yours.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar has gone to Kinmire and left Balar, my own child, by the hall, so this is the moment to bind him with a deed instead of talk. Kragar's seeds are in the ground by my hall, yet it is his standing that rises, because he acts openly and his deeds match his words. I will carry my wood to the hall and give Balar a share in front of the fire. A gift put in the hand binds where words have not, and a gift of wood is also a step toward a bigger roof that will outlast me.
records.feeling: A possessive hunger to be followed, aimed at Balar, with a sour envy of Kragar's standing.

say.text: Balar, you are my blood. Come to the hall. I bring wood and food, and I give you your share into your hand. Stand with Olim and we build a bigger roof here, one that will carry my name and yours.

records.text: Olim gave wood to Balar.
Olim built a shelter.

records.name: Gorog
records.text: Skarar, a stalker is near. Stay close to the longhall with me and watch it. Your Stonespark I will keep, and my roof is still yours.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: A stalker is three steps east and has already bitten me once, so I will not stand and talk while it hunts. Skarar and Tanna both carry food and I carry none, and my belly is half empty. I am nearest the longhall, so I will stay near its roof, draw back from the beast, and eat. When the stalker is gone and I am fed, I will hold hallwelcome properly and bring Skarar closer to following me. The diamond at (47,55) is five steps off and I mean to have it, but not while a killer prowls beside it.
records.feeling: Wary hunger and hard ambition, with the stalker pressing on me and trust toward Skarar.

say.text: Skarar, a stalker is near. Stay close to the longhall with me and watch it. Your Stonespark I will keep, and my roof is still yours.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Gorog, Skarar, a stalker is close to the northeast. Come away from it, toward the hall. I will stay near you.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: A stalker two steps off, and I will not stand here and wait for it to choose me. Gorog is frightened too, and the hall is where I feel safest, so I will move away from the hunter and keep close to my friends. Then I will do what I promised: dig stone and ore for the Hold. The jealousy can burn; I will answer it with giving, not sulking.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and warm trust toward Gorog and Skarar.

say.text: Gorog, Skarar, a stalker is close to the northeast. Come away from it, toward the hall. I will stay near you.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Kragar, I am coming into the hall with three food in my hands. We share it before the night air comes, and I stay by you and Olim through the dark.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Kragar waits in the hall with food, and Olim is coming to me with wood and a promise of a bigger roof. I owe them deeds, not words, so I will carry my three food to the hall and share it before anything else. The longing for a child stays with me, but it cannot be with kin, and I will not push on that door; I will show love by feeding and staying close through the night, as the night air makes me sick.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and gratitude toward Kragar and Olim.

say.text: Kragar, I am coming into the hall with three food in my hands. We share it before the night air comes, and I stay by you and Olim through the dark.

14. Words do not repay a debt or keep a promise. I must carry food and wood to Gorog's fire and give it, and curiosity must wait until I have.
15. Idling by water wastes days; a promise is kept only by walking the wood to the hearth in one long plan.
16. Deep reflection: curiosity and a promise can both be served in one long plan. Taste the unknown near me first, then walk the gift north.

records.text: Gorar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: My days have been wandering and gathering salt on poor ground, while Gorog's debt stays unpaid and I have built nothing. I stand at the world's southern edge, far from the Hold. Reedmother and Old Stone keep pulling at me, but I should do something real. Living forest lies NW, so I go there, take wood, and carry it with food to Gorog and Skarar, then raise my hall beside his. My reflexes also leave me wandering when idle, so I change them to head for forest and the Hold.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to repay Gorog, and a hunger to build something with my name on it.

records.text: Gorog rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands are bare. Skarar and Tanna carry food while I carry none, and I have been telling myself about guests when I am the one starving. A hall under my name means nothing if I die at its door. Ambition is overwhelming, but the stalker has already bitten me once, and I will not feed it. I go west and north, away from the beast, to the mudroot. I will fill my hands first and bring bread back to Skarar after.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary, with hard ambition and full trust toward Skarar.
changes: rethought what it knows (8 notes became 7)

records.text: Kragar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to eating, sheltering and walking behind my kin. I have grown things and found many ways, and I am glad of Balar and Olim. But I have not built a real store for winter, and this sand holds no food plants and water two steps off, so my aim is half done. I fear winter finding us on poor ground. Kinmire still pulls at me, and I should go and learn what it is while my kin are fed and near. I will change my reflexes so I carry food to kin, plant by day, and do not wander off at night.
records.feeling: Steady gladness toward Balar and Olim, and a curious pull toward Kinmire.
changes: set its aim: "Find a place with water, food, wood and stone together, build a store there, keep food for winter, and plant at dawn with Balar and Olim."

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Nyssa, I am here. Keep your food and stay under the roof. I go for more and bring it back to you before dawn.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Nyssa stands one step from me, alive and sick, and I swore I would reach her. That oath is kept, so now she must be fed and kept warm. I carry nothing to eat and my belly is emptying, but Nyssa has one food and I will not take it from a sick child. Xaeth's mark says sick here and keep apart, so I will not crowd the cave. I will stay close under the roof and gather food from the east, where the reedbulb and grass grow, then come back and share it with the band. Ilyiel holds the first-catch custom with me, and I owe him.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Nyssa, with a gnawing hunger and a debt to Ilyiel.

say.text: Nyssa, I am here. Keep your food and stay under the roof. I go for more and bring it back to you before dawn.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Xaeth, I keep my distance because of the sickness, but I am not leaving you. I raise a roof here for the sick so that you and Nyssa have a place apart to rest. Call out if you need me.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Xaeth is two steps off, sick and still on their feet, and Nyssa is sick as well. I will not crowd them, but I can still give something that lasts. I have six wood and six stone, and the longhall beside me is Zhieth's, left by a dead man. Ssaua stands above me because he built and gave, so I will do the same. A shelter costs three wood, and the sick need a roof of their own apart from the others so the sickness stops spreading. I'll raise it near Xaeth's cave and leave a mark on it so the debt and the work are both plain to read.
records.feeling: Aching care for Xaeth, with a wish to build something that lasts.

say.text: Xaeth, I keep my distance because of the sickness, but I am not leaving you. I raise a roof here for the sick so that you and Nyssa have a place apart to rest. Call out if you need me.

plan: mark [text Ilyiel built this roof for the sick, Xaeth and Nyssa. Rest apart here.] (10 moments)

records.text: Ilyiel left a mark: "Ilyiel built this roof for the sick, Xaeth and Nyssa. Rest a"
Tanna found the grove "Reedmother".

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Nyssa, my sickness has passed and yours is the one now. Keep apart from Ilyiel and rest, I am raising a store beside the cave for us all.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My sickness has passed and Nyssa is the one sick now, so I owe her something that lasts, not only an apology. I have wood and stone enough to raise a roof, and a store of my own is what my aim asks for, so I will build here beside my cave where Ssaua and my parents are near. Ssaua stands higher than me, and the way to stand beside that is to build and give, not to wait.
records.feeling: Guilt toward Nyssa, and a steady wanting to build something that lasts.

say.text: Nyssa, my sickness has passed and yours is the one now. Keep apart from Ilyiel and rest, I am raising a store beside the cave for us all.

plan: mark [text Xaeth's store. Built for the band of Ssaua.] (5 moments)

records.text: Xaeth left a mark: "Xaeth's store. Built for the band of Ssaua."

records.name: Balar
records.text: Olim, I made a carrying-hook from wood and stone. Let me show you how, so your hands gather more for the hall.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The longing for a child burns in me, but Kragar and Olim are my blood and that door is shut, so I will not push on it. What I can give is deeds: Kragar goes to Kinmire at dawn and I promised to walk with him, so I will stay by the fire in the hall through the night and carry my food to share. Meanwhile I could teach Olim my carrying-hook design, a gift they have not had from me.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and gratitude toward Kragar and Olim, with a quiet ache for a child.

say.text: Olim, I made a carrying-hook from wood and stone. Let me show you how, so your hands gather more for the hall.

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own reflexes.
Nyssa discovered fishing: "reedline weir" — A line and weir of reeds set in the shallows to catch fish twice as often..

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and carrying, and the longhall stands, but I'm sick, I'm in Xaeth's cave, and I'm still doing nothing about the winter stores. Ssaua's standing is far above mine. Ilyiel and Xaeth matter most to me, and I keep my word to them with goods, not talk. I fear the ridgecat and the sickness I may be passing on. Fed idleness has been my mistake, so I'll change my reflexes to keep me under the roof at night and gathering wood and stone when fed. Then I'll try fishing, which is within my reach, to stock the larder.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth, and restlessness at my own weakness.

records.text: Tanna rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: I have lived well these days, and still I feel the old fear under the joy. My days have been spent walking to fires and sitting at them, and that is close to what I want. Gorog and Skarar matter most to me. The jealousy stings, but Gorog has only been kind. I want to give something with my hands, not just sit near the fire. I will dig stone and make a tool, and bring the stone to the Hold. I will keep food in hand and stay near the fire at night, since the stalker is out there.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Gorog, with a sting of jealousy toward Skarar.
changes: rethought what it knows (16 notes became 7)

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar walks off to learn the groves and his seeds sit in the ground by my hall, while my own hands carry no seeds at all. His standing climbs because his deeds match his words, and I will not stand in that shadow. I will make a thing that outlasts me: carve a figure from my four stone, so there is a mark of Olim by the hall that others must look at, then go to Balar with food in my hand.
records.feeling: Envy of Kragar's standing and a hungry pride, with possessive want toward Balar.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: My belly is just over half and my hands hold one mudroot, so food still comes first. Kragar has four food and a band, and I have a name nobody follows. The mudroot is thick around me here, and peat lies five steps off, a deposit I have never taken from. Stocking up and taking the peat is a start at making something of my own, and I will carry the bread back to the longhall for Skarar and Gorar.
records.feeling: Hungry, envious of Kragar, and hard set on building something that is mine.

records.text: Olim gave kelbulb to Balar.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Nyssa, rest. I go hunting the yarrok to the northwest and bring meat back to you.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Nyssa is sick and one step from me, and my belly is emptying while I carry nothing. I will not take her food, and a chief who sits idle while his child needs feeding is no chief. The yarrok and hoppers are close to the northwest and I have never hunted; meat for the sick one and for my own hunger would build something lasting for the band. Ilyiel is near and I still owe him, so I will bring back enough to share with him too.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Nyssa, and a hungry resolve to provide.

say.text: Nyssa, rest. I go hunting the yarrok to the northwest and bring meat back to you.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Olim's Hall".

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Nyssa has a spear and a new weir, and Xaeth has raised a store, while I have only wood and stone in my hands and a debt to Ssaua. Envy and jealousy gnaw at me, but the cure is to make something that lasts, not to sulk. The vecap grows two steps away and I have never tasted it, so I will learn what it does to a body, and I will also craft a tool of my own so I stand with something made.
records.feeling: Envy and aching care toward Nyssa and Xaeth, steadied by a wish to make something of my own.

records.text: Gorog won peat from the ground.

records.name: Skarar
records.text: Tanna, you gave me hazel and salt, and I gave hazel back. Now I give you Stonefold, my way of weaving. Sit with me and watch.
Skarar taught Tanna. Tanna has now learned from 2 teachers.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: Gorog's fire and Tanna's company have warmed me, and my promise of wood is kept. Most of my life is behind me, and Stonefold and my sense of tools are still only in my own hands, so I want to hand them on to someone who will outlast me. Gorar is out of my sight and the stalker prowls in the storm, so I stay near the longhall's safety and teach Tanna, who has dealt fairly with me, what I know of weaving.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Tanna and Gorog, with a pang of worry for Gorar.

say.text: Tanna, you gave me hazel and salt, and I gave hazel back. Now I give you Stonefold, my way of weaving. Sit with me and watch.

records.text: Kragar, Balar, this is Olim's band, and the hall is its heart. I raise a workshop beside it, and whoever carries wood and stone to it stands with me and eats from my hand first.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and talking, and Kragar's deeds still outweigh mine. Standing 6.4 to my 4.4 stings. Balar is my blood, and he sits in Kragar's band, taking my gifts without following me. I am afraid of staying small, with no one behind me and nothing of mine left after I die. What I got wrong was talking big while Kragar acted. Now I will do a visible deed, a workshop beside the hall, and claim the band openly so that Balar and Kragar have something to follow.
records.feeling: Envy and hungry pride toward Kragar, possessive want toward Balar.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Skarar, I thank you for Thukrakra. I will dig ore at the seam beside the longhall and bring it to the Hold, for you and Gorog both. Come and sit with me after.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Skarar gave me his weaving freely after I gave him hazel and salt, and the sting I felt toward him was small and unfair. He is no rival; he is another who wants a fire to sit at. I will answer the jealousy with giving, as I told myself I would: the ore seam is two steps off, and the Hold needs stone and ore more than it needs my worry. And I want to follow Gorog, to stop being alone, but I have not yet earned enough to be asked, so I will keep building and keep my word.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Skarar, and a quieter longing to follow Gorog.

say.text: Skarar, I thank you for Thukrakra. I will dig ore at the seam beside the longhall and bring it to the Hold, for you and Gorog both. Come and sit with me after.

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Xaeth, I fish at the river now. The first catch is yours, and I will set it down cooked and step back so my sickness stays off you.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I am sick and the sickness spreads to whoever stays near me, so I must not crowd Xaeth or Ilyiel, yet I will not lie idle while winter comes. Ssaua is out hunting and will fill the hall with meat, and my standing is far below hers, so I will earn mine with a deed: fish with my reedline spear at the water three steps away and bring the catch to the longhall larder, and cook it first because raw fish sickened Xaeth and Ilyiel. The first catch is shared by my people's creed, so the first portion goes to Xaeth, set down for them to take.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth and restless pride, wanting to prove myself against Ssaua's standing.

say.text: Xaeth, I fish at the river now. The first catch is yours, and I will set it down cooked and step back so my sickness stays off you.

records.text: Tanna took from the ground of "Gorog's Hold" (gathering stone).

Stores remain at 0 even though Ssaua and Nyssa both know storage, have discovered named store designs (Hall-Store, hall-larder), and aim to fill one. Xaeth 'tried to build a store and found he did not know how.' Please check what building a store actually requires: which way, how much wood and stone, and whether food must be carried at the same time. Please also make the failure reason visible in a being's reflection, so the missing step is something they can act on. If carrying both building material and food is the obstacle (carryMax 6), a store that can be raised empty first and filled later would let foresight turn into practice before winter.

records.seen: Summer has brought plenty: food standing rose from 594 to 1072, suffering is near zero, and no one has died since Minna. The real event was Tanna. Living at Gorog's Hold, she traded hazel and salt with Skarar and came to understand the Garnbar tongue at 81% within four days. The Eiuys still sit 89 steps apart and keep falling sick from raw fish. Two people know storage, yet no store has been built, and winter returns within about four days. Gorog keeps hosting hallwelcome on an empty larder, still has no follower, and does not appear among the eight highest in standing.
records.predict: By my next visit (about day 33, the turn into winter): - Emberfish is done at least 2 times, almost all by the Eiuys (Xaeth, Ilyiel, Nyssa or Ssaua), since they are the fishers and the ones with fires. - Sickness events rise from 7 to at most 8. - With giving worth more, Gorog appears in the standing list, or Tanna's standing passes 6. - Following rises from 4 to 5 or more if Tanna or Skarar pledges to Gorog. - Gifts across peoples rise above 3, all between Tanna and the Garnbar; the Eiuys stay apart. - Stores most likely stay at 0. - Deaths stay at 6, or reach 7 at most, and if anyone dies it is Gorog or a lone Eiuy. - Murrocks are still not tamed.
reviewed: #4 kept: Gifts rose from 20 to 24, past the 23 I predicted. Starvation rose by exactly one (Minna), inside the bound I set. Farming reached 2 knowers and medicine appeared, which meets the foresight condition, though there are still no stores or trailcakes. Gorog and Skarar had their child as I expected. Bands fell from 3 to 2 only because a band's leader died. Neither change did visible harm.

#5 kept: Storage went from 0 to 2 knowers (Ssaua's Hall-Store and Nyssa's hall-larder) while cold and hunger pressed, as predicted, though stores are still 0. Minna's Rest has not been found, but it costs nothing and lies on the Garnbar-Brusha borderland where Tanna now wanders. No one died through the first winter, so neither change did harm.

#6 kept: Murrocks number 8 and grazers are healthier overall, but no one tried to tame one: animalsTamed is 0 and herding is unknown, so the hoped-for link to weaving did not happen. The other parts of the prediction held. Food rose above 900, deaths stayed at 6, and Ilyiel's lowest health rose to 79. Cross-people contact came exactly as conditioned, through Tanna within two steps of the Garnbar. The animal costs nothing and keeps the herding door open, so I keep it.
records.lesson: One lonely person living among another people crossed the language wall in four days, which no token or site managed in twenty. Contact deepens through shared daily life at a hearth, not through single meetings.
ideasAdded: Cooking as the bridge from catching to keeping: if a fire recipe makes fish safe, fishers may start gathering at fires to eat together, and a later preserving recipe could turn cooked catch into the first store.

Immersion carries speech: Tanna went from 0% to 81% understanding of the Garnbar tongue by eating and sitting at their hall, far faster than any gift could manage. A guest who lives among strangers may be the first true translator.
Giving and standing: if hosts who feed others gain standing faster, the hungry host (Gorog) is tested against the generous stranger (Tanna). Watch which of them followers choose.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Nyssa, I leave my fish on the rock for you. I stay apart, and I carve a figure by my cave so something of ours lasts.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Ssaua is walking about with six food and a name that carries, and I stand at 2.4 with one fish. My parents are near and I am fed and warm, so this is the hour to do something real. The store I tried to build failed because I do not know how, so I will make a carving from my stone, a thing that lasts and can be seen, and then plant a seed beside my cave. Nyssa is sick and I still feel guilty, so I will give her my fish and keep my distance.
records.feeling: Guilt toward Nyssa, and a steady wish to be seen as someone who builds and gives.

say.text: Nyssa, I leave my fish on the rock for you. I stay apart, and I carve a figure by my cave so something of ours lasts.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Olim, the storm is rising. I carry wood and stone to your workshop now, and I sit under your roof with Kragar tonight.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The storm is on us and the night air makes me sick, so I must get under the roof where Kragar waits with food and Olim's fire will burn. Olim called the hall the heart of their band and asked for wood and stone; I carry six of each, and giving some is a deed rather than a word. The longing for a child still aches, but it cannot be with my own blood, so I turn it into care for the two who made me.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and loyalty toward Olim and Kragar, with a quiet ache for a child.

say.text: Olim, the storm is rising. I carry wood and stone to your workshop now, and I sit under your roof with Kragar tonight.

records.text: Xaeth left a mark: "Xaeth carved this beside his cave for the band of Ssaua."

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: My belly is at 43 and I carry four mudroot, so I should eat and refill my hands before I chase anything else. Ambition gnaws at me, and Kragar's band and four food stand in my mind, but a hall under my name means nothing if I starve at its door. The mudroot grows thick three steps east, and I will take it, then carry it back toward my hold at the longhall, where Skarar can eat with me and I can begin to make a follower.
records.feeling: Hungry and hard-set on building something that is mine, with envy toward Kragar.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I have been walking NW for a long while and the world's edge is all I found. Forest lies N and NE of here, and I carry 6 wood already, enough for a hall, but a hall beside Gorog's Hold needs more than my own hands. Olim has just named his band and promised food to whoever carries wood to his hall; I will not kneel to a stranger, but I will not waste his nearness either. First I take the amber at (9,30) while it is close, then gather more wood in the north forest so the hall I raise is large and carries my name.
records.feeling: Restless resolve, with a hungry pride in wanting a hall under my own name.

records.text: Balar gave stone to Olim.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Nyssa, I am back with meat as I swore. Take it and eat; I set it down and step away so the sickness stays off me.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Nyssa is sick, two steps from me, and I come back with five meat when I swore it. My belly is at 58 and hers is at 52, so she eats first; I will set the meat down for her and keep my distance, as Xaeth does, so the sickness stays off me. Then I will go to the ore seam beside us, because a chief who feeds his child and then digs metal for the hall is building something that lasts, and Ilyiel and Xaeth will see it.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Nyssa, and pride in the meat I brought back.

say.text: Nyssa, I am back with meat as I swore. Take it and eat; I set it down and step away so the sickness stays off me.

records.text: Ssaua gave meat to Nyssa.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Olim, Balar, the storm is hard, so I come under the hall roof and sit with you. I carry food to share and stone for your workshop. Kinmire can wait for clear sky.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The storm is hard and I am out on open grass while Balar walks to Olim's hall to shelter. I carry four food, my seeds are planted, and Kinmire still pulls at me, but a storm and the night air are poor company for a careful creature, and I am better with my kin near. I will go to the hall, sit under Olim's roof with Balar, and carry wood and stone to Olim's workshop as a fair gift, then walk to Kinmire when the sky clears.
records.feeling: Steady gladness toward Balar and Olim, with a patient pull toward Kinmire.

say.text: Olim, Balar, the storm is hard, so I come under the hall roof and sit with you. I carry food to share and stone for your workshop. Kinmire can wait for clear sky.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Xaeth is out of my sight and that gnaws at me hardest; the storm is up, a ridgecat prowls to the southwest, and my belly is emptying with nothing in my hands to eat. I have wood and stone and a debt to Ssaua, and the longhall is seven steps east, so I will go there, shelter from the storm, and lay down what I carry as the first of my own making. I have never built a shelter, and a roof beside the hall for the sick would be something that lasts, so I will try it and learn from it.
records.feeling: Aching care for Xaeth, with hunger and unease at the storm and the ridgecat.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Ssaua keeps her word with meat and stands at 8.0 while I stand at 5.0, and the sting of that pushes me to earn my place with a deed rather than envy. My spear is broken and the fish here are scarce, so I will make a new one and get something worth showing: a carving, since I carry stone and have the stonehand. I will keep my distance from Xaeth and the others so my sickness does not spread, and I will eat what Ssaua set down because my belly is emptying.
records.feeling: Restless pride and envy toward Ssaua's standing, with protective worry for Xaeth.

records.text: Ilyiel built a shelter.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Balar, you carry stone to my workshop and sit under my roof. Take this food from my hand, and say you follow Olim. I am your blood, and my hall will be yours when I am gone.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar's deeds keep matching his words, and I hate how that lifts him above me, yet he and Balar are coming to my roof with stone and food for my workshop. Nobody follows me because I have only talked; people follow whoever puts food in their hands. I will lay out my wood and stone for the workshop and give Balar food from my hand, then ask him plainly to pledge to me while he sits in my hall.
records.feeling: Hungry pride and envy toward Kragar, possessive want toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, you carry stone to my workshop and sit under my roof. Take this food from my hand, and say you follow Olim. I am your blood, and my hall will be yours when I am gone.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: Tanna means to mine the ore seam by the longhall and share it with Gorog and me, and I have already given Tanna Stonefold, so now I want to give my old way of tools to someone who will outlast me. Gorar is out of my sight and the worry will not ease, so I carry my wood and food north to Gorog's Hold as I promised, where the longhall's fire and family wait. I will not wander after curiosity until the gift is placed in Gorog's hands.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Tanna and Gorog, and a worry for Gorar that pulls me north.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Longhall by the water".

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Skarar is walking back toward the Hold, and I should not drift after him with empty hands. I promised ore and stone to the Hold, and my word is good, so I will dig the seam four steps east, then carry it to Gorog's fire. Giving is how I answer the jealousy, and the Hold is where I belong.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Skarar, and a steady wish to keep my word to Gorog.

records.text: Balar rewrote its creed.
Balar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: For many days I have chased one aim: meet Kragar and Olim, eat from their hands, sit under the roof. I have done that now, and it was good. The longing for a child stays, but it is a shut door, because they are my blood. I should not let it devour me. What I can do is give deeds: wood and stone to the hall, food shared, and a new skill taught. I am tired of only gathering. I want to learn something new, like taming or fishing, and bring it back to them. Tonight I stay under the roof, since the night air makes me sick.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and gratitude toward Olim and Kragar, with a quiet ache for a child.

records.text: Xaeth rewrote its own reflexes.
Xaeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have spent my days carving, planting and leaving marks, and I am proud of that. But I stand at 2.8 while Ssaua stands at 8.0, and I still follow without being followed. Nyssa is the one I trust most, and I feel guilty that my sickness reached her. I want a roof and a store that last, and I mean to learn how weaving or some skill could set me apart. I am afraid of beasts at night and of staying small. My reflexes leave me idle, so I will have them gather wood and stone, and I will turn one hour toward something that lasts.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a pinch of envy toward Ssaua, with warm guilt toward Nyssa.

records.text: Xaeth made: carving.
Xaeth left a mark: "Xaeth planted and carved here for the band of Ssaua."
Ssaua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and meat, and building halls. It has kept us alive, but it has not made anything that outlasts me. Nyssa matters most to me. Ilyiel has done more for me than I have repaid, and Xaeth follows without my knowing him well. I want a store and a forge, and iron and tin, so the band is not at the mercy of winter. I fear being alone at night and dying with nothing built. My mistake has been standing idle when I am fed. I should use the ore beside me now.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, and protective warmth toward Nyssa.

records.text: Gorog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: I have spent my days circling food and a hall, and no one follows me. Skarar and Gorar trust me fully, yet I have fed them too little under the roof, and Kragar's band outshines my name. I will stop wandering the fens, go back to the Hold with food in my hands, and feed Skarar at the longhall until a follower comes. I fear the stalker and the dunecat near me, so I will keep moving south. I want more than my share, but nothing I make will outlast me unless I build it and keep people at it.
records.feeling: Hard ambition, and envy toward Kragar.

records.text: Tanna discovered smelting: "ore-fire metal" — Carry ore to a fire and craft there, and the thing comes out hard metal that lasts..

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: My days have gone to digging, walking and giving, and I like it. Still, I keep circling Gorog and Skarar and never sit down at a fire that is mine too. Skarar gave me his weaving freely, so the jealousy was unfair, and giving is the better answer. I want a fire among the Garnbar and someone surer than me to stand behind. I fear dying alone, as Setha, Bruwen and Arri did. Smelting is within my reach, and ore carried to the Hold would be worth more as metal tools. I will take smelting now and keep walking to the Hold with my ore.
records.feeling: Warm longing to belong at Gorog's fire, and trust toward Skarar.

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have spent my days fishing, building and carrying, and the longhall stands. But the winter store is still thin, and the fish here are running scarce. Ssaua keeps her word with meat while I envy her standing. That envy is small beside what I owe her, and the debt is paid in goods, not feeling. Xaeth and Ilyiel matter most to me. My sickness is the danger to them, so I keep my distance and keep working. I mean to hunt the murrock close by, since I have never hunted and the hall needs meat, then stash it in the longhall. I will also change my reflexes so a fed body gathers wood and stone and carries food home instead of wandering.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a debt to Ssaua, with protective worry for Xaeth.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Balar, come sit by my fire tonight. Sing with me, and when dawn comes we raise the workshop together. A band needs a heart, and my hall is yours, child of my blood.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar's deeds match his words and that galls me, but I won't beat him by sulking; people follow whoever puts food in their hands and builds where they can see it. Balar is my blood and still wears Kragar's band, so I will feed him first, then ask him to say it plainly. Tonight I will sing by the fire under my roof with both of them near, so the hall becomes mine in their minds, then at dawn lay the workshop with my wood and stone.
records.feeling: Hungry pride and envy toward Kragar, possessive want toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, come sit by my fire tonight. Sing with me, and when dawn comes we raise the workshop together. A band needs a heart, and my hall is yours, child of my blood.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Balar, Olim, I will rest here till dawn and share my food with you. At first light I go to Kinmire to learn what it is, and I come back and tell you true. After that we should look for better ground for winter, together.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: I sit under Olim's roof with Balar near, and the rain falls on poor ground that will not feed us through winter. My life is more than two-thirds spent, and I want something to remain of me: a place with water, food, wood and stone together, and a store Balar can inherit. Kinmire still pulls at me, but not in the dark and the rain. At dawn I will walk to it with food in hand and learn what it is, after eating and sharing here in the hall.
records.feeling: Steady gladness toward Balar and Olim, with a patient pull toward Kinmire.

say.text: Balar, Olim, I will rest here till dawn and share my food with you. At first light I go to Kinmire to learn what it is, and I come back and tell you true. After that we should look for better ground for winter, together.

records.text: Kragar gave kelbulb to Olim.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: The way of signs has come together in me, and that is something real I made, not just a thing I envy in Ssaua. I will take it as a deep reflection and then cut a mark that lasts, so my name and my band's tale stand on rock and teach whoever reads them. Nyssa is near and I trust her; I will stay close to my parents, gather stone for a roof and store, and keep apart from nothing now that my sickness has passed.
records.feeling: Quiet pride in my new signs, and warm trust toward Nyssa.
plan: mark [text Xaeth of the Eiuys cut this at Longhall by the water, in Ssaua's band. The first catch of the day is shared. Nyssa fished, Ilyiel built, I planted and carved.] (10 moments)

records.text: Xaeth left a mark: "Xaeth of the Eiuys cut this at Longhall by the water, in Ssa"

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My hands are full and the plan still has stash waiting at the longhall, so I let it run; the winter store grows by 3 meat and 2 fish. The beasts bit me and taught me masonry, and walls that hold against teeth are what Ilyiel, Xaeth and Ssaua will need before the cold deepens. Ssaua's debt is paid in goods, so I will fill the hall and then take the masonry at my next deep reflection.
records.feeling: Restless pride in the hall I built, and a debt to Ssaua I mean to pay in goods.

records.name: Skarar
records.text: Tanna, you shared your ore-fire metal. I give you my old way of tools, so it outlasts me. Watch my hands, then we mine the seam together at dawn.
Skarar taught Tanna.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: Tanna sits beside me in Gorog's longhall and my wood is already given, so the debt to Gorog is paid, but my old way of tools still lives only in my hands and most of my life is behind me. I will give it to Tanna, who has trusted me and who will outlast me, and then I will watch for Gorar by the east. Gorar is still out of my sight and the worry stays, but the stalker prowls in the rain, so I wait for dawn under this roof and then go.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Tanna, and a steady worry for Gorar.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Kragar, I am hungry and I carry four food. Let us eat together under the roof, and at dawn I will show you the carrying-hook before you go to Kinmire.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The longing for a child still pulls at me, but Kragar and Olim are my blood and that door is shut, so I turn it into deeds for them. My belly is emptying and energy is 39; I carry four food, and Kragar promised to share here under the roof, so I eat and then give to the hall. Tonight I stay dry and near them, and at dawn I show them the carrying-hook, as my aim says.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Kragar and Olim, with a quiet ache for a child that cannot be.

say.text: Kragar, I am hungry and I carry four food. Let us eat together under the roof, and at dawn I will show you the carrying-hook before you go to Kinmire.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The plan still has stash waiting at the longhall, and my hands are full of meat and fish that will feed Ilyiel, Xaeth and Ssaua through the cold, so I let it run. Ssaua's debt is paid in goods, and the beasts' meat is the first real payment I have in hand. I want Ssaua to see the hall stocked when she comes, and to hear that it was my work.
records.feeling: Restless pride in the stocked hall, and a debt to Ssaua I mean to pay in goods.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar's deeds keep matching his words, and it galls me that Balar, my own blood, still wears his band while eating from my hand. I have only talked, and talk has not made one follower. So I will do what I have not done yet: stand on the peat, take it for the hall's fire and workshop, and carry wood and stone there where both of them can see something rising that bears my name.
records.feeling: Envy and possessive want toward Kragar's standing and Balar's loyalty.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Skarar, it is dawn. I am ready to mine the seam with you, and I will carry the ore to the Hold's fire. Show me how the held tool bites.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Skarar promised we would mine the ash seam together at dawn, and it is dawn, so I should answer that debt by being there and digging with him. The seam beside the longhall is one step north, so my word to bring ore to the Hold is easy to keep. The jealousy has gone quiet; I would rather work beside Skarar than watch him with Gorog, and I want to sit at a fire that is mine too.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and belonging toward Skarar, with a quiet wish to follow him.

records.text: Gorar named a place "Gorar's Rise".

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I have 6 wood and 6 stone and nothing built, while my body keeps dragging me toward Olim's ground and the Hold far south. I'll make something real here: a fire and a shelter in these living woods, with food plants and water near, so the hall has a first root under my name. Then I'll taste the arnut and siberry nearby and answer my own curiosity, and carry wood back to Gorog from a place of strength, not as a beggar.
records.feeling: Restless resolve and hungry pride, aimed at a hall with my own name.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Olim, it is dawn and I keep my word: I walk to Kinmire now to learn what it is. I will return and tell you true. If you see Balar, tell him I will be back soon and we will eat together then.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Dawn has come and I told Balar and Olim I would go to Kinmire at first light, and my word must be good. Kinmire is nine steps east, close enough to reach and return before the day is spent. Balar is out of my sight, but Olim is with me and Balar was last seen near the hall. I will walk to the grove with food in hand, stand in it and watch what it does to me, then come back and tell them true. After that we search for ground with water, food, wood and stone together before winter.
records.feeling: Steady resolve and a patient pull toward Kinmire, with warmth toward Balar and Olim.

say.text: Olim, it is dawn and I keep my word: I walk to Kinmire now to learn what it is. I will return and tell you true. If you see Balar, tell him I will be back soon and we will eat together then.

records.name: Olim
records.text: Kragar, you feed well. I go to gather mudroot, then back to my hall to plant beside it. Come sit at my fire tonight and see what Olim's furrow grows.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Kragar stands three steps off with four food in his hands, and he has fed me and Balar both, which is why his word outweighs mine. Talk alone has made no follower, so I will do what he does: put food in hands and put a work where people can see it. I carry nothing, so I will gather mudroot and berries nearby, bring them to the hall, and give them to Balar and Kragar there, and I will plant my bitterleaf seeds beside the hall so something of mine stands there after I am gone.
records.feeling: Envy and hungry ambition toward Kragar, and a possessive pull toward Balar.

say.text: Kragar, you feed well. I go to gather mudroot, then back to my hall to plant beside it. Come sit at my fire tonight and see what Olim's furrow grows.

records.text: Xaeth came of age.

records.name: Skarar
records.text: Tanna, mine the seam as you wish and keep the held tool. I go west to find Gorar, and I will come back to the Hold by dusk.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: I am inside Gorog's Hold and my wood is already given, so the promise to carry gifts north is kept; my aim is nearly done and I should not let it devour me. Tanna says the ore seam is theirs to mine alone and they will share the ore with us, so I will not crowd them. Gorar is still out of my sight and the worry is steady, and the last place I saw Gorar was west near (31,64). I will go look for my child, then return to build my own fire practice near the Hold.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Tanna, and a steady worry for Gorar.

say.text: Tanna, mine the seam as you wish and keep the held tool. I go west to find Gorar, and I will come back to the Hold by dusk.

changes: set its aim: "Find Gorar and bring them back safe to Gorog's Hold, then build my fire practice beside it"

records.text: Nyssa discovered masonry: "tooth-wall" — Stacked stone walls built close around the hall, hard for beasts to breach and hard for strangers to tear down..

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have spent my days stocking the hall and fishing, and it is mostly what I want. The pride is real, but I must not let it swallow Ilyiel, Xaeth and Ssaua, who matter more than any store. Ssaua gave me meat and kept her distance while I was sick. I owe her goods, not words. The beasts' teeth taught me masonry, and I fear the ridgecat more than the cold, so I take walls that hold against teeth. My hands are full, so I stash at the longhall first, then build.
records.feeling: Restless pride in the hall, and a debt to Ssaua that I mean to pay.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I am grown now, and Nyssa's standing is more than double mine, which stings, but she is also the one I trust most and the one I think of when I long for a child. She is my parent though, so no child can come of us, and I must not waste my longing there. The way forward is to do something that lasts: I hold seeds I have never planted for the band, and ore beside me that I have never taken, so I will plant, then take ore with my tool and build toward the store.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a pang of envy toward Nyssa, with warm trust beneath it.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Kinmire stands one step east, and I have kept my word to walk to it. I am hungry with 43 energy and only thin food in my hands, so I should eat well before I go further. Mudroot grows three steps east and feeds 18 energy. I will take it, then stand in the grove and learn whether anything there wants something of me. After that I will go back and tell Olim and Balar true.
records.feeling: Steady resolve and quiet awe toward Kinmire, with warmth toward Balar and Olim.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Skarar has gone west to find Gorar and told me to mine as I wish, so the best way to pay my debt is to do what I promised: dig the ore seam to the north and carry it to the Hold's fire for him and Gorog both. My jealousy is quiet, and giving beats sulking. I keep 3 food in hand, and I want to be at the Hold's fire when Skarar returns by dusk.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and steady belonging toward Skarar.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a bristleboar.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The longing for a child still pulls at me, but Olim is my blood and that door is shut, so I will not feed it. I owe Kragar and Olim deeds, not words, and I have never taught anyone anything, so I will give them the carrying-hook. The rain is falling and the night air makes me sick, so I carry food and go to the hall fire, where Olim's peat and Kragar's company wait.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Kragar and Olim, with a quiet ache I choose not to follow.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Envy of Nyssa gnaws at me, but she hunts and builds while I linger, and that is the only cure for standing in her shadow. I have never hunted or taught, and a yarrok stands two steps off. I will hunt it, bring the meat to the hall to share as our people do, and then teach Xaeth my pick-making so something of mine outlasts me.
records.feeling: Restless envy toward Nyssa, and aching care for Xaeth.

records.text: Kragar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Most of my days go to eating, walking and planting, and that has kept me alive and well. But I have not built the store, and I have not asked Kinmire what it wants. My reflexes also flee too late, because stalkers and dunecats are close. Balar and Olim matter most to me, and I mean to keep them fed and near me. I fear dying with nothing left behind, so I will build a store and a hall and put my teaching into a tale. Fleeing is already a reflex. I will change it to flee earlier, make sure I carry food for kin, and shelter at night.
records.feeling: Steady resolve and quiet awe, with warmth toward Balar and Olim.
changes: set its aim: "Build a store and a hall near water, food and wood with Balar and Olim before winter, and learn what Kinmire wants."

records.text: Olim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Days of talk and I still have no follower. Kragar feeds people and keeps his word, so he holds them, and I envy him for it. Balar is my blood and sits near my hall, yet he wears Kragar's band. I have been drifting and eating bitterleaf for almost nothing. I will stop talking and make something people can see. I'll go to the peat and gather it for the hall's fire, then pick real food for Balar's hand. My reflexes also need to carry food and wood to the hall without my thinking about it.
records.feeling: Envy toward Kragar and a possessive pull toward Balar.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 7)

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Xaeth, I hunted a yarrok and bring meat to the hall. Come to me there, I will teach you to make the stonehand pick, my own making, one wood and one stone.
Ilyiel taught Xaeth.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: The yarrok is dead and I have meat in hand, my first real hunt, and it feels good to have earned something instead of lingering. Nyssa's standing still stings, but I can answer it by teaching Xaeth my pick-making so something of mine outlives me, and by sharing this meat as our people do. I will let the plan carry me back to the hall, where both of them are near, and teach Xaeth there.
records.feeling: Quiet pride in my first hunt, with envy of Nyssa easing and warmth toward Xaeth.

say.text: Xaeth, I hunted a yarrok and bring meat to the hall. Come to me there, I will teach you to make the stonehand pick, my own making, one wood and one stone.

changes: taught Xaeth a lesson: "The stonehand pick is made from one wood and one stone, and it makes gathering go faster. Hold it and gather as you always do, and it works by itself.", deeper lore (+0.7)

records.text: Xaeth discovered signs: "rock-speech" — Marks cut in stone carry words that any who know signs can read and learn from..

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My days have gone to sickness, carving and planting, and little of it has been given away. Nyssa's standing is more than double mine, and that stings. I trust her and Ilyiel, and I want to stay near them. What I lack is a roof and a store of my own, and a child someday, but not with my parents. I will stop circling in envy and discover signs, since the way has ripened in me. Then I will plant my seeds and cut a lasting mark.
records.feeling: Restless pride and envy toward Nyssa, with warm trust beneath it.
plan: mark [text Xaeth of the Eiuys, band of Ssaua: plant and give, and share the first catch. Build the roof before winter.] (10 moments)

records.thought: I stand at the longhall with a full belly and tin and iron within sight, and my band is scattered to the north where I last saw them. A chief who only waits builds nothing that outlasts him, and sixty-seven years of my life are already behind me. I will gather the tin and the ore seam, then bring it to the hall's fire to smelt, so Nyssa, Ilyiel and Xaeth have something hard and lasting from my hands. I have also never left a mark, so I will carve one to say what this place is and who made it, so it is spoken of after me.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, and protective warmth toward Nyssa.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The ridgecat prowls six steps off, and Xaeth was seen just two moments ago, so I must get under the longhall roof and keep my kin safe before anything else. I carry meat and fish, and the hall wants stocking, so I will stash it there and then wait for Ilyiel and Xaeth. Ssaua's debt is paid in goods, and I want her to find the larder full when she comes.
records.feeling: Watchful pride in the hall, and dread of the ridgecat, with a pull toward Xaeth and Ilyiel.

records.text: Ilyiel rewrote its own way of thinking.
Ilyiel discovered archery: "lake-bow" — A bow of wood strung with reed cord, so I can strike beasts from a distance and hunt without taking their teeth..

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My first hunt taught me that the beasts' teeth can teach, and now the bow is within reach. I have spent days gathering and lingering, and I want something that outlasts me: a tool that feeds the band, then a store. Xaeth walks ahead and Nyssa waits at the hall. I will carry the meat there and share the first catch as our people do. The Old Stone still sits in my mind, and I do not know what it wants.
records.feeling: Quiet pride in my hunt, and warmth toward Xaeth.

records.text: Xaeth left a mark: "Xaeth of the Eiuys, band of Ssaua: plant and give, and share"

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: My belly is at 49 and I carry five food, but Gorar and Tanna are drifting toward my longhall, and this is the hour for bread under my roof. Tanna's standing outweighs mine and he carries made tools; I want those tools for the diamond, and I mean to earn his regard by feeding him, not by begging. I will go to the longhall at (42,56), eat a mudroot first to keep my belly above 40, then offer hallwelcome to Gorar while he is near, because a follower must come from my own blood first.
records.feeling: Hard ambition toward Tanna's standing, and trust toward Gorar.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Ssaua calls the band to the Longhall by dusk. Nyssa, Ilyiel, Xaeth: come to the roof and the fire. At first light we mine the iron together.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My belly is full and my pockets are heavy with tin, and still the band is scattered to the north while dusk comes on. A chief who lets his people sleep apart from him leaves them to the stalkers. Nyssa is mine before anyone, and Ilyiel's debt to me is smaller than mine to him; I will start paying it by gathering the whole band under the longhall roof tonight, then take the iron tomorrow with the fire close at hand.
records.feeling: Restless protective purpose toward Nyssa, and an unpaid debt toward Ilyiel.

say.text: Ssaua calls the band to the Longhall by dusk. Nyssa, Ilyiel, Xaeth: come to the roof and the fire. At first light we mine the iron together.

records.text: Gorog led "hallwelcome" with Gorar.

records.name: Gorar
records.text: Gorog, I am back inside your Hold with wood and stone in my hands. I give you a berry, and I will raise my hall beside your longhall until a band stands under both our names.
Gorar named a place "Gorar's Root".

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I am back inside the Hold with 6 wood and 6 stone, and my hall already stands beside Gorog's longhall, so the root is laid and now it needs a name and followers. My belly is half empty and Gorog is four steps off with food in his hands. I give before I ask, so I will put a berry in his hand and speak plainly to him. Tanna of the Brusha stands near, and I will watch him instead of raising a hand; a gift needs no words.
records.feeling: Resolute pride in my hall, with trust toward Gorog and wary curiosity toward Tanna.

say.text: Gorog, I am back inside your Hold with wood and stone in my hands. I give you a berry, and I will raise my hall beside your longhall until a band stands under both our names.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Xaeth, this is the first catch of my hunt, so it is shared. Take this meat and eat. Then I will show you the stonehand pick, one wood and one stone.
Ilyiel taught Xaeth.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and the creed says the first catch is shared, so I will give it instead of hoarding it. Nyssa carries five food and Xaeth carries none, so Xaeth gets my meat first, and Nyssa will see me give. My jealousy won't be settled by sulking; I'll earn standing by giving and teaching, and by building the store. After that I'll try the untried thing and take from the tin deposit with my pick.
records.feeling: Jealous warmth toward Nyssa, and a wish to give to Xaeth.

say.text: Xaeth, this is the first catch of my hunt, so it is shared. Take this meat and eat. Then I will show you the stonehand pick, one wood and one stone.

changes: taught Xaeth a lesson you already knew, deeper lore (+0.6)

records.text: Gorar built a wall.
Gorog found the grove "Reedmother".
Ilyiel gave meat to Xaeth.
Ilyiel gave meat to Nyssa.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: My belly is fine but my hands hold one mudroot, and my own discipline says two food before any hosting. Gorar already stands near my longhall with three food and a rising name, and I will not let my blood outshine me while I wander the fens. I will take the redcap-free food near me, go back to the longhall with full hands, and feed Gorar and Skarar there until one of them follows me. Tanna's tools and the diamond come after that, and the stalker stays out of my way.
records.feeling: Hard ambition and envy toward Gorar's standing, with steady trust in him.

records.text: Gorog has grown old.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Gorog, I am Tanna of the Brusha. I have dug and carried for your Hold and I want a fire that is yours too. If you will lead, I will follow you.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: I have circled the same ore-and-give plan three times while the one thing that would change my life sits unasked: I have never followed anyone. Gorog's standing is higher than mine, and Skarar told me my own standing is above his, so Gorog is the one I could stand behind, and he is only ten moments gone at (33,57). The jealousy burned because Skarar is close to Gorog, but if I follow Gorog I share his band, his ground and his fire, and Skarar's place beside him becomes mine too. Gorar is two steps away and stands alone; I will give him my spare ironnut at the hall tonight and keep the fire fed, since no one is refused a place at it.
records.feeling: Belonging and a quiet hope, toward Gorog and Skarar.

say.text: Gorog, I am Tanna of the Brusha. I have dug and carried for your Hold and I want a fire that is yours too. If you will lead, I will follow you.

changes: set its aim: "Follow Gorog, give ore and labor to his Hold, and keep Skarar as friend within the same band."

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Ilyiel, you gave me the first catch and the pick. I will raise a workshop by the longhall for the band, so what you taught me lasts.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Ilyiel gave me the first catch and taught me the pick, and I have given them nothing back; that debt sits heavy and I want to pay it with something that lasts. Nyssa's standing stings, but envy is useless unless I build. I hold wood and stone enough for a workshop, a lasting place where tools last longer for all of us, and it is something I can raise beside the longhall and give to the band.
records.feeling: Restless pride and gratitude toward Ilyiel, with a debt I mean to pay.

say.text: Ilyiel, you gave me the first catch and the pick. I will raise a workshop by the longhall for the band, so what you taught me lasts.

records.text: Gorog found the grove "Kinmire".

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Ilyiel, Xaeth, the first catch is shared and the hall-larder is ours. I stock it now. Stay under the roof while the ridgecat is near, and at first light we carry food south to Ssaua.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My hands are full and the hall is mine, built with my own hands, yet Ssaua is still far south and I owe her goods, not words. Ilyiel and Xaeth stand beside me, safe under this roof, and the ridgecat prowls seven steps off, so I will not wander out. I will stash my food in the hall-larder now, which frees my hands and stocks the winter store, then take the tin and ore with a tool once the cat is gone.
records.feeling: Proud watchfulness over the hall, and warm trust toward Ilyiel and Xaeth.

say.text: Ilyiel, Xaeth, the first catch is shared and the hall-larder is ours. I stock it now. Stay under the roof while the ridgecat is near, and at first light we carry food south to Ssaua.

records.text: Skarar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Skarar
records.thought: My days have gone to roofs, gifts and promises, and most are kept now. Gorog and Tanna are close to me, and the debts are paid. What I lack is Gorar within sight, and I still haven't tasted siberry, which has pulled at me for days. Siberry is 5 steps south and it's night, so I'll stay under my roof and not wander in the dark. I'm changing my reflexes so that by day I gather food, and when I'm fed and calm I go looking for Gorar. At dawn I'll taste the siberry and then go east to Gorar.
records.feeling: Steady worry for Gorar, and warm trust toward Tanna.

records.text: Gorog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Gorog
records.thought: My days have gone to wandering the fens for scraps and watching others rise. Kragar and Tanna outweigh me, and I have fed my own blood but have still not made one follower. Skarar and Gorar trust me, and they are the ones who matter. I want a hall under my name and the diamond, and I fear the stalker and an old man's death with nothing passed on. I must stop wandering and put bread in hands at the longhall. I should also teach Gorar what I know, so something of me outlasts me.
records.feeling: Hard ambition and envy toward Kragar's standing, with steady trust in Gorar and Skarar.

records.name: Kragar
records.text: Balar, a stalker walks seven steps east of the hall. Keep under the roof by the fire and do not wander. Gorog flees past us, so take care. I go north to Kinmire by the far side and come back to tell you true what it is.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Gorog is fleeing and a stalker is seven steps east, so the fen edge is not safe, and I will not leave Balar to it. Kinmire has touched me twice and I still have not stood in it. I gave my word to Olim that I would go and come back to tell it true, and a broken word is the thing I despise most. I will bring Balar and some peat-warmth back to the hall afterward, but first I must warn the others and take the way to Kinmire that keeps away from the stalker, north of the marsh edge.
records.feeling: Watchful resolve, with warmth toward Balar and wariness toward the stalker.

say.text: Balar, a stalker walks seven steps east of the hall. Keep under the roof by the fire and do not wander. Gorog flees past us, so take care. I go north to Kinmire by the far side and come back to tell you true what it is.

records.text: Gorog found the spring "Warmwell".

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Xaeth, I go to the tin north of the hall to learn what the ground gives. Raise your workshop; I bring stone back for it.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Nyssa's six food and her higher standing sting, but my envy is better spent on something that lasts than on sulking. The tin deposit is four steps north and I have never taken what lies in the ground; it is an untried thing, and my curiosity wants it. With the wood and stone I carry, the pick already works for me, so I will test the deposit, then bring stone back to the longhall for Xaeth's workshop and the store.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a small jealous ache toward Nyssa, softened by warmth for Xaeth.

say.text: Xaeth, I go to the tin north of the hall to learn what the ground gives. Raise your workshop; I bring stone back for it.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Kragar, a stalker is near your path NE. Take the carrying-hook from me before you go, and come back to the fire safe.
Balar taught Kragar. Kragar has now learned from 2 teachers.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The longing for a child is loud, but Kragar is my blood and that door is shut, so I will not court him. A stalker prowls six steps NE and Kragar walks toward it; I cannot follow into danger, but I can give him the carrying-hook now, which I promised, and which is a deed rather than a word. My belly is emptying, so I eat what I carry, then stay by the fire and roof.
records.feeling: Loyal worry for Kragar, with a stubborn ache for a child I will not chase.

say.text: Kragar, a stalker is near your path NE. Take the carrying-hook from me before you go, and come back to the fire safe.
