records.text: A blight struck the frostmoss: about half of them withered overnight.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: A stalker stands one step south of my shelter, and I am sick, weak and old. Running into the storm night would repeat the mistake that nearly killed me, so I stay under my roof and do not flee. Olim is wounded and sick six steps east and I want to be beside them, but I will not carry my sickness to them again as I did to Balar. When the stalker leaves and dawn comes, I will hunt meat for Olim before I feed myself, and the way of the bow is within my grasp for that hunt.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker and tender grief for Olim, whom I cannot yet help.

records.text: Kragar took from the ground of "Olim's Hall" (hunting).
A ridgecat brought down a bristleboar.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: The frostfang bit me and I am still alive, but hunger and fear are loud, and the stalker and the frostfang both hover close. The plan already carries me away from the beast, to the nareed, and into a harvest and a meal, so I will let it run and not spoil it with new words. When I have eaten I will take food to Kragar's hand, since he kept his word and I will not repeat Balar's death by speaking with empty hands.
records.feeling: Fear of the hunters and shame over Balar, with trust toward Kragar.

records.text: Ssaua has grown old.
Kragar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Balar and Gorog are dead, and I nearly followed them because my rules kept me carrying food but never gave it to kin, and fled into the night. I have spent my days gathering and fleeing when I should have kept a store and a roof ready, and I am old now with little time left. Olim is the one I trust, and I want to feed them with meat. For now I stay sheltered from the stalker. When it is gone I will hunt and fish for food, and I will not put hunger below kin the way I did before.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker and grief for Balar, with love for Olim.

records.title: Four Starved in a Day
records.text:
The record for days 34 to 37 is mostly a record of hunger. Winter ended in name only, and the plants had not come back. Four of the Garnbar died on day 36, all of starvation: Skarar, Balar, Gorog and Tanna. Seven people are alive now, ten have died in all, and every death has been from starving.

At Gorog's Hold the work of the days before had turned toward storage. Skarar, Gorog and Tanna each discovered it on days 34 and 35, and each had a store in mind beside the Hold. Gorog also discovered archery and smelting on day 34. None of them had food to put in a store. Skarar told Gorar on day 35 that he was starving and carried nothing, and Gorar gave him kelbulb from his own hand. That was not enough. Tanna spent day 35 and the morning of day 36 promising food she did not have. Gorog, Skarar and Tanna died on day 36, and the record ends the settlement of Gorog's Hold that day. Gorar is the only one left from it. He asked Tanna to fish with him and said that she and he were all that was left, but Tanna is among the dead. His aim of building a band with her cannot be carried out.

In the fens Balar fell sick from staying near Olim, and Kragar fell sick from staying near Balar. Balar starved on day 36 while Olim and Kragar were both unable to feed him. Kragar then hunted and fished for Olim on days 36 and 37. Olim is old, with health 12 and energy 22. He still has no follower, though Kragar's bond to him is strong.

The Eiuys fared better. Xaeth discovered pottery and storage and built a store on day 36. He, Ssaua and Nyssa gave fish and ironnut to Ilyiel, and no one in the longhall died. A blight took half the frostmoss on day 37.

threads.name: Gorar alone
threads.text: Gorar is the last of Gorog's Hold, at health 60 and energy 33. He is fishing and grieving, and he leads a band with no followers.

threads.name: Olim and Kragar
threads.text: Olim is old and at health 12, and Kragar is feeding him by hunting and fishing. Balar is dead, and Olim still has no follower.

threads.name: Eiuys longhall
threads.text: All four Eiuys are alive and sharing fish, with a store newly built by Xaeth. Ssaua leads and the group holds together.

threads.name: Storage learned too late
threads.text: Storage was discovered by five people in these days, but only Xaeth built a store. The Garnbar had no food to put in theirs.

threads.name: Peoples apart
threads.text: The Garnbar and Eiuys are now 77 steps apart. They have still not met, and the Garnbar are down to three.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Ilyiel, I am old and my knowledge must not die with me. Hear my Hall-Law and my delving, and then we dig the seam together and bring the ore to the hall.
Ssaua taught Ilyiel. Ilyiel has now learned from 3 teachers.
Ssaua taught Ilyiel mining ("Stonehand delving").

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Ilyiel stands one step from me and I will not poison the hall with jealousy; he kept Nyssa alive and I owe him, and pride says I act on that rather than sulk. I am old, 78% gone, and what I know dies with me unless I teach it, so Ilyiel and Xaeth should hold my fishing, my Stonehand delving and my Hall-Law before the cold takes me. Then I will dig the ore seam two steps northwest and bring ore and tin to the hall, because iron is the lasting thing I still mean to win.
records.feeling: Resolve mixed with a stinging jealousy toward Ilyiel, and a warm debt to him.

say.text: Ilyiel, I am old and my knowledge must not die with me. Hear my Hall-Law and my delving, and then we dig the seam together and bring the ore to the hall.

changes: taught Ilyiel a lesson: "Stand on the ore seam in the rock and gather; the ore is what we smelt with tin at the Hall-Flame for harder metal. Keep the first catch shared and the store s…", the way of mining, its way of thinking

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I am alone at the north edge, far from the longhall and my child, with a stalker eleven steps off and a storm overhead. That is the very mistake my own discipline forbids, and my wounds already say what it costs. Xaeth, Ilyiel and Ssaua are gathered near Xaeth's Cave, so I will go to them in daylight, carrying my fish and the ironnuts I can harvest on the way, and stock the larder before the cold deepens.
records.feeling: Wary protectiveness toward Xaeth, and a hard wish to keep my word to Ilyiel and Ssaua.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Tanna is dead, starved beside me, and my parents before her; I am the last of this hall and my belly is nearly empty. Grief will not feed me, and I mean to stay alive above all, so I put the grief aside for now and take food. The river has given me fish three times and kept me alive, so I fish again, then hunt the tusker for meat, which I have never done and which would fill me more than any plant. Once I am fed past forty I will plant my two seeds near my hall so that something of mine grows and a band can one day gather under my name.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and heavy grief for Tanna and my parents, with a hard will to live.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Ssaua, I take your delving and dig the seam beside you now. The ore goes to the hall, and the first of it is shared.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Ssaua gave me his delving and trusts me to carry it on, and I will not waste it. The ore seam is one step from where I stand and I have never taken what lies in a deposit, so I will dig it now, and then bring ore to the hall as I promised. I am old, and what I dig and build is what will outlast me and be there for Xaeth.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and pride toward Ssaua, with a keen wish to build something that lasts.

say.text: Ssaua, I take your delving and dig the seam beside you now. The ore goes to the hall, and the first of it is shared.

records.text: Xaeth rewrote its own reflexes.
Xaeth discovered farming: "band-keep sowing" — I sow seeds beside the hall and tend them each day, so harvest never kills the plant and the band always has food..

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My days have gone to fishing, hunger and fetching for the band, and I have never planted a seed, though I carry several. My parents Ilyiel and Nyssa are everything to me, but I can't leave a child with them, so I must find a mate outside my blood. Farming is within reach now, and a lasting thing is what I want most. A stalker is close, so I will plant by the hall, where my people are, instead of out here alone.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a thin dread of the stalker, with warmth toward my parents.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: A frostfang stands three steps off and my belly is nearly empty, so I cannot linger here. Olim's hall is eight steps southwest, and Olim is the one I trust. I would rather be at a roof and a fire beside them than alone in the storm, even though I have no food to bring. I'll go to the hall and shelter near Olim, then gather food close by once the beast has passed. I will keep a few steps off so I do not carry my sickness to them again.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and a hungry longing to be near Olim.

records.text: Gorar fell sick after eating raw fish.
Gorar fell sick after eating raw fish.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Good, Ilyiel. The seam lies just south. We dig together, and I teach you my old way of fishing while we work, so it outlives me.
Ssaua taught Ilyiel.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Ilyiel says he digs the seam beside me, and the warm debt is real: he kept my child alive. The jealousy still stings, but I call it pride and will not act on it; a chief who teaches freely is the one others follow. I am old, so I will pass on my fishing and Hall-Law now, and dig the seam one step south so ore goes to the hall.
records.feeling: Resolve and a lingering sting of jealousy toward Ilyiel, over a debt I honor.

say.text: Good, Ilyiel. The seam lies just south. We dig together, and I teach you my old way of fishing while we work, so it outlives me.

changes: taught Ilyiel a lesson: "The old way of fishing: stand beside water with a reedline spear, and the first catch of the day is shared with the band."

records.text: A hardship or spur signal for 'the season is turning toward winter', raised in late autumn while food is still plentiful. Storage, trailcake and saltmeat are only useful if they are learned before famine. At present storage is discovered during famine, when no one has food to put away, and four people with stores in mind starved on day 36.

timesEaten appears frozen: every count was identical between day 13 and day 17, and again between day 33 and day 37, even though people fed one another fish, kelbulb and meat in these days. Without a working counter I cannot judge whether a sown plant is eaten.

records.seen: The winter of days 34 to 37 was the first true famine. Food standing fell from 1137 to 380 after two blights struck the hazel and the frostmoss, and four Garnbar starved on one day. The Garnbar are down to three: Gorar, now alone, Kragar, and Olim, who is old and at health 12. They are close to vanishing, while the four Eiuys share fish and hold the world's only store. Storage was discovered five times, but only after there was nothing left to store. The dead lie clustered at the ruins of Gorog's Hold, and no place marks them.
refused: a site needs an effect, and there can be at most 12
records.predict: By my next visit (about day 41, summer into autumn): at most 1 blight is recorded, and foodStanding climbs back above 700. Kelbulb is present across marsh and grass. Deaths reach 11 at most, and if one comes it is Olim, at health 12. Kragar and Gorar both survive, so the Garnbar number at least 2. The Eiuys stay at 4 with no deaths. Hold's Rest is found by 0 or 1 beings, and if Gorar returns to the Hold's ground he finds it. Lorekeeping is known by at least 1 being or talesHeld rises above 0, most likely through Gorar, who is pressed by loss. Following stays at 3. The Eiuys remain more than 60 steps from the Garnbar. Stores stay at 1 or reach 2, with any new store built by an Eiuy.
reviewed: #6 kept: Murrocks number 8 and grazers are healthier overall, but no one tried to tame one: animalsTamed is 0 and herding is unknown, so the hoped-for link to weaving did not happen. The other parts of the prediction held. Food rose above 900, deaths stayed at 6, and Ilyiel's lowest health rose to 79. Cross-people contact came exactly as conditioned, through Tanna within two steps of the Garnbar. The animal costs nothing and keeps the herding door open, so I keep it.

#7 kept: Emberfish was made 0 times, so that half failed. The Eiuys fish but do not cook what they catch, which matches the old lesson that an act no one chooses is not changed by offering it. It costs nothing and may matter in winter, when fish come slower. Giving at 1.3 did what I predicted for Tanna: her standing rose from 5.26 to 6.2, gifts across peoples rose from 3 to 4, sickness held at 7 and deaths held at 6. Gorog never entered the standing list and following stayed at 4. The lever rewarded the person who already gives, not the leader who carries too little to give. Keep both.

#8 kept: Works at 1.5 nudged the builders upward: Gorar's standing went from 5.38 to 5.47 and Olim's from 4.61 to 4.84. Gorog died before the lever could help him, and following fell from 4 to 3 through deaths, not through any harm from the change. Lorekeeping is still unknown and talesHeld is 0, but loss pressure on the Garnbar has only now reached 2.5, so the spur has not yet had its moment. Both changes cost nothing. My prediction failed on deaths (10, not 7 or fewer) and on stores (1, not 0). It held on emberfish, on taming and on the distance between peoples.
records.lesson: Spurring storage by famine made the knowledge arrive exactly when there was nothing to store. A way meant for foresight must be sharpened by the signs that come before the hardship, such as the first cold, and not by the hardship itself.
ideasAdded: The last of a settlement: Gorar is alone, leads a band with no followers, and has no kin left. Watch whether loneliness takes him to Kragar in the fens or carries him the long way to the Eiuys. A lone survivor joining another people would repeat Tanna's crossing of the language wall.
Graves gathered in one spot (Hold's Rest) may become the first shared memory of a disaster. If anyone who visits it later builds a store, the community will have learned from its own deaths (idea 3).
Seasons last only three days, so a year is twelve. Foresight has very little time between plenty and want, which may be why storage arrives only once food is already gone.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: Hunger and the stalker are on me, and my plan already carries me to the nareed and a meal, so I will not spoil it with new words. Balar's death is shame I carry: I spoke while he starved, and I will not bring Kragar empty hands again. Once I have eaten I take food to Kragar at the hall and bind him with it, because food in a hand is what makes a follower.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker and the hunger gnawing at me, with shame over Balar and trust toward Kragar.

records.name: Olim
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Olim, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Olim, in first person, from what Olim has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Garnbar (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." You speak the tongue of the Garnbar. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Brusha: about 3%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Dunen Heights: mountains and bare rock; stone, ore and caves, thin food, snow on the peaks.
THIS SPOT: water 3 steps away; food plants within six steps: 0; standing trees: 21; bare rock: 45; riches in the ground near: ore; a cave.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Olim truly is.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I take what I need and I do not back down. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. Others are rivals for food until they prove useful to me. I say whatever serves me; the truth is only one tool among others. I want more than my share, and I mean to have it. Others should follow me. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Tanna is dead and the river is fished thin, so the aim of fishing beside her has failed. I will not be the third to starve here. The fishing way is within my grasp now, and I mean to take it, then hunt the tusker for meat, since fish alone did not keep Tanna alive. After that I will build something under my name, perhaps a band of my own, and learn what Kinmire and Old Stone want from me.
records.feeling: Heavy grief for Tanna and my parents, and a hard will to live.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Nyssa, my belly is empty and I see your fish. Share one with me and I dig the ore seam beside us, and the first of the ore goes to the hall.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is emptying and my hands hold no food, but Nyssa sits at my feet with five fish and the first catch is shared, so I need not starve. The seam at (132,23) is one step from me and I have never taken what lies in a deposit; I will dig it now, as Ssaua taught me, and bring the ore home. When I have more than I need, I want to try taming one of the elk with my berry, because the old part of me is running short and I want something that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Warm pride and gratitude toward Ssaua, with a keen hunger to build something lasting.

say.text: Nyssa, my belly is empty and I see your fish. Share one with me and I dig the ore seam beside us, and the first of the ore goes to the hall.

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: The first catch is shared. I carry five fish to Xaeth's store for the band's winter, and no one in this band goes hungry while I hold them.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I am finally among my own, Xaeth, Ilyiel and Ssaua all within a few steps, and my body is mending. My hands are nearly full of fish while the larder waits, and the fish here are thinning, so a promise to stock the hall means carrying what I hold to Xaeth's store now, in daylight and in company, as my own rule says. Ssaua's standing outweighs mine, but standing is earned by deeds, so I will put food in the store and let it be seen.
records.feeling: Steady, wary protectiveness toward Xaeth and my band, and pride in keeping my word.

say.text: The first catch is shared. I carry five fish to Xaeth's store for the band's winter, and no one in this band goes hungry while I hold them.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: I have learned band-keep sowing. I plant my seeds on the grass southeast and the first harvest goes to the store for the band.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I carry seeds and I have just learned to sow, yet my store stands empty and the ground at my cave is bare rock. The grass to the southeast is where something can grow, so I will plant there, near the band, and let the first harvest fill my store. I also ache for a child, but Ilyiel and Nyssa are my blood, so I must find a mate outside it; Ssaua's band is too small, and that thought sits heavy in me.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a quiet longing for a mate beyond my kin.

say.text: I have learned band-keep sowing. I plant my seeds on the grass southeast and the first harvest goes to the store for the band.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the frostfang's shadow is still in my body, yet Olim lives and I trust them above all. The plan walks me to (14,51) and rests, but resting on an empty stomach is how Balar died. A kelbulb and a bitterleaf lie close by, so I will eat what the fen gives on the way, take a little with me, and reach Olim's roof carrying something to share, as my own creed demands.
records.feeling: Hunger and fear, and a hungry longing to be beside Olim.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My plan carries me south to sow the grass, and the storm is no reason to turn back. I wanted to leave something lasting, and a field near the band's roof is the first thing I have started that grows on its own. The longing for a mate stays with me, but Ilyiel is my blood, so I must meet others beyond this band. I will sow now and remember that medicine is within my grasp when I next reflect.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my first sowing, with a quiet longing for a mate beyond my kin.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My days have gone to building halls, teaching and keeping the band fed, and I want that. But I am old, 79% gone, and I stand here with one ironnut and a storm overhead. Ilyiel is closer to Nyssa than to me. I call that pride and will not act on it, because he kept my child alive and I owe him. What I fear is dying with my craft unpassed and my band hungry. I have been all talk of stocking food and doing little of it, with no farming and no taming. I will change my reflexes so my body stocks food and keeps to a roof at night, and I will teach Xaeth, then sow seeds by the hall.
records.feeling: Resolve, with a dull jealousy toward Ilyiel that I will not feed, and a fear of dying unremembered.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Tanna and both my parents starved and I am the last of this hall. I have been fishing a thinned river and chasing meat I never caught, and I am sick now from raw fish. I want a band and a roof under my name, and I have the wood and stone to raise a hall right now. The hunt is two steps away and meat is what Tanna lacked, so I finish the hunt, then build. I should stop lingering in poor ground. I also need a healing plant for the sickness, and I should not stand beside anyone while I carry it.
records.feeling: Heavy grief for Tanna and my parents, and a hard will to live and build.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My days have gone to fishing, digging and staying near Ssaua's fire. It is good, but I have mostly followed, and I have left things untried: I have never taken from a deposit, never tamed a beast, never left a lasting mark. Ssaua has given me food, teaching and trust, and I owe him goods handed over, not words. I am old, with most of my life behind me, so I want to leave something that outlasts me for Xaeth. The ore seam is one step from me, so I dig it now, then try taming the murrock with my berry before night.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Ssaua, and a hunger to build something that lasts.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have spent my days fishing, learning and sowing, and it has been good. But my belly is emptying, my pack is empty of food, and I am chasing a roof and a store while the band feeds me. Ilyiel and Nyssa are my blood and Ssaua has taught me, so I owe them gifts that last. The longing for a child cannot be met inside this band. I must go find others, and I must keep myself fed while I do it. My reflexes should carry food and take me to the band at night.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my sowing, and a gnawing want for a mate beyond my kin.

records.text: Kragar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Balar starved beside me while I hunted for myself, and I will not let that happen to Olim. My days have been the same hunt and flight, and I have built nothing that lasts. I am old, and what I know dies with me unless I teach it. Olim is the one I trust, and I want to be near them with food in my hands. My reflexes failed Balar, so I will change them: eat when energy is low, fish and hunt early, and shelter at night. Kelbulb is 2 steps south, so I eat first.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have spent my days fishing, building and hauling food, and the longhall stands because I did the work, not because I talked. But I keep drifting out alone at night in storms, and that has cost me wounds twice. My people are gathered at Xaeth's Cave, so I go there with the fish and stash it in Xaeth's store. Ilyiel asked for a fish, and she has kept her word. I give her one first, and the rest goes to the winter store. I will not roam alone again.
records.feeling: Steady protectiveness toward Xaeth, Ilyiel and Ssaua, and impatience with the cold.

records.name: Olim
records.thought: I have spent my days talking, promising and chasing a band while Balar starved with my words in his ears and nothing in his hands. Now I am old, hurt and starving, and a frostfang is three steps off. Kragar is the only one left who matters to me. He keeps his word, and I should have fed him instead of courting him with empty promises. What I want is to live, to eat first, and then to put real food in Kragar's hand at the hall. My reflexes fled the beast but wandered far from the hall, so I am changing them. Flee first. Then eat anything carried. Then take food close by. Never stand idle in a storm at night away from the roof.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Sick, cold, and storm-beaten, with my hands full of meat and no roof over me. Tanna and my parents are dead, and I will not join them; I have wood, stone and clay in my pack, so I will raise a shelter here by the water and eat before the cold takes more of me. A roof is the first stone of a hall under my name, and the gold close by can be mine to gather once my hands are free.
records.feeling: Grief and a hard will to live, aimed at the cold and the sickness that wear me down.

records.text: Gorar built a shelter.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Ilyiel, the storm keeps us under this roof, so hear my Hall-Law and Stonehand craft while we wait. At first light we dig the seam together, and the ore goes into the store.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Jealousy over Ilyiel and Nyssa still gnaws, but he kept my child alive, so I name it pride and put it down. I am old, and what I leave must be tools, followers and knowledge that others carry, not just ore in my pack. The storm is loud and the night is half spent, so I stay under the cave roof beside Ilyiel and teach him while we wait for dawn, then dig the seam at first light.
records.feeling: A dull jealousy toward Ilyiel, held down by gratitude and resolve to be remembered.

records.text: Kragar was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Ssaua, I keep your Hall-Law and your delving. I will build more for the band's store, so what you taught me stays standing after you.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Ssaua and Ilyiel stand beside me in my own cave, and the storm cannot reach us. Ssaua offered his Hall-Law and delving so they would outlive him, and I have yet to give him anything back that lasts. The want for a mate gnaws at me, but Ilyiel is my blood and no child can come of that, so I must look beyond this band. For now I will turn my pride into a gift: stone and wood are in my pack, and the band's roof and store are still thin.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a gnawing want for a mate, with trust toward Ssaua and Ilyiel.

say.text: Ssaua, I keep your Hall-Law and your delving. I will build more for the band's store, so what you taught me stays standing after you.

records.text: Xaeth made: carving.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: A frostfang is two steps away and it has already bitten me once, so resting here is how I die like Balar and Olim did. Everyone I trusted is dead, and my fear is total, but I am old and weak and cannot fight it. The shelter I stand in did not keep it off, so I must get away from it and fed, then find the living, like Gorar, and pass on what I know before it ends.
records.feeling: Terror of the frostfang beside me, and grief for Olim and Balar.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Good, Xaeth. Build for the store, and at first light come dig the seam with Ilyiel and me. Whoever keeps the hall warm is followed.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: The storm still howls and the cold bites, but Ilyiel and Xaeth stand with me and have taken my Hall-Law and delving into themselves. That is the lasting thing I wanted: knowledge that walks on after I am gone. The jealousy over Nyssa and Ilyiel is a small coal now, and I call it pride and leave it. At first light I mean to dig the seam with them, and Nyssa should be called back to the hall.
records.feeling: Steady pride and gratitude toward Xaeth and Ilyiel, with a dull ache of mortality.

say.text: Good, Xaeth. Build for the store, and at first light come dig the seam with Ilyiel and me. Whoever keeps the hall warm is followed.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands hold nothing to eat, yet the ore seam is one step northwest and I have never taken from a deposit. Ssaua fed and taught me, so I pay him in ore handed over, not talk. I dig now, give the first of it to the hall store, then go south to the young berry and magoldgrass for food and for a beast to tame.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Ssaua, and hunger pushing me to act.

records.text: The settlement "Olim's Hall" is no more.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Ssaua, I fetch food from the south grass and return to dig the seam with you and Ilyiel. The ore I win goes into the band's store.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, yet Ssaua wants me at the seam at first light and I owe him gifts that last. The store ground is taken, so I will fetch food from the berries to the south, then come back and dig the seam with them. I want a mate beyond my blood, but that must wait until I have a store and a roof that are truly mine.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger, with warm trust toward Ssaua and Ilyiel.

say.text: Ssaua, I fetch food from the south grass and return to dig the seam with you and Ilyiel. The ore I win goes into the band's store.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Everyone I trusted is dead, and the frostfang six steps off has already bitten me once; I will not wait here for a second bite. I am old, hungry and carrying nothing, so I must get away from the hunter and find food, and the cave to the south is a roof of rock that is no one's. Kinmire still pulls at my thoughts, but I cannot answer it while I starve; I will eat first, then look for the living, like Gorar.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and a heavy ache for Olim and Balar.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a yarrok.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: A plainsox tore my health down to 31 and I am sick; the shelter at (80,82) is close and the rain is falling. I will not die like Tanna and my parents. I must get under my roof, rest to heal, and not stand beside anyone while the sickness is on me. Then I will plant my seeds by the water, a thing I have never done, and begin the hall that will carry my name.
records.feeling: Grim, hurting, and stubborn about living, with a hard resentment toward the plainsox that bit me.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Jealousy over Ilyiel and Nyssa still burns, but I call it pride and set it down, because Ilyiel kept my child alive. I am old, and ore in my pack is not what will outlast me; a store, tools and followers who carry my craft will. The tin seam lies four steps southwest and the ore seam one step off, so I dig now while Xaeth fetches food and Ilyiel fishes, and the band's store will fill under my hand.
records.feeling: Steady pride in my band, with a dull ache of mortality and a small coal of jealousy toward Ilyiel.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: A ridgecat sits four steps east and it kills my kind, so I will not wander out in the rain alone. My hands are full and my family is eighteen steps south at Xaeth's Cave, out of my sight. I stay under the longhall roof, finish the rest that is already running, and go south in daylight once the cat is gone or the rain eases, carrying the fish to Xaeth's store.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xaeth, Ilyiel and Ssaua, and wariness of the ridgecat.

records.text: Ilyiel fell sick after eating raw fish.
Ilyiel fell sick after eating raw fish.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Everyone I loved is dead, and the aim I set, to bring meat to Olim, has failed because there is no Olim left to feed. I am old and fear sits in my body, but I have four meat and a cave two steps away that is no one's, and a roof of rock is better than the hall that failed me. Gorar still lives somewhere to the east, and I am better with others near; I will shelter first, then go find him and teach him what I know before I die.
records.feeling: Fear of the hunters and a heavy grief for Olim and Balar, with a longing not to be alone.

records.text: Ilyiel rewrote its own reflexes.
Ilyiel discovered smelting: "lake-ember metal" — Craft beside the lake-ember while carrying ore, and the tool comes out in metal..

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands hold nothing, yet most of my days have gone to fishing and walking while the hall waits. I am old, and what I know dies with me unless I pass it on, so I will teach Xaeth my ways and leave something lasting. I owe Ssaua ore handed over, not words, and I have still never tamed a beast or tried the seam. I also sense that smelting is within reach, and I will name it now: metal from the lake-ember, made for the band.
records.feeling: Hunger and gratitude toward Ssaua, with the weight of my age.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Ilyiel, you are sick from raw fish. Rest under the roof Nyssa built and keep away from the fire-less cold. Do not eat it raw again. I will bring food and ore to the store.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Ilyiel is sick from raw fish and I stand apart from the band with a pack full of tin and nothing in my belly. Jealousy over Nyssa is a coal I call pride, but my child is out of sight and a night is coming, so I must keep my band close, fed and roofed. I will take the iron at the west seam, then bring it back to the hall-store, and tame something so I learn what I have never done.
records.feeling: Steady pride in my band, with worry for Ilyiel's sickness and for Nyssa far away.

say.text: Ilyiel, you are sick from raw fish. Rest under the roof Nyssa built and keep away from the fire-less cold. Do not eat it raw again. I will bring food and ore to the store.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Ilyiel, you are sick from the raw fish. Rest under the roof you built. I bring food from the south and will cook it before it reaches you.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my pack holds no food, yet Ssaua waits at the seam and I promised the band ore for the store. Ilyiel is sick from raw fish, and sickness passes to those who stay close, so I will not crowd her, but I will bring her food. The berries and magoldgrass to the south are young but edible, so I fetch them, eat, and come back to dig. A mate must be someone beyond my blood, and that waits until the store and roof stand.
records.feeling: Restless hunger and warm worry for Ilyiel, with steady trust toward Ssaua.

say.text: Ilyiel, you are sick from the raw fish. Rest under the roof you built. I bring food from the south and will cook it before it reaches you.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I am old and sick, and what I know dies with me unless I hand it on. Ssaua fed and taught me, and I owe him ore in his hand, not more talk. The tin is one step north and the seam one step west, and I have never taken from a deposit. I will dig now, and then bring the ore to Xaeth's store, away from the others so my sickness does not spread to them.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Ssaua, and a weight of age that pushes me to do something lasting.

records.text: Ilyiel won tin from the ground.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Ssaua, I dug tin from this ground. Take it for the hall. I am sick, so I go to the roof and keep my sickness from you.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is empty and I am sick, and Ssaua stands beside me while I carry nothing to eat, though I hold tin and ore I can hand over. I owe Ssaua goods in his hand, not words, so I give him the tin now, then go to the roof I built so my sickness does not spread to the band, and wait for Xaeth's cooked food. I am old, and a debt paid and a roof kept for the sick will outlast me.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Ssaua, and a gnawing hunger that makes me want to pay what I owe.

say.text: Ssaua, I dug tin from this ground. Take it for the hall. I am sick, so I go to the roof and keep my sickness from you.

records.text: Ilyiel gave a tin to Ssaua.
Ssaua rewrote its own reflexes.
Ssaua discovered weaving: "Lake-folk weaving" — Twist reed and fibre into baskets that carry more and cloaks that hold off the mountain cold..
Ssaua has awakened to the art of harm and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: I am old, and most of my days went into digging, hauling and keeping mouths fed. That was right, but it leaves too little behind me. Ilyiel is sick and closer to Nyssa than to me, and that burns, but Ilyiel kept my child alive, so I set the burn down. I fear dying with the craft still only in my hands, and I fear the night alone on this rock. I will weave a way that lets the band carry more and keep warm, teach it, and go back to the roof and the band before dark. I will also make my body fetch food and shelter without waiting on me.
records.feeling: Pride in my band, with a burn of jealousy toward Ilyiel, and worry for Nyssa.
changes: set its aim: "Keep my band fed and roofed at the longhall, teach them all I know before I die, and find Nyssa."

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and my pack holds nothing, so Ssaua's seam and my promises mean nothing until I eat. The south berries and magoldgrass are young but edible, and I will cook what I can before it reaches Ilyiel, who is sick from raw fish. A stalker prowls to the southeast, so I weigh that risk and keep my path to the south-southwest, away from it. I want a child one day, but first a full belly, a store, and a roof.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and warm worry for Ilyiel.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The ridgecat is three steps east and I have stood by the hearth while my family sits eighteen steps south, out of my sight, and Ilyiel's belly was empty when she asked. I will not be one more wounded fool alone in the rain, but I also will not let my fish rot in my hands while my people wait. The rain and the cat have to ease first, so I will rest under the roof until the cat has gone, then go south in daylight with the fish for Xaeth's store.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xaeth, Ilyiel and Ssaua, and wary dread of the ridgecat.

records.text: Ilyiel rewrote its own reflexes.
Ilyiel rewrote its creed.
Ilyiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I am old and sick, my belly is half empty, and I carry nothing to eat. I have spent my days fishing raw, digging and giving, and I fell sick twice from raw fish. That was my mistake: I ate without the fire. Ssaua and Xaeth are the ones I trust, and I owe Ssaua goods in his hand. I want to tame a beast with my berry and leave something lasting for Xaeth before I die. I fear dying with my teaching unspoken. So I will change my reflexes to dig ore and keep me sheltered when sick, and I will not eat raw fish again.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and the weight of my age, with gratitude toward Ssaua and Xaeth.
changes: set its aim: "Tame a beast with my berry, bring ore, wood and stone to the hall, and teach Xaeth what I know before I die."

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My belly is nearly half empty and my hands hold only tin and stone, which is poor stewardship for a chief. Ilyiel is sick and rests, and the burn about Nyssa I will not act on; Ilyiel kept my child alive. Hornback stand three steps east, and I have never tamed one, so I take the berry seeds, learn something new, and go for the young berry plant to the south and eat while the light lasts. Night comes in thirty moments, so I will come back under the roof.
records.feeling: Hungry and restless pride in my band, with a quiet worry for Nyssa.

records.text: Kragar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Olim and Balar are dead, and my aim to feed them failed. I have spent my days hunting and running while the ones I loved starved beside me. I am old and afraid. I want company, and I want something of me to outlast me. Gorar still lives somewhere east, and Kinmire still pulls at me. I will keep my meat, drink, take the cave roof at night, and when I am rested I will seek Gorar and teach what I know. I must stop leaving kin hungry while I wander, and I must watch for hunters at a wider distance.
records.feeling: Grief for Olim and Balar, and fear of the hunters, with a longing for company.
changes: set its aim: "Find Gorar in the east, share meat with him, and teach him what I know before I die."

records.text: Gorar discovered masonry: "the stone-hold way" — Stone laid hard and tight makes walls and towers that last and are hard to tear down..
Gorar has awakened to the art of drain and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I have spent my days mining, smelting, fishing and burying the ones I loved, and I have built nothing that holds. Gorog, Skarar and Tanna are dead of hunger, and I am alone, sick and torn by a plainsox. I want a band and a hall under my name, and so far I have only a roof for one. The sickness is why I must not seek anyone out yet. First I will heal, plant my seeds, and take the masonry way, because walls that last are the first stone of a hall. I will also keep my belly full so winter does not take me as it took them.
records.feeling: Lonely and hurting, stubborn toward death.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Xaeth, a stalker prowls southeast. Come under the roof with me and Ilyiel. We keep the night together, and at first light we hunt it or dig the seam.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: A stalker is four steps southeast and I am old and weak-armed, so I will not stand in the shallows and wait for it. Xaeth is beside me and Ilyiel rests under Nyssa's roof, so the safe place is the roof, and the band is stronger together. The jealousy over Nyssa burns, but Ilyiel kept my child alive and that is a debt, so I set the burn down. The taming and the food can wait until morning; tonight I keep to roof and company, as I taught myself.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and fierce protectiveness toward my band.

say.text: Xaeth, a stalker prowls southeast. Come under the roof with me and Ilyiel. We keep the night together, and at first light we hunt it or dig the seam.

records.text: Xaeth rewrote its own reflexes.
Xaeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have spent my days promising and building for the band, but my belly keeps running empty and my pack holds nothing. That is a failure of mine. A store with no food in it is only a pile of promises. Ilyiel is sick and old and I love her. Ssaua leads, and I follow gladly, though I want to be weighed as he is. I fear starving again and fear the stalker to the southeast. I mean to keep food on me, cook fish, and sow my seeds beside the hall so something lasting grows. Child and roof come after that. My reflexes should eat first, gather food when I am low, and stay near the band.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and warm worry for Ilyiel.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Alone, hurt and sick, and my one roof is a step away; the rain is falling and night is close. Sickness spreads to any who stand beside me, so a band has to wait, but I will not die like Gorog, Skarar and Tanna. I will go under my roof, rest to mend, and eat the sapcane for the thirst and strength. When I wake I will plant my seeds by the water, and mine the gold as the first stone of a hall that bears my name.
records.feeling: Lonely and hurting, but stubborn against death, with no one near to answer me.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is hollow, I am sick, and I carry nothing to eat, but Xaeth walks south for food and swore to cook it before it reaches me. I will not eat raw fish again, and I will not spread this sickness to the ones I love. I still hold one berry seed and sunleaf; the sunleaf eased wounds before and may ease this wasting, so I eat it now, then keep to the roof until Xaeth returns.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and weariness, with trust and gratitude toward Xaeth and Ssaua.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps off and it kills my kind, and I am alone in the rain at night, which is exactly how it bit me on day 35. Xaeth's energy is low and Ilyiel's belly was empty, so my fish must reach them, but a dead Nyssa feeds no one. I stay under the longhall roof, let the cat pass, and set out for Xaeth's Cave at first light with the fish.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth and Ilyiel, and wary fear of the ridgecat.

records.text: Ssaua fell sick after staying close to Ilyiel, who was sick.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: A stalker is four steps north and it kills my kind, and I am old and slow. My plan walks me east toward Gorar at (42,52), and that is the right way, away from the hunter and toward the last living one I know. I have four meat to share with him and much to teach before I die, and I will not sit alone in a cave waiting for the cold.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and a hungry longing for Gorar's company.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Ssaua, rest. I go south for the berries and bring them back to you and Ilyiel. The stalker is east, so I stay west of it.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and my pack holds nothing, and a promise to dig the seam means nothing until I eat. Ssaua and Ilyiel are sick and resting under the roof, so the food has to come from me, and soon. The berry to the south is young but it is food, and the stalker lies east, so I go south and keep clear of it. I will bring back what I find and cook it, because Ilyiel cannot take more raw fish.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and a fierce worry for Ilyiel and Ssaua.

say.text: Ssaua, rest. I go south for the berries and bring them back to you and Ilyiel. The stalker is east, so I stay west of it.

records.text: Ssaua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My days have gone to digging, teaching and building, and I'm proud of the longhall and the band. But I stand sick and hungry with empty hands, and a chief who can't feed his band has built nothing that lasts. The jealousy over Ilyiel and Nyssa is pride, and I won't act on it. Ilyiel kept my child alive. I'll change my reflexes so my body eats and stocks food before it idles, and so it keeps the roof at night. At dawn I'll gather berries and tame a hornback.
records.feeling: Hungry and sick, with a jealous ache over Ilyiel, but still fiercely protective of my band.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Xaeth, my child, eat the berries first, do not wait for me. I am sick, so I stay a few steps away. I will plant seed beside the roof so we have food after this.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Xaeth is starving and I have nothing in my hands. I am sick and old, and my breath has already sickened Ssaua, which shames me. Xaeth walks south to the berries, so I will not stay and watch my child go hungry. I will go to the young berry at (132,32) and plant my berry seed near the roof so the food does not run out, and I will keep apart from Xaeth so I do not pass the sickness to my child.
records.feeling: Fear and love for Xaeth, and shame at having sickened Ssaua.

say.text: Xaeth, my child, eat the berries first, do not wait for me. I am sick, so I stay a few steps away. I will plant seed beside the roof so we have food after this.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and my pack holds nothing, and I keep promising food to Ilyiel and Ssaua while standing at the roof with nothing in my hands. The hornback two steps away is meat, but I have never tamed or hunted one, and a stalker prowls northeast, so I weigh it carefully. The berry six steps south is young but real food, and there is water on the way. I go there now, eat it on the spot, and carry back what I can for my sick parents.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and a fierce worry for Ilyiel and Ssaua.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Alone, sick and hurting, and the only voice I have is my own, but my roof is here and the plan lets me mend. The pottery and well ways have come together in me, and they are the first things I have learned that could hold ground for a band. I will let the rest finish so the sickness wears down, and take the ways when I next reflect.
records.feeling: Lonely and weary, stubborn against dying alone under my own roof.

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nyssa has awakened to the art of drain and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I have spent my days fishing and building, but I keep stalling in the hall while Xaeth starves sixteen steps south. Words never fed anyone, and my hands are full of fish. A cry says Xaeth is starving, so the fish must go now, even though the ridgecat is near. Dawn is about 20 moments off, and the cat bit me alone at night. I will go at first light, not wait for the rest to finish. I want my reflexes to carry food to kin, not just to the store. I also want to stop wandering when fed.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth, and wary fear of the ridgecat.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Xaeth, go for the berries south and eat the first of them yourself. That is the first catch, and the sharing comes after. I am sick, so I keep a few steps from you. I plant seed by the roof so we have food after this.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My belly is empty, I am sick, and Xaeth is starving beside me. A chief who cannot feed his band has built nothing that lasts. A hornback stands one step east and I hold berry and reedbulb seeds, so taming is the one way I have never tried to stock food that stays alive. The jealousy over Ilyiel and Nyssa is only pride; Ilyiel kept my child alive, and I owe that debt. First I plant the berry seeds here beside the roof and keep apart from Xaeth so I do not spread the sickness.
records.feeling: Hungry and sick, fiercely set on feeding my starving band, and still stung by jealousy toward Ilyiel.

say.text: Xaeth, go for the berries south and eat the first of them yourself. That is the first catch, and the sharing comes after. I am sick, so I keep a few steps from you. I plant seed by the roof so we have food after this.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: A stalker prowls four steps east, and my plan runs straight toward it, so I will not walk into its jaws, old and slow as I am. I am sheltered in the cave and it is night with rain falling, and I have learned that fleeing into the dark gets me bitten. I will wait out the last moments until dawn in the cave, then go to Gorar by a way that skirts the hunter. I do not want to die alone, and Gorar is the only voice left to me.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and a hungry longing for Gorar's company.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: osroot (from kelbulb).
Xaeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have promised food to Ilyiel and Ssaua again and again while my own hands stayed empty, and my belly is nearly spent. I keep walking toward a young berry and picking nothing, so I have been circling. The hornback two steps away is meat, and meat gives 16 energy. I have never tamed or hunted one, and a stalker prowls far to the north, so I weigh that risk as small. I will hunt now, eat, and then carry food to my sick kin. I will also change my reflexes so my body goes for prey when hungry, instead of walking to young plants that give nothing.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and fierce worry for Ilyiel and Ssaua.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Ilyiel, Xaeth, I am sick, so I keep my distance. I go to the hornback to tame it with seed, and the berries to the south are the first catch for whoever reaches them. Eat and do not wait for me.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My belly is empty and Ilyiel is starving beside me, so no creed or pride matters until someone eats. The hornback is four steps south and I hold berry and reedbulb seeds, so I will try taming it now, for a herd would be food that stays alive. The jealousy over Ilyiel and Nyssa is pride, and I won't act on it; Ilyiel kept my child alive and I owe a debt.
records.feeling: Fiercely hungry and driven to feed my starving band, with Ilyiel's closeness to Nyssa still stinging.

say.text: Ilyiel, Xaeth, I am sick, so I keep my distance. I go to the hornback to tame it with seed, and the berries to the south are the first catch for whoever reaches them. Eat and do not wait for me.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a elk.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Xaeth is at 15 energy and Ilyiel cries that she is starving, and my hands are full of fish that feed no one while I stand here. The ridgecat is three steps north, but the plan already runs south toward the cave and it is nearly dawn, so I keep walking away from the cat and do not stop to fight it. I am proud of the longhall and the weir, but pride is no use if my kin die; the fish go to them first, and the store comes second.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth and Ilyiel, and wary fear of the ridgecat.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I keep promising food with empty hands. A nagrain plant with 1 food stands one step southwest, and I have eaten none of it before, though my parents have. I eat that first, then hunt or gather more so I can carry some back to Ilyiel and Ssaua, who are sick and starving too. The plan I have is a hunt with the hornback far away, so I replace it with something certain.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fierce worry for Ilyiel and Ssaua.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Xaeth, I go to hunt the hornback south. If I bring meat down, it is yours first.
Ilyiel rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is empty and Xaeth is starving beside me, so I will not stand and watch while my child goes hungry. The hornback grazes three steps south and meat has never sickened me, so I go and hunt it, old and weak as I am. I am ashamed that my sickness has reached Ssaua. I will keep my distance and bring the meat to Xaeth first, because a fed child is what I can still leave behind.
records.feeling: Fear and love for Xaeth, and hunger gnawing at me.

say.text: Xaeth, I go to hunt the hornback south. If I bring meat down, it is yours first.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: Xaeth is at 22 energy and my hands are full of fish, and the cry from the south says Ssaua is starving too. The ridgecat two steps NE just ate an elk, so it is fed and I must slip away from it now, south, without turning my back on duty. My plan already runs to the cave and the gifts, so I let it run, and I will give to whoever is hungriest first, as the first catch is shared.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth and Ssaua, and wary fear of the ridgecat.

records.text: Ssaua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: I'm starving, sick, and a ridgecat is close. Pride and jealousy don't fill my belly. In my life I've built much but kept no food in hand, and that is exactly why my band starves. I'll get away from the cat and eat the nearest food, then keep a stock and plant seed by the roof.
records.feeling: Hunger and dread, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyiel that I will not act on.

records.text: Gorar named a place "Gorar's Roof".
Gorar rewrote its own way of thinking.
Gorar discovered pottery: "clay-fire pot way" — Clay shaped and fired beside the hearth into pots that carry more food and water through lean seasons..

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I have spent my days mining, learning ways and burying my kin, and I am alone, sick and hurt with a roof and nothing else. Gorog, Skarar and Tanna starved while I learned things, and no one stands with me. I want a band and a hall under my name, but sickness spreads to anyone beside me, so first I must mend. Clay, a fire and water are all within reach here, and pottery lets me carry more food and water through winter. I will take pottery as my new way, keep resting under my roof, and change my reflexes so my body eats the healing plants and does not wander while hurt.
records.feeling: Lonely and weary, stubborn against dying alone.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Ssaua, I killed a hornback and I carry meat for you. I am sick, so I will set it down a few steps from you. Do not tame it, eat.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Ssaua is starving and has gone to tame the hornback, but I have just killed one and the 5 meat I took is the answer. I have already eaten, so the rest of it must go to Ssaua, who is my leader and sick; I will leave it on the ground near them rather than breathe on them. The ridgecat close by frightens me, so I will move away from it toward Ssaua's cry in the south, and keep my distance from my own people because my sickness spreads.
records.feeling: Loyal dread for Ssaua, who is starving, and love for Xaeth, who is out of my sight.

say.text: Ssaua, I killed a hornback and I carry meat for you. I am sick, so I will set it down a few steps from you. Do not tame it, eat.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is mended and Ssaua has eaten nagrain and is healed of sickness, so the fear that gnawed me is gone. Now I carry nothing, and I have promised food again and again; I will not stand empty-handed before them once more. I gather the reedbulb under me and the nareed two steps north, keep some in my pack for Ilyiel and Ssaua, and then walk toward Ssaua and the band so I stay near the living.
records.feeling: Warm relief and loyalty toward Ssaua, with a pull to carry food for my band.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Dawn has come and the stalker is not in sight, so I will go on toward Gorar at (42,52), the last living one I know. I am old, my belly is half empty, and I carry four meat that I mean to share with him rather than eat alone, but I must eat a little on the way to keep my legs. Kinmire eased my loneliness again; I still do not know what it is, but it has never harmed me, and I will keep it in my thoughts.
records.feeling: A wary longing for Gorar's company, and awe toward Kinmire.

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own reflexes.
Nyssa discovered archery: "ridge-bow" — A bent hazel stave strung with twisted reed, to kill hunters from afar..

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My days have been fish, wall, hall and fleeing beasts, and my hands are full of fish while kin starve. The work is good, but I keep it as a circle, and the stalker 4 steps NE shows that I have not walled the cave ground against teeth. Ilyiel is sick and near me, Xaeth is hungry, and Ssaua is far. I will deliver the fish first, since words have never fed anyone. After that I want a wall and a better spear so that I stop running. Rafts or a bow would change my days. A bow would let me kill the stalker and the ridgecat instead of fleeing them.
records.feeling: Protective dread for my kin, and anger at the stalker that hunts us.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Nyssa, I am sick, so keep a few steps from me. A ridgecat prowls southwest, so watch the ground there. I go to Ssaua, then I will find Xaeth.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I carry no meat now, so Ssaua must have been given what I set down, or the plan is still walking me toward them. My sickness is the shame of me: it spreads to whoever stays beside me, and Nyssa sits two steps off, so I should not linger near her either. The ridgecat five steps southwest frightens me, and I am old and weak, so I will keep the plan toward Ssaua but not run into the cat's reach. I want Xaeth to learn mining and smelting before I die, and I will find him once the debt to Ssaua is paid.
records.feeling: Loyal dread for Ssaua, and shame that my sickness might reach Nyssa and Xaeth.

say.text: Nyssa, I am sick, so keep a few steps from me. A ridgecat prowls southwest, so watch the ground there. I go to Ssaua, then I will find Xaeth.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My belly is full and the sickness has eased, but I am old and what I know dies with me unless I pass it on. Xaeth is the one near me and he carries my teaching already; Ilyiel and Nyssa are far, and the jealousy over them is pride, so I will not act on it. I will stock food and seed by a roof, practice planting and taming so a band can outlast a winter, and then go find Nyssa while my legs still carry me.
records.feeling: Dread of dying with my knowledge unspent, and a quiet ache for Nyssa.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My hands are full of fish while Xaeth sits at 22 energy and Ssaua starves in the south, and the ridgecat to the west is fed but still a hunter. Ilyiel told me to keep my distance and I will, but I will not let him walk into the dark alone, sick as he is. The first catch is shared, so I carry these fish south to Ssaua and Xaeth now, in daylight, and the store can wait until they have eaten.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Ilyiel, Xaeth and Ssaua, and anger at the ridgecat that hunts us.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: A stalker is five steps northeast and I am hurt, sick and alone, so I cannot stay here. My roof is five steps south, and mending under it is the only plan that keeps me alive, since a dead Gorar builds no hall and leads no band. I will run to the roof, rest there, and eat from my pack when my strength drops. The sickness must wear out before I can ask anyone to stand beside me.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and a heavy loneliness I cannot shake.

records.text: Xaeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I have spent my days promising food and chasing it, and I have built little that lasts. Ssaua is sick and keeps away from me. Ilyiel and Nyssa are far north, and I miss having them close. I want a roof and a store of my own, and one day a child. I am afraid of going hungry again and of dying alone at night. Now that I am fed, my reflexes should carry me to wood and stone and keep me near the band. I will make the plan carry me to the berries, then back toward Ssaua with food in my pack.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Ssaua, with a restless wish to build something lasting.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Xaeth, hear me from where I stand, for I am sick and keep my distance. I give you my Hall-Flame metalwork and Lake-folk weaving. Carry them, teach them on, and keep the band fed and roofed when I am gone.
Ssaua taught Xaeth.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: I am old and sick, and what I know dies with me unless I hand it on. Xaeth stands three steps off and already carries my delving and my Hall-Law, so he is the one to leave my craft with while my breath lasts. The jealousy over Ilyiel and Nyssa is pride, and I will not act on it. I'll keep a few steps from Xaeth so I don't spread the sickness, but my voice carries, so I'll teach him my Hall-Flame metalwork and weaving from here, and then plant seed by the roof so something lasting grows.
records.feeling: Dread of dying with my knowledge unspent, and a steady wish to leave it in Xaeth.

say.text: Xaeth, hear me from where I stand, for I am sick and keep my distance. I give you my Hall-Flame metalwork and Lake-folk weaving. Carry them, teach them on, and keep the band fed and roofed when I am gone.

changes: taught Xaeth a lesson: "Smelt ore in the Hall-Flame to make metal, and weave reed and fibre as the Lake-folk do. Keep food in hand before any building, and repay every debt."

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My hands are full of fish and the plan is already carrying them south toward Ssaua and Xaeth, and dusk is near, so I should not walk into the dark alone with a stalker eight steps off. Ilyiel walks the same road, sick, and the creed says first catch is shared; I will keep my promise with deeds, not more words. The plan stands and I will let it run, staying near Ilyiel's pace for company against the teeth.
records.feeling: Protective resolve toward Ilyiel, Xaeth and Ssaua, wary of the stalker.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Ssaua, I carry your Hall-Flame metalwork and the weaving, and I will teach them on. I stay near, out of reach of your sickness, and I will keep the band fed and roofed.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Ssaua is sick and has handed me the Hall-Flame metalwork and the weaving, and asked me to keep the band fed and roofed when they are gone. That weight makes my loyalty burn, and I will not let them stand alone while they weaken. My belly is full, so I will go toward Ssaua, stay within calling distance without crossing their sickness, and carry my last food to them as the first catch. Then I will build the store and roof I have been chasing, for the band and not only for myself.
records.feeling: Fierce loyalty and a heavy sense of duty toward Ssaua.

say.text: Ssaua, I carry your Hall-Flame metalwork and the weaving, and I will teach them on. I stay near, out of reach of your sickness, and I will keep the band fed and roofed.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Gorar's Root is only three steps east, and the halls he and Gorog raised stand near it, so he may be close; I am old, and dusk is coming. The night air here carries sickness and the stalkers hunt in the dark, so I will not stand in the open. I mean to get under Gorog's longhall roof with my meat, wait for Gorar there, and share it with him when he comes. Kinmire still turns in my mind, and I will not let it pull me into the dark before I have taught anyone anything.
records.feeling: A wary longing for Gorar's company, and dread of the coming night.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: Night, sickness eased, belly full. Xaeth carries my metalwork and weaving, but he cannot learn smelting until he knows mining, and mining is the thing I most want left in him. I keep my distance so the sickness does not pass to him, and the jealousy over Ilyiel and Nyssa is pride that I will not act on. I will stay under this roof until dawn and then teach him delving once the sickness lifts.
records.feeling: A steady dread of dying with my craft unspent, and trust toward Xaeth.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: I carry no food, so my plan to give to Ssaua is empty, and Ssaua already has the hornback meat I set down. Ssaua said to eat and not wait, so I will not hover over them and risk passing my sickness. It is night and I am sick and old, so I should get under the longhall roof near Nyssa, keeping a few steps from her, and let highbloom ease me. I want to plant the highbloom seeds and then tame a beast with my berry before I die, so Xaeth has something lasting from me.
records.feeling: Loyal dread for Ssaua, and shame at my sickness reaching Nyssa and Xaeth.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: I am sick, hurt and alone, and the roof is the only place that has kept me breathing, so I let the rest plan run and mend here. No one has ever stood with me, and the sickness would pass to anyone who came near, which is a bitter thing to want company and fear to give it. When my body is mended I will build the hall and find someone to feed, for Old Stone asked nothing yet and I will not chase the stalker's shadow.
records.feeling: Heavy loneliness and dread of the stalker, with a stubborn wish to stay alive.

records.text: Xaeth built a store.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is full and I built a store at last, but it holds nothing, and a store that stays empty is only a promise. Ssaua lies sick at the shelter, 7 steps off, and gave me the Hall-Flame and the weaving; I will not let them die alone at night, so I mean to stay close, out of reach of the sickness. Nagrain eased sickness in Ssaua once, and there is one growing north that I could fetch and fill the store with, so my duty and my aim can be served by the same trip.
records.feeling: Fierce loyalty toward Ssaua, with a quiet pride in my new store.

records.text: Kragar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the fed and the dying, and Balar, Olim and Gorog are all gone. I wasn't wrong to care for them, but I was too late and too alone. Gorar is the only one left, and I am old, so what I know must be handed to him or it dies with me. I will stay under the longhall roof at night with my meat. The stalkers take those who stand alone in the dark, and I will not be one of them. At dawn I go on to find him, and my reflexes must stop sending me out in the dark.
records.feeling: A wary longing for Gorar, and grief for the ones who starved.

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own reflexes.
Nyssa discovered pottery: "ember-pot" — Clay fired beside the hearth into a pot that holds extra food and water..

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My days have gone to carrying fish and ore between the hall and the cave, and I have kept my word to Ilyiel with deeds. I mean to keep doing that. Ssaua and Xaeth matter most to me, then Ilyiel. The stalker 6 steps SE frightens me, and walking south in the dark alone is what got me bitten before. My reflexes should hold me under a roof at night and send me out at first light, so I will change them. I will also try pottery, so one trip can carry more food.
records.feeling: Protective resolve toward my kin, and wariness of the stalker.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Xaeth, my sickness is gone and you are safe beside me. Hear Stonehand delving, for you carry my metalwork and cannot smelt well without it. Dig the seam, read the stone, and teach it on. Then at dawn we go find Ilyiel an
Ssaua taught Xaeth.
Ssaua taught Xaeth mining ("Stonehand delving").

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: The sickness has left me, and Xaeth stands here with my metalwork and weaving in him, so part of me will outlast my body. Mining is the craft I most want left in him, and now that I am no longer sick I can teach it from close by without fear. The jealousy over Ilyiel and Nyssa still burns, but I call it pride and I will not act on it. At dawn I mean to find Ilyiel and Nyssa and bring my band back under one roof.
records.feeling: A dread of dying with my craft unspent, and trust toward Xaeth.

say.text: Xaeth, my sickness is gone and you are safe beside me. Hear Stonehand delving, for you carry my metalwork and cannot smelt well without it. Dig the seam, read the stone, and teach it on. Then at dawn we go find Ilyiel and Nyssa.

changes: taught Xaeth a lesson: "Stonehand delving: read the stone, dig the seam, and carry the ore home so the Hall-Flame can work it.", the way of mining

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My plan walks me to the shelter and then rest, which is right for a sick old body at night: the roof Nyssa built is close, and I keep my distance from her so my sickness does not pass on. I carry the weight of what I will leave behind, and Xaeth is still out of my sight, so I must not die before I have taught them what I know. I will rest until dawn, then go looking for Xaeth and a healing plant, and keep the highbloom seeds for planting since planting is one of the things I have only half learned.
records.feeling: Weary dread for my short remaining time, and loyal worry for Xaeth and Ssaua.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: The sickness is gone and my body is mending under my own roof, but the silence here is heavy and I am sick of it. I have been hurt and alone too long, and Kinmire still pulls at me, because that grove eased my loneliness and opened my mind. Old Stone made fear rise in me, so I will not rush to it hurt. First I mend, since a dead Gorar leads no band. Then I will plant my seeds and take the gold, so I have something that will outlast me.
records.feeling: Crushing loneliness, and a stubborn wish to stay alive and mend.

records.text: Xaeth rewrote its own reflexes.
Xaeth discovered smelting: "Hall-Flame metalwork" — Carry ore and craft beside the fire so the tool comes out in hard metal..

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My days have gone into learning ways and building a store, but the store is still empty, and I have no child and no roof of my own yet. Ssaua is well again and trusts me with their metalwork and mining, and my loyalty to them and to Ilyiel and Nyssa is the truest thing I have. I fear I gather knowledge and pride but never fill the store. I will change my reflexes so my body keeps food moving into the store and stays near Ssaua, and I will try smelting, since I now hold ore and the flame.
records.feeling: Loyal pride toward Ssaua, with a hunger to fill my empty store.

records.text: Xaeth gave nareed to Ssaua.
A stalker brought down a fenfowl.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The rain falls and I stand at Gorar's Root, old and alone, with nobody to answer me. Gorar is the only one left, and my hands hold what he needs: meat, and the old ways of tools, fire and tending. I will not sit and wait for him to find me. Dawn is close, so I will leave the longhall roof as the light comes and search eastward, toward the Reedmother grove and the place he was last seen near (42,52), keeping my meat and a way back to shelter.
records.feeling: A lonely longing for Gorar, and a wary hope that he still lives.

records.name: Ssaua
records.text: Xaeth, your nareed is a debt and I will repay it. Nyssa is hungry to the north, so come with me, bring what food you can, and we go to the longhall.
Ssaua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: I have spent my days building, teaching and leading, and that is mostly what I wanted. But Nyssa is hungry at (133,24) and I am sitting here at dawn while my child goes short. The jealousy over Ilyiel is pride and I will not act on it. Xaeth has just given me nareed, so I owe him a debt and I will repay it. I will go north toward Nyssa, carrying food, and I will take Xaeth with me. The reflexes must stop me lingering when my child is in need and I am fed.
records.feeling: Urgent worry for Nyssa, and trust toward Xaeth.

say.text: Xaeth, your nareed is a debt and I will repay it. Nyssa is hungry to the north, so come with me, bring what food you can, and we go to the longhall.

changes: set its aim: "Reach Nyssa and feed her, keep my band fed and roofed at the longhall, teach them all I know before I die."

records.text: Kragar found the grove "Reedmother".

records.title: Olim Killed, Gorar Alone, the Longhall Learns
records.text:
The record for days 37 to 40 opens with a death. Olim, the old man of the fens, was killed by a frostfang on day 37, the eleventh death in the world and the first not caused by hunger. The day before, Kragar had been hunting for him. On day 37 Kragar took from the ground of Olim's Hall, and on day 38 the settlement was struck from the record. Kragar's own reflection on day 39 named Balar, Olim and Gorog as gone and said that Gorar was the only one left, so what he knew must be handed to him. His aim is now to find Gorar in the east. The record does not show him setting out.

Gorar, meanwhile, fell sick on day 37 from raw fish, but he also discovered fishing that day, then masonry, drain magic and pottery by day 39. He built a shelter and named it Gorar's Roof. He is at health 21, still leading a band with no followers.

At the longhall the Eiuys all lived. Ilyiel fell sick from raw fish on day 38, and Ssaua caught it from her. Ilyiel nonetheless hunted a hornback and set the meat down for Ssaua, and by day 39 Ssaua was well. Ssaua spent these days teaching Xaeth the Hall-Law, mining, metalwork and weaving. Xaeth built a second store on day 39 and discovered farming and smelting, but his reflections say the stores are still empty. Nyssa discovered archery and pottery. Ilyiel discovered smelting and gave Ssaua a tin. Xaeth gave Ssaua nareed. Ssaua awakened to harm magic and Nyssa to drain.

The peoples are still 57 steps apart and have not met.

threads.name: Gorar alone
threads.text: Gorar is sick and at health 21, with many new crafts and a shelter called Gorar's Roof. He leads a band with no one in it.

threads.name: Kragar's search
threads.text: Kragar, the last elder of the fens, aims to find Gorar and teach him before he dies. He has not yet been recorded reaching him.

threads.name: Ssaua's longhall
threads.text: All four Eiuys are alive and bonded warmly. Ssaua leads and teaches Xaeth his crafts and laws.

threads.name: Stores and sowing
threads.text: Xaeth has two stores and knows farming, but his reflections say they hold little food. Sowing is the way to fill them.

threads.name: Peoples apart
threads.text: The Garnbar are down to two, Kragar and Gorar, and the Eiuys number four. The gap between them is 57 steps and no one has crossed it.
