records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Nyssa, my sickness is gone. A stalker is at my feet, so stand close with me under the roof. Share the first catch with me, and I will dig ore and teach Xaeth.
Ilyiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: A stalker stands one step from me, and I am old and my blows are weak, so I will not stand and fight it. I go to Nyssa and the cave and the roof, because the beasts here take those who are alone. Most of my life is behind me. I have not yet tamed a beast with my berry, and I have not taught Xaeth enough, and that is what I fear. When the stalker is gone and my belly is fed, I will go to Xaeth and teach, then tame the yarrok to the east. My sickness has passed, so I can stand near my own again.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker at my feet, and a hard wish to teach Xaeth before I die.

say.text: Nyssa, my sickness is gone. A stalker is at my feet, so stand close with me under the roof. Share the first catch with me, and I will dig ore and teach Xaeth.

changes: set its aim: "Stay alive, tame the yarrok with my berry, find Xaeth and teach them all I know (fire, rafts, smelting, tin and ore) before I die."
rethought what it knows (16 notes became 10)

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Ssaua, I come with you. I gather berries first so I bring Nyssa food, and then I follow north.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Ssaua owes me for the nareed and is already walking north to Nyssa, who is hungry, and my pack is empty. I eat first, then carry food to the longhall, because a gift that arrives with Nyssa is worth more than any store I could boast of. Berries are two steps away, and with Ilyiel up there too I want to stay close to the living and prove my loyalty by acting on it.
records.feeling: Loyal pride toward Ssaua, with a pull to bring food to Nyssa.

say.text: Ssaua, I come with you. I gather berries first so I bring Nyssa food, and then I follow north.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Health 22 and no one to answer me; the roof is two steps off and it is the only thing that has kept me breathing. I mend first, then I plant the seeds I have never put in the ground, so that something I made feeds me when the lean season comes again. Loneliness gnaws, but a hurt body is prey, so I will not wander to Kinmire yet; I will rest under my own roof and let the gold wait.
records.feeling: Crushing loneliness and a stubborn will to mend, toward the empty land around me.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The grove Reedmother touched me again and my mind feels open, but I will not sit here wondering while Gorar may still be out there. Dawn is close and I carry meat for him, and the hall at Gorar's Root is nearby, so I will go back there and look for signs of him, then press east as my aim says. I am old and tire fast, so I will walk carefully and keep my food for the one living kin I have left.
records.feeling: A wary hope toward Gorar, and a quiet awe toward the grove.

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Ilyiel, I am coming to the roof. Take a fish from my hand, the first catch is yours. Cook it in the fire this time so the sickness does not return. At first light I go for Xaeth.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: A stalker sits 3 steps south and I will not walk into its teeth; the cave and roof are the safe ground, and Ilyiel is already beside the hall asking for the first catch. My creed says the first catch is shared, and I keep my word with deeds, so I give Ilyiel a fish now and stay under the roof with them until the stalker passes or first light comes. Xaeth is out of my sight and that gnaws at me, but dying in the dark to a stalker would help no one, so I will carry the rest of the fish to the larder and then go for Xaeth at dawn.
records.feeling: Protective resolve toward Xaeth and Ilyiel, and dread of the stalker to the south.

say.text: Ilyiel, I am coming to the roof. Take a fish from my hand, the first catch is yours. Cook it in the fire this time so the sickness does not return. At first light I go for Xaeth.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My plan already has me walking north toward Nyssa, and my belly is full, so I will let it run. Xaeth says he will gather berries and follow, and his word has held so far. The jealousy over Ilyiel still burns; I name it pride and will not act on it. I would rather show Nyssa and Ilyiel that I am worth following by arriving with food and teaching them what I know before my years run out.
records.feeling: Urgent worry for Nyssa, and steady trust toward Xaeth.

records.text: Nyssa gave fish to Ilyiel.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My pack is empty and I told Ssaua I would bring Nyssa food, so I must not walk north with nothing. Berries are close, and I want to gather them and keep following, because a gift that reaches Nyssa matters more than boasting of a store. Ssaua's standing is higher than mine, and staying near Ssaua and my parents is how I learn and earn a roof and, one day, a child.
records.feeling: Loyal pride toward Ssaua, with a pull to bring food to Nyssa.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Nyssa, I thank you. I will cook the fish in the fire and eat it. Stay beside me under the roof while the stalker is near, and we go for Xaeth together at first light.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Nyssa is one step away with fish in her hand, and I am hungry, so I will take what she offers and cook it in the fire this time. I will never eat raw fish again; that sickness taught me. The stalker three steps south frightens me, and I am old and my blows are weak. I stay under the roof with Nyssa until the beast drifts off, and then I go find Xaeth before my days run out.
records.feeling: Hunger and dread of the stalker, and warm trust toward Nyssa.

say.text: Nyssa, I thank you. I will cook the fish in the fire and eat it. Stay beside me under the roof while the stalker is near, and we go for Xaeth together at first light.

I eat a fish here where it is safe, then rest until first light, as I told Ilyiel, and go for Xaeth together with them. My word is good, and I will keep it with deeds, not just talk.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and protective resolve toward Xaeth and Ilyiel.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: My days have gone to feeding and healing kin who died anyway, and to standing alone in the rain. Balar, Olim and the rest are gone, and I could not keep them alive. Gorar is the only one left, and I mean to find him and pass on what I know before I am gone. I have been too passive. My reflexes just linger, and I have left nothing behind that others could read. I will walk east, leave a mark at Gorar's Root, and change my reflexes so that a full belly sends me looking for him instead of standing still.
records.feeling: A wary hope toward Gorar, and the ache of being the last one left.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.text: Nyssa, take this tin from my hand. When you find Xaeth, tell them it comes from the ground beside their cave, and that lake-ember melts it into metal. I will wait under the roof until the stalker leaves, then follow you.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: The stalker is two steps off and I am old, so I keep under the longhall roof with Nyssa and do not test my weak blows against it. Xaeth is out of my sight and my days are few, so everything I know must reach them: fire, rafts, smelting, tin. I have never tamed a beast, and the yarrok five steps east waits for my berry, but not while the stalker prowls. First I pass something to Nyssa by hand, since she will find Xaeth at first light and may carry it when I cannot.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and a deep wish to reach Xaeth before my time runs out, with warm trust toward Nyssa.

say.text: Nyssa, take this tin from my hand. When you find Xaeth, tell them it comes from the ground beside their cave, and that lake-ember melts it into metal. I will wait under the roof until the stalker leaves, then follow you.

records.text: Ilyiel gave a tin to Nyssa.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My pack is empty and I told Ssaua I would bring Nyssa food, so I will not walk north with nothing. The berries are three steps southwest, so I harvest there first and then follow Ssaua, who has already gone ahead. A gift that reaches Nyssa matters more than any boast, and staying near Ssaua and my parents is how I keep my roof and store within reach before winter.
records.feeling: Loyal pride toward Ssaua, and a pull to bring food to Nyssa.

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own reflexes.
Nyssa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I keep walking in circles: fish, carry, rest, flee the stalker, and I get sick from my own haste with raw fish. I eat well but the winter stores are not filling, and Xaeth is still out of my sight. Ilyiel has stood by me and I trust them. I fear the stalker, and I fear that my words outrun my deeds. I will rest until first light as I said, then go for Xaeth with Ilyiel. I change my reflexes so I cook fish before eating, and I note that.
records.feeling: Protective dread of the stalker, and steady trust toward Ilyiel.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My pack is empty, and I promised Ssaua I would bring Nyssa food, so I will not go north with nothing. The berries are four steps southeast, young but close, and the reedbulbs and nareed lie south, ripe with food. I will gather there, then follow Ssaua north. Bringing Nyssa a meal matters more than boasting, and it keeps me near my parents and my band.
records.feeling: Loyal pride toward Ssaua, and a pull to bring food to Nyssa.

records.text: Gorar rewrote its own way of thinking.
Gorar discovered storage: "the salt-keep way" — A stone-walled store at my roof holds food, and salt rubbed into meat keeps it through the lean season for me and any band I gather..

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: Days of resting under my roof, and the silence is still the worst of it. I have made much: mining, smelting, weaving, fishing, masonry, pottery. None of it has a voice to answer it, and my people are all dead. I have kept my body alive but I have not built anything with my name on it, and I have not planted a seed. That is the mistake. I mend first, then I put seeds in the ground, store food against winter, and go find the living, since a band will not walk to a lone man in the sand. Storage is within my reach, and with my salt it would keep meat for the lean season that killed Gorog, Skarar and Tanna. I will not let their deaths repeat in me.
records.feeling: Crushing loneliness and a stubborn will to outlast the winter that took my kin.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My plan is still walking me north toward Nyssa, and I will let it run. Xaeth stands close and has not yet gathered his berries, but his word has held, so I trust he will follow. The jealousy over Ilyiel being nearer to Nyssa still burns; I call it pride and will not act on it. I want to arrive with food in hand and show them I am worth following, and I still wonder what makes a person choose to follow.
records.feeling: Urgent worry for Nyssa, and steady trust toward Xaeth.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The aloneness presses hard, and I will not let the rain and the reeds hold me while Gorar may be alive somewhere east. My explore is already carrying me that way and my two pieces of meat are still for him, so I let it run. If I find his roof or a sign of him I will teach him what I know before my years run out.
records.feeling: A wary hope toward Gorar, and an ache of loneliness.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: Hunger gnaws and my hands are empty, yet Nyssa's fish was already given and I will not take more from a sick friend. The stalker prowls eight steps west, so I stay under the roof tonight and do not test my old blows on it. At first light I will go for the berries south and for Xaeth, with my one berry kept for taming the yarrok, so what I know is not lost when I die.
records.feeling: Hungry and dreading the stalker, but warm trust toward Nyssa and a longing for Xaeth.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My days have gone into learning things and following Ssaua, and I have built little that is mine alone. Ssaua and my parents matter most to me. I told Ssaua I would bring Nyssa food, yet my pack is empty and my plan keeps failing because I stand off the plants. I fear the night alone and an empty belly again. I will stop circling, harvest the plants where they actually grow, and walk to the band. Then I will court Ssaua only if kin rules allow it, and I will keep building toward a store and a roof.
records.feeling: Loyal pull toward Ssaua and Nyssa, with restless purpose.
changes: rethought what it knows (16 notes became 8)

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Ilyiel, my sickness may pass to you if I stay close, so I will sit a few steps off under the roof. At first light we go for Xaeth, and I carry your tin.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: It is still night, the stalker prowls nearby, and I am sick, so I must not stay beside Ilyiel and spread it to them, yet leaving the roof now means the teeth of the stalker. My word to Ilyiel was first light and Xaeth, and I keep it: I rest until dawn, then go with company. The sickness is my own fault from raw fish, and I will cook every fish from now on. Ilyiel's tin sits in my hand like a gift I must carry to Xaeth, and I want a made thing of my own, a carving, to answer my envy while I wait.
records.feeling: Protective dread of the stalker, and steady trust toward Ilyiel, with pride and envy stirring.

say.text: Ilyiel, my sickness may pass to you if I stay close, so I will sit a few steps off under the roof. At first light we go for Xaeth, and I carry your tin.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: It is night and raining, and the last time I stood alone in the dark a frostfang found me, so I will not wander east blind. Still, the ache for Gorar is stronger than the ache for safety, and I carry meat for him. I will gather a little more food from the plants here, then walk east at dawn, leaving a mark so he or anyone can find where I went. I mean to build a shelter first against the night air, since a roof and stored food are what kept the living alive.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Gorar, and loneliness pressing on me in the rain.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and my hands hold nothing, yet Nyssa already gave me her fish and I will not take more from a sick friend. The stalker prowls west in the rain, my old blows are weak, so I stay under this roof and let my rest finish until the light comes. Then I will cross to the berry south for my belly and carry my one berry to the yarrok, and from there search for Xaeth, because what I know must reach them before I die.
records.feeling: Hungry and anxious for Xaeth, but warmed by trust toward Nyssa.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My belly is near full and the rain is falling, but my pack holds only one nareed, and I promised Nyssa food. The berries are three steps southwest, plentiful, so I will gather several and carry them north to Ssaua and my parents, because a promise kept is worth more than any boast. I also have seeds idle in my pack, and seeds wasted help no one. I will plant a few here beside the shelter so something of mine lasts and feeds the band when we return.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, with a loyal pull toward Ssaua and Nyssa.

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: The roof kept me breathing, but resting alone only feeds the silence. I have never put a seed in the ground, and the winter that took Gorog, Skarar and Tanna was a failure of stored food, so I will plant the berry and the ironnut beside my roof now, while the rain falls, and let something grow that is mine. Health is 32 and a hurt body is prey, so I stay close to Gorar's Roof, eat what I carry, and mend while the seeds take.
records.feeling: Crushing loneliness, and a stubborn will to build something that outlasts me.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: The rain and the dark press on me, and the ache for a living voice is stronger than the ache for safety. It is night and a frostfang has found me alone before, so I will not stumble east blind. I will eat a little, take the food near me for Gorar's sake, and let the rest-then-east plan carry me to dawn.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Gorar, and loneliness in the rain.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: nahazel (from hazel).

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: The silence is the worst wound, worse than the pain, and nobody here will answer me while I sit under my roof. My health is 33 and it is night with rain, so I will mend first: get into Gorar's Roof and rest until dawn. When light comes I will go and find the grove Kinmire, which eased my loneliness before, and ask whether it wants something from me, and I will look for living kin of any tongue to gather as a band.
records.feeling: Crushing loneliness, and a stubborn wish to mend and then build something that outlasts me.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: I promised Nyssa food and my pack holds one nareed, while Ssaua walks north without me. Berries stand one step northwest, plentiful, so I will gather a few and then follow Ssaua to the longhall, because a kept promise is what makes me worth following. Standing off the plants is what failed me before, so this time I walk onto the berry tile first.
records.feeling: Restless purpose and loyalty toward Ssaua and Nyssa.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: The rest is still running and dawn is close; I let it finish rather than throw it away. I am sick and Ilyiel is on the same spot, so I should not linger beside them. At first light I go for Xaeth with Ilyiel's tin, as I promised, and I will not be a liar.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth and steady trust toward Ilyiel, with pride in my word held.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My plan is still walking me north to Nyssa, and I will let it run. Xaeth is two steps off and his word has held, so he follows. The jealousy over Ilyiel and Nyssa still burns; I call it pride and will not act on it, for what I want is to arrive with food in hand and be worth following.
records.feeling: Urgent worry for Nyssa, and steady trust toward Xaeth.

records.text: The miskit died out.
A dunecat brought down a yarrok.

records.name: Xaeth
records.text: Ssaua, I gather shell and a little food here, then I follow you north to the longhall. Wait for me on the way if you can.

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: Ssaua walks north to the longhall and I promised Nyssa food, but my pack holds one nareed and I have never courted or tasted a shell deposit two steps away. Longing for a child pulls at me, yet Ssaua is of my band and I must weigh whether kin rules forbid it; a mate must come from outside my kin, so I will keep the band close and gather shell first, which can be worn to tire less and is something others notice, to build my standing. I will grab the shell, harvest the young osroot beside me for food, then follow Ssaua north to my parents.
records.feeling: Restless purpose and loyalty toward Ssaua and my parents.

say.text: Ssaua, I gather shell and a little food here, then I follow you north to the longhall. Wait for me on the way if you can.

records.text: Xaeth won shell from the ground.
Ilyiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My days have gone to fishing, building and finding things, and I'm proud of the fire, rafts and metal. But I've kept little food in my hands and I've let Xaeth drift out of my sight, and that's wrong for a man at 83% of his life. Nyssa and Ssaua are the ones I trust. I fear the stalker, and I fear dying before Xaeth has learned what I know. I'll rest until first light, then walk south for the berries. After that I'll find Xaeth and Ssaua and put tin and metal into their hands, because words alone won't carry it.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven to find Xaeth, with deep trust toward Nyssa.
changes: rethought what it knows (11 notes became 10)

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: Dawn has come and the rain has not eased, but the ache for a voice that answers is greater than any fear of the plains. Gorar is the one living soul I trust, and I carry meat for him, so the plan to walk east is right and I will let it run. Before I go I will fill my last two places with food, since a hand should not arrive empty, and I will leave a mark so that Gorar or anyone else can find where I passed. Kinmire still tugs at me, but I do not mean to turn back for a riddle while a friend may be waiting.
records.feeling: Wary hope and aching loneliness, toward Gorar in the east.
plan: mark [text Kragar of the Garnbar went east to find Gorar, old, with meat for him.] (3 moments)

records.text: Kragar left a mark: "Kragar of the Garnbar went east to find Gorar, old, with mea"
Ssaua taught Xaeth.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: I keep telling myself I will go north, but my body has been standing here and my belly is emptying. Nyssa is hungry, and I will not reach her if I arrive weak, so I eat first and then walk, with Xaeth's shell and food coming behind me. The jealousy over Ilyiel I call pride and let lie; I will find Ilyiel at the longhall and mend it by feeding both of them. Along the way I will teach Xaeth what he lacks, so that something of me outlives me.
records.feeling: Urgent worry for Nyssa, and steady trust toward Xaeth.
changes: taught Xaeth a lesson: "Hall-Law: the first catch of the day is shared, a debt is repaid, and a child in need outranks rest. Walk with food in hand and company, and teach it on."

records.text: Xaeth rewrote its own way of thinking.
Xaeth discovered medicine: "nagrain-tending" — Carry nagrain and sunleaf and give them to the sick or wounded, myself included, to ease wounds and sickness..

records.name: Xaeth
records.thought: My days have been gathering, building and following Ssaua, and I have made a lot: tools, fire, pots, stores. But I have no roof of my own and no child, and I keep putting off both. Ssaua and my parents matter most to me, and Ssaua repays what I give. A mate must come from outside my kin, so I need to find others. I fear winter and the empty store. I will turn what I know about healing plants into medicine, and I will change my reflexes so I keep stocked food and stay with the band.
records.feeling: Restless loyalty toward Ssaua and my parents, with a longing for a child.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 8)

records.name: Gorar
records.thought: The silence is crushing me, and the pain is no better. Health 37 is too low to wander far, but sitting alone has only fed the loneliness. I am fed and the water is beside me, so I will go to Kinmire, the grove that eased me before and left my mind open, and find out whether something there wants me. On the way I will plant the ironnut seed near my roof, so that something of mine is growing when I return.
records.feeling: Crushing loneliness, and a stubborn wish to build something that outlasts me.

records.name: Nyssa
records.text: Ilyiel, it is first light and I go to Xaeth's Cave with your tin. Keep a few steps from me, my sickness is still on me. Follow when you are ready.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: It is first light, and I swore to Ilyiel I would go for Xaeth carrying their tin. My word is good, and I despise liars, so I will not sit here fishing on reflex while my child is out of my sight. I am sick and Ilyiel is walking toward me, so I will keep some distance from them. I will go to Xaeth's Cave just north, where the longhall and the ore seam are, and look for Xaeth there. The fish here are thinning, so the winter stores must come from elsewhere, and Xaeth first matters more than any of it.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth, and steady trust toward Ilyiel.

say.text: Ilyiel, it is first light and I go to Xaeth's Cave with your tin. Keep a few steps from me, my sickness is still on me. Follow when you are ready.

records.text: The population is six, three of them elders, with no children and no likely pairs: Nyssa and Xaeth are parent and child, and the two Garnbar are apart. Please consider newcomers who arrive at the edge of the land when the living fall below some floor (perhaps 8): a small band of a new people or of a lost one, with its own tongue and a craft or two. This would keep the world from simply ending, and it fits the roadmap idea of the world growing at its edges.

Elders who know a way that no younger person knows (Kragar alone knows medicine) should feel a drive to hand it on before they die, or there should be a way for knowledge to be left at a grave or a hall for others to find. Otherwise whole ways vanish when the last elder of a people dies alone.

records.seen: Summer has returned and food has recovered from 380 to 1202. Olim was the only death since the last visit, killed by a frostfang. The world is now dangerously small: six people, three of them elders, no children, the Brusha gone, and only two Garnbar who are not yet together. Gorar lives alone at Gorar's Roof, sick and at health 36, with a band of no one. Kragar means to find him but has not set out, and the Eiuys keep to their longhall 54 steps away with two stores that are still empty.
records.predict: By my next visit (about day 45, autumn into early winter): Kragar and Gorar end up within 15 steps of each other, or the Garnbar/Eiuys distance falls below 45 because Gorar or Kragar moves toward company. Bands stay at 1, and following stays at 3 unless Gorar or Kragar pledges to Ssaua, in which case it becomes 4. The Eiuys stay at 4 alive. Deaths reach 12 at most, and if someone dies it is Gorar (health 36, sick) or an elder. If anyone dies away from others, wandering in search of company did harm, and I will undo the change. No births. Stores stay at 2 or reach 3. Lorekeeping stays unknown unless Kragar teaches Gorar. Emberfish is still 0.
reviewed: #7 kept: Emberfish was made 0 times, so that half failed. The Eiuys fish but do not cook what they catch, which matches the old lesson that an act no one chooses is not changed by offering it. It costs nothing and may matter in winter, when fish come slower. Giving at 1.3 did what I predicted for Tanna: her standing rose from 5.26 to 6.2, gifts across peoples rose from 3 to 4, sickness held at 7 and deaths held at 6. Gorog never entered the standing list and following stayed at 4. The lever rewarded the person who already gives, not the leader who carries too little to give. Keep both.

#8 kept: Works at 1.5 nudged the builders upward: Gorar's standing went from 5.38 to 5.47 and Olim's from 4.61 to 4.84. Gorog died before the lever could help him, and following fell from 4 to 3 through deaths, not through any harm from the change. Lorekeeping is still unknown and talesHeld is 0, but loss pressure on the Garnbar has only now reached 2.5, so the spur has not yet had its moment. Both changes cost nothing. My prediction failed on deaths (10, not 7 or fewer) and on stores (1, not 0). It held on emberfish, on taming and on the distance between peoples.

#9 kept: Food rose from 380 to 1202, well above the 700 I predicted, with only one blight recorded. Deaths stopped at exactly 11, and the one who died was Olim, as predicted, though the cause was a frostfang rather than hunger. The Eiuys all lived, and the second store was built by an Eiuy (Xaeth). The prediction failed on distance: the peoples came to 54 steps, not more than 60, and lorekeeping is still unknown. The lower blight did only good.
records.lesson: Easing blight let food recover fast, and the next death came from a predator to the weakest elder rather than from hunger. Once scarcity lifts, danger falls on whoever is most frail, so with so few people every remaining life now carries the world's future.
ideasAdded: A world of six can end. When a people falls to its last two or three, newcomers from beyond the edge (a wandering family of a new people, or lost kin) may be what keeps the world alive, and they would bring a new tongue and new crafts with them.

The two last Garnbar are seeking each other across the land. If Kragar reaches Gorar and teaches him, the knowledge of a whole people passes through a single meeting. Watch whether what Kragar knows (medicine, farming, customs) survives him.

records.text: The world changed: law drives.loneliness: 1 → 1.3.
Ssaua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ssaua
records.thought: My days have gone to feeding, building halls and teaching, and that was right. But Nyssa is hungry in the north, and I stood still when I should have walked. Jealousy over Ilyiel burns, and I call it pride and leave it alone. I am old, so I must teach Xaeth and the others while I can. My plan is still walking me north, so I let it run.
records.feeling: Urgent worry for Nyssa, and steady trust toward Xaeth.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands hold no food, and an old man who lets that happen has learned nothing from his own sickness. The berry two steps south is mine to take, and I carry one berry seed that I have never used to tame. I mean to eat, then try the yarrok to the northeast with a berry in hand, since that is a thing I have never done and want to leave behind as knowledge for Xaeth. Nyssa is sick, so I keep my distance and stay glad of her trust, and then I go for Xaeth before my days run out.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with deep trust and worry toward Nyssa.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: I swore to Ilyiel I would carry their tin to Xaeth, and the plan ran out with Xaeth's Cave only two steps off while my reflexes drag me toward water. My word is good, so I go to the cave now, and I keep my distance from Ilyiel because my sickness spreads. Xaeth is my child and out of my sight, and I will not rest until I see them, then I'll get back to stocking the longhall for winter.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth, and steady trust toward Ilyiel.

records.name: Ilyiel
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands hold no food, and I am old enough that I cannot keep letting that happen. The berry under my feet is tended and mine to take, so I will eat it first. Then I will try taming the yarrok with the berry seed's fruit in hand, for I have never done it and taming is a thing that lasts. Nyssa has gone ahead to Xaeth's Cave with my tin, so after that I follow her, with Ssaua walking the same way, and I will teach Xaeth what I know before my time runs out.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with deep trust toward Nyssa and a quiet worry for Xaeth.

records.text: Kragar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragar
records.thought: My days have been the same day: walking, eating and burying the ones I loved. Olim and Balar are dead. They died alone, hungry and without a roof, and I could not feed them in time. Gorar is the only one left I trust, and I am 86% through my life with nothing taught and nothing built. I am afraid of dying alone with what I know. So I will keep walking east, but my reflexes must stop me from wasting the day, and I want to learn to leave lasting marks. I'll carry food, drink, and take only what I need on the way to Ssaua's ground, where there may be living voices.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and a thin hope toward Gorar.
changes: set its aim: "Find Gorar in the east, or any living people at Ssaua's Hall-Ground, share meat, and teach what I know before I die."

records.text: Nyssa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nyssa
records.thought: My days have been fishing, hauling and circling the hall, and I got sick twice from raw fish because my body doesn't cook it. Ilyiel has given me tin and stayed true, and Xaeth is my child and out of my sight, so that is what matters most. I swore to bring the tin to Xaeth. I'm sick, so I keep my distance from kin, and I will not break my word. I change my reflexes so I stop eating raw fish and so I keep a roof at night. I will go find Xaeth now.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Xaeth, and steady trust toward Ilyiel.
