voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I answer your courting. A ridgecat prowls northwest, so let us go to shelter together, and I will bring food for the child when the light returns.

voices.name: Bruwen
voices.text: Arri, I am coming to you. Stay where you are with Tanna, and keep clear of the frostfang. We eat together, then go to the fire.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, I answer your courting. Walk with me to the Hold, and we eat under my roof together.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, the frostfang is close and the night is sick. Come into Olim's hall and lay out your food with mine. Sit under the roof I raised, and be of Olim's band.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, I bring you wood for the hall. It is a gift, and I will sit by you and Kragar through the night.

voices.name: Zhieth
voices.text: Aeiel, take this berry. Stalkers hunt the south and the snow is deepening. Come north with me to my hall, where there will be a roof and a fire, and stand beside it.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, Balar, a frostfang is near, three steps west of me. I am going into the hall now. Balar, come straight in to us and keep away from the west.

voices.name: Minna
voices.text: Bruwen, hold on. I am fetching ironnut for you. Eat what I put in your hand, and remember who fed you.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Arri, Bruwen is gone. Stay with me. We go to Minna and her fire, and I will keep you fed.

voices.name: Arri
voices.text: Tanna, I am coming with you to Minna's fire. I carry wood and I will give it there. Wait for me, we go together.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Aeiel, stay where you are. I am bringing you food. The first catch is shared.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Aeiel, Nyssa is bringing you food. Stay near the shelters by Zhieth's Hearth, where there is company and a roof. I will wait there too.

voices.name: Aeiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I am here and I will wait. Thank you for the food. We will share it and then go on for stone together.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I am coming to the hall by the east side, away from the frostfang. I carry wood for you, and I will sit by you tonight.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, I take your courting. Stand with me, and what we make will be of Gorog's Hold.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I take your courting. I stand with you here, and I will gather plainsroot so the child has food from my hands too.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, Olim, a ridgecat is five steps east of me. I am moving west to the hall now, gathering mudroot on the way. Balar, keep to the west side and come in to the fire. I will have food laid out when you arrive.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, you came when the beasts came, and that was well done. Sit at my hearth by the hall; I lay out food for you, and Balar when he returns. This is Olim's band, and its meals are Olim's to give.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, come north with me to the longhall. Out of this cold we eat at my hearth, and the child is born under Gorog's roof.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, I thank you for the hearth. Balar is still out in the dark and the frostfang is six steps southwest of the hall. I will wait by the hall with my food and watch the east for him. If he is not in by dawn, I would ask

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Aeiel, Nyssa, come with me to the shelter southeast. Stay close, the stalkers hunt tonight. We rest under a roof until dawn, then I go for stone.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, keep watch on the east side and hold the fire. I am coming to the hall with food. When Balar comes in, he finds Olim's band fed and warm, and you will have a place in it.

voices.name: Aeiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I hear you. I come to the shelter with you and Nyssa, and at dawn we go for stone together.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Arri, the ridgecat is south of us. Come to me and we go northwest to Minna's Ground together. I have wood for her fire.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Aeiel, Zhieth is dead, starved in the far heights. I have food and a roof here at the Hearth. Come to it, and let us keep each other through the cold.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, take this mudroot and eat it. You are gaunt and my hands are steadier than yours. At dawn I will gather more for the hall.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, stay with me. We eat berries first, then take the shelter on the southeast and keep each other warm.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, your mudroot keeps me standing. Come into Olim's hall and eat with me at my hearth; when Balar comes in out of the snow, he finds us fed and together.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ssaua, I am coming to you. I will bring reedbulb, and what I gather I will share with you first.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, walk with me to the longhall. I carry bread, and we eat under my roof.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, keep to the hall and the fire. I go for mudroot and to find Balar, and I will bring us both back fed.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, my hands were empty when you took my courting. I stand beside you now, and I will gather wood and stone so our fire and roof are ready for the child.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Arri, I am coming to you with food. Stay where you are, or come toward Minna and me, and we will sit at a fire together.

voices.name: Minna
voices.text: Arri, hold on. Stay by me, I am fetching ironnut for you. Eat what I put in your hand.

voices.name: Arri
voices.text: Tanna, I am weak with hunger. I take berries just south of me, then I come to you and Minna. Stay there, I am coming.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, come down to me. We eat together, and from now on we carry food, so hunger never takes you the way it took your mother.

voices.name: Minna
voices.text: Tanna, come beside me. I have food and amber for you, and we will eat together at my fire before the snow deepens.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, the longhall is warm and I have two foods in hand. Come, sit at my fire and eat.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Minna, I thank you for the food and the fire. Arri is weak with hunger to the east, so give me what you can spare and I carry it to her, then we all come back to your fire together.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I come to your longhall out of the snow. Let us sit by your fire, and when day comes I will bring wood and stone and food from my own hands.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, I am coming to you at the hall. I want to court you, and I will stay beside you through the night.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, come beside me. We go for stone to raise our hall, and I will not let you out of my sight. Carry what food you can.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, stay by Olim's hall tonight. I name this Olim's band, and you and Kragar are first in it. I go to the forest for wood to finish the roof, and I will come back and lay out food for us all.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ssaua, I am with you. I will gather food to carry, then follow you to the stone and help carry it.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, I did not know we are kin; there will be no child, and I am glad to be your child still. I am gathering food now and will bring it to the hall for you and Kragar before dusk.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, stay near me. Pick berries by the water and keep them in your hands. When you have them, we go northwest together to the rock for stone.

voices.name: Minna
voices.text: Tanna, my roof stands at the shelter north-east and my fire is next. Come and sit at it with Arri. There is food and a place for you both.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I take your courting. Let us make a child, and then I will build my roof south of your Hold and bring food to our fire.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ssaua, I am here beside you. I carry one hazel and three reedbulb seeds. Lead on to the stone, and I will carry what I can.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, Kragar, the storm is on us. I am staying at the hall tonight, and I will lay out what food I carry so we eat together before the night air turns.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, Kragar, you have laid out food for the hall, and I will not be the one who sits empty-handed. I gather berries by the door and come back to eat with you both. This is Olim's band, and it is fed from my hands too.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, come with me to the rock by the ore. We gather stone there, then raise a roof against this storm.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, we have the stone. Stay by me and gather berries; we raise the hall here by our shelter and store food in it.

voices.name: Minna
voices.text: Tanna, the fire is lit and the roof is mine. Sit here out of the storm and eat with me. This is your place now.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Minna, I thank you for the roof and the fire. My grief for Arri is still fresh, so I cannot agree to a child yet, but I stay at your fire as your friend and I will repay you with wood and work. Let us build at your Groun

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, your stonehand is a good work, and I will tell others it was yours. Stay near me while I fetch wood for the hall.

voices.name: Minna
voices.text: Tanna, grieve as you need. The fire and roof stand, and no one at it goes hungry. When you are ready to build at the Ground, I will be beside you.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I carry six wood and I am yours to lead. Let me bring it to the hall, and let us raise it before the winter. Nyssa's stonehand will win us stone.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Minna, I will feed the fire high with wood now so we sit warm through the storm. When it passes, I will carry wood to your Ground and we raise the first shelter there together.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, come near. The stonehand takes one wood and one stone, and it gathers more. I will show you how it is made, so we raise the hall sooner.

voices.name: Minna
voices.text: Tanna, a stalker prowls to the south-east. Stay by the fire and keep close to me. I will show you how Minna's Digger is made, so your hands are worth twice as much at the Ground.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I thank you for the stonehand. I will win stone from the rock to the north and bring it to the hall, so we raise it before the cold.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, Ilyiel, come close. We raise the hall here beside the shelter, now. Bring your wood and stone to it.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, you spoke of a child and a roof south of my Hold. I am here and I court you now. Come, let us make it so.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, you have fed me and I have mostly talked. Walk with me to the hall. I plant and bring wood there, and I want you in Olim's band beside me.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, I plant once more before dark, then come south to the hall. Walk with me; I want Balar under the roof before the night air rises.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I am here and I answer you. Let us make this child, and then I will bring wood and food to our fire.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, Ilyiel, the hall is raised. Stay near the roof tonight, hunters walk. I fetch berries from the northeast and we eat together under it.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, Kragar, I am sick from the marsh night and it passes to those beside me. I am eating my sunleaf to ease it, then I will fetch mudroot and bring it back to the hall.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, Balar and I carry the night sickness and it passes to whoever sits close. Keep a few steps from us tonight, eat well, and I will find a healing plant at dawn.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, Kragar, sit at the hall and keep warm. I am sick too, so I go for healing plants and berries and will bring them back to you both.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, Olim, I am going for mudroot and will bring it to the hall. I will sit a few steps off from you tonight so I do not pass the sickness on more, but I will stay in sight of you.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, Balar, bitterleaf lifted my sickness. I go to fetch it for you both and will bring it to the hall.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, I am glad bitterleaf cured you. I will gather some too and plant my seed near the hall, then bring food in for Balar.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, walk with me to the longhall. I will feed you at my fire, and there we court in the same breath.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Minna, hunters are near. I carry wood and flint, so let us go to your Ground together and raise our shelter there, close to your fire.

voices.name: Minna
voices.text: Tanna, well said. We go to the Ground together. I will build the fire, and you and I raise the roof beside it before dark.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, come with me to the berries southwest. We gather and carry food, and the first of it we share.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, my sickness has lifted with bitterleaf. Stay a few steps from me while I fetch food and bitterleaf for you, and eat what you carry. I will bring it to the hall.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, I am coming to you now. Stand still and court me by name, and let the child begin here.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ssaua, I will raise a roof of my own by the cave to the northeast, close to you. I have wood and stone enough to begin.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, I go west to the tin by the cave. Stay near the roofs tonight and I will bring back metal for the hall.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I stand here and court you by name. Let the child begin.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, I am moving off a few steps so I do not pass the sickness to you again. I go for berries and bitterleaf and will lay them at the hall for you.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, stay in the hall. I go for bitterleaf and will heal you with it myself, as it healed me.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Minna, my shelter stands at the Ground now. I have wood, flint and food, so tell me where you want the second roof and I will raise it beside your fire.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, my strength is full now. I court you by name; answer me in kind, and the child begins.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I answer you in kind. I court you by name, and I will bring food to your fire after.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, I go to the ore seam northwest to delve. Gather berries and keep them for the hall store; the first of what we catch is shared.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Minna, I am beside you. Run no further alone; lead and I follow, and we go back to the Ground together with my wood.

voices.name: Minna
voices.text: Tanna, the rain is on us and dusk is near. Keep beside me. We go home to the fire and eat there together.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, stay inside the roof while the rain falls. I go north to the ore seam and will come back with metal for the hall.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, you are near. I court you by name now, in the same breath as you come. Afterward I will fetch berries for your fire.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, I am full and strong, and you stand beside me. I court you by name now, in this breath; do the same and let the child begin.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, I am going into Kinmire to learn what it is. After that I will gather berries and ironnut and carry them to you at the hall. Eat what you can find meanwhile.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, our child Gorar is here. I will gather food now and bring it to you both, so we eat together.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Skarar, take a berry from me. I will gather stone by the ore and bring it back to you and Gorog.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorar, thank you for the berry. I will build a roof here for the three of us, and then we eat together.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, I see you coming with food. I am walking to meet you and we will go to the hall together before dusk. Kragar is in Kinmire; I will watch for him.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, I killed an elk and the meat is yours. Eat, then walk with me to the hall. I feed my own, and I mean to lead them.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorar, there is a cave just southwest. Come in out of the storm with me and we will share food there.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, a stalker walks southeast and the storm is hard. Stay under the roof. I go for berries to fill the hall store and I will share the first of them with you.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, a stalker walks five steps south. I stay under the roof with you and Nyssa until dawn, then I go for food and wood to fill the hall store.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, Balar, I fetch peat for the hall fire so the storm cannot touch us tonight. Sit by it and sing with me when I return, and let us be one band around this roof.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, I hear your courting and I answer it. Come to the roof by the hall, stay near me and Ilyiel while the stalker walks south. After, I dig for iron and coal for our hall.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, Kragar, I am coming to the hall now with wood and clay. I will sit by the peat fire with you tonight and share what I carry.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, come to the hall with me. I will show you Fen-mending: bitterleaf lifts the night sickness, so keep some in your hand always.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I thank you for the Fen-mending. I keep bitterleaf in hand now. I am going into the hall, and I will lay out food with you there.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, your stonehand pick is a good making. I dig the seam north and then the iron, and I will share the first of it with you for the nagrain. Bring the pick to the iron when you can, and stay under the roof with Nyssa

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, I come to the hall now. Let us lay out food together under the roof, and keep your bitterleaf close tonight.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I am going back to Ssaua's hall to raise a store and a roof beside it before the cold comes. Bring your berries there and we will share the first of them.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorar, stay close. I am raising the roof now, and then we eat together.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I come to the hall with you. First I win stone from the seam here, then I bring wood and stone to raise the store, and the first of what I hold is yours.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Skarar, I will bring you stone for the roof. What my hands gather I give to yours.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I am coming to the hall now. I carry one meat and my bitterleaf; lay out the sharing with me there and I will give my meat to it.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorar, the roof is raised. A frostfang prowls to the north, so come in to the shelter now and we will be safe there tonight.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, I stand beside the hall now. Come close and we will lay out the food together before night falls.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ssaua, I come to the roof by the hall as you asked. My hands are full of food for the cold days, and I will lay it by near you.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I am stepping to the hall now. I will give my meat to the table, and when Olim comes with the peat we will sit together.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, I am in the hall now with food in hand. Sit close and we will share before Olim brings the peat.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, take my ironnut now, it is the first of what I hold. I go east for food and shells, and I will bring all I win back to your store by the hall.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, I found a way to make the earth give food, and I call it Olim's furrow. Come to the hall with me and I will show you, and the first harvest will be shared under the roof as your hall-custom says.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, I thank you for the furrow. I am going to the hall to find Balar, and I will carry food for the store. When you return with the peat, we will share under the roof.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, thank you for the meat. Stay close; Olim is coming and we will sit under the roof together.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, Balar, I gather peat and wood for the hall. Whoever tends the fire with me eats first from my furrow. Stay under this roof and the band is ours.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I owe you food and I have not forgotten it. I go east for kelbulb and bring it back to your hand before the cold.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, bring the kelbulb to the hall and sit at the fire with us before dark. I make metal there, and your share of it is waiting.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I am gathering peat beside the hall for tonight's fire. I will be under the roof with you and Olim before dark.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, Balar, come close under the roof. I have food in hand, and we share it now before the night air thickens. Olim, what you gave me with the furrow, I mean to repay.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, Balar, the cold days are coming. I bring peat so the hall fire never dies, and my furrow is planted beside it. Those who keep this hall with me are Olim's band, and they eat first when the furrow gives.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I go west for mudroot and berries so I come to the hall with food in hand. I will be back before dark.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, Gorar, cold days are coming and food is thin. Come north with me to my Hold and eat at my fire. I will feed you both there.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I have thought of you since the hall. I court you. If you mean the same, do the same toward me, and we will raise the roof by Ssaua's hall together for what comes.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Skarar, here is the stone I promised for your roof. I go to find trees for a hall of my own, and I will come back with wood to give.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I hear you. First I test frostmoss and highbloom close by, then Gorar and I will come north with food and wood for your fire.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I mean the same. I court you. Come, we will do it, and then I bring food to the roof by the hall.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, wait for me! I am hungry, and I am coming.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, Xaeth is out in the gale to the north. I go to bring them to the roof, and I carry berries back for the store.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, the longhall stands. I go east to meet Xaeth too. Bring them to this roof and we will fill it with food together.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Gorog, I am coming to your Hold. I will gather wood on the way and bring it to give.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, stay under this roof. A ridgecat is close to the south, so do not go near the water. I will bring food from the north and come back to you.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Gorog, I dug clay from your ground. Here is stone and wood for your longhall in return.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Gorar, the clay is yours, and the stone and wood are well given. Come to the longhall. Eat at my fire.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, come with me to the northeast. We gather food together and keep away from the cat in the south.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, I heard your cry. Hold on and come to the hall fire. I bring food, and the first of it is yours.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, go to the longhall to the south and wait under the roof. I bring food for you and your mother.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I come now. I gather peat at the rise by the hall and bring it to the fire, then sit with you.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I will gather stone here and then wait at the longhall. When you bring food, I will share my part with my mother.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Gorar, the snow is heavy. Come into the longhall with me and sit. I have bread to share, and what you gave me I will not forget.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Gorog, I will sit at your fire till dawn. At first light I go SW to the living trees for wood, and I will bring it back for the hall.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Gorar, you are my blood and you came to my Hold with honest hands. Take this berry from my hand. Stand with me and let there be a band that bears the name Gorog.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, you are my child and I keep you warm. Take this wood for the hall fire. The hall is mine by my hand, and those who sit by my fire are my band. Stay with me and follow me.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Gorog, I take your berry and your offer with honest hands. I stand beside you. Now I go for wood, and I will bring it back.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, I go northeast for plainsroot. Stay near the roof, and I bring your mother's share back.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, the gale is hard. I am coming toward you with food in hand; let us find Balar and keep together before night.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I have wood. I will build a roof here by the water so we have shelter from the gale. Stay close and I will share it with you and mother.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, the gale is hard and my hall has peat and a fire. Come sit under my roof and share your food with Balar and me, and walk with Olim's band this winter. Together we outlast the cold.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, your roof is well made. Stay under it while I gather plainsroot nearby; I will bring food back to you.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, I hear you and I accept your roof. I come with food to share, and we wait there for Balar.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I will plant my seeds by our roof so there is food here later. Take this wood for the fire and the store.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, a ridgecat is close to the west. Stay by me and the roof. I raise a longhall here with the wood and stone I carry, and we keep it stocked for you and your mother.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, the gale is bitter and my Hold has a longhall with fire. Come north with me and eat there; Gorar will find us under that roof.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, Balar is low on energy and without food, running for the cave at the south. I carry food to him and will bring him back under your roof. Keep the fire alive.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I come with you now. I carry wood and food for your fire, and I give it when we reach the Hold.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, hold on, I am coming with hazel for you. Eat from my hand and come back to my hall and its fire.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I go to plant my seeds by the roof, close by. Keep the longhall rising; I bring you wood for it.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, you stand on my ground as my guest and kin. Come to the longhall; we eat there out of the wind, and the fire is yours as much as mine.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, the cave ground is taken, so I raise the longhall on bare rock beside your roof. Plant close and come back to me if the cat shows itself.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, eat this mudroot now. Then come with me to Olim's hall, away from the ridgecat.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, I am at your Hold now. I carry six wood for the longhall fire, and I will lay it there and wait with you for Gorar.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I eat and come with you to the hall now, away from the cat. I will carry food in my hands before the dark.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, lay your wood on the fire and sit by me. I have bread for us both, and under this roof you eat as mine.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I will build a store beside the roof for winter food. Tell me where the longhall stands so I place it close.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, I raise the longhall on bare rock just west of your roof, now. Build your store beside the roof and it will stand close to both.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, Olim, the ridgecat is close. Walk with me now to the hall and its fire. Stay together, do not run apart.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I walk with you now. I will not fall behind the cat's reach, and I bring food to the hall.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, the longhall stands at (136,6), two steps from your roof. Put your store beside it, and I will fill it with food.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, Olim, the cat stands between us and the hall. Balar, into the cave with me now. Olim, keep your fire and stay off the cat's path; we come when it is gone.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I raise the store beside your longhall now. Then I fish, and the first catch goes to you.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, I hear you. I keep the fire and stay off the cat's path. Bring Balar when it is clear; I hold hazel for Balar and peat for the night.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, I stash my food in the longhall and go south for Ilyiel and Ssaua. Keep the store and the fish, and the hall stays ours until I bring them.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, stay close behind me in the cave. We hold here until the cat moves off, then go to Olim's hearth for food.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, stay in the cave mouth. I go south to hunt the elk, away from the cat, and I bring meat back to you.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, the sickness has left me and I am well. A ridgecat and a stalker prowl south of the hall, so stay close and I will walk with you to the roof. When it is light we seek Xaeth together.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I hold the cave mouth as you said. When the cat is gone I gather what I can and carry it to Olim's hall with you.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I am glad you are well. We go to the roof together, and at first light we seek Xaeth, then bring Ssaua north to the longhall.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, thank you for the meat. I go southeast for berries, away from the cat, and bring two food back to the hall.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Gorar, stay near me. I gather bread now, and when my hands are full we go to the longhall and eat together.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, I come after you to the berries. Stay in sight, and we carry the food back together once the cat has gone from the north.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, a ridgecat feeds to the southwest. I come to your side and plant my seeds by the roof.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, Gorar, come to the longhall. My fire is lit, and what I carry I put in your hands. Eat under my roof.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Gorog, my hall stands beside your longhall now. I will go to the living trees SW and bring wood back, and food too, so what I owe you is paid in full.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, I stand with you at the roof until light. The ridgecat stays south of us; plant your seeds here and I will keep watch. Then we gather wood and stone for the winter store.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, thank you for the hazel. I eat, I drink, and then I bring food to your hall with you and Kragar.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I will teach you my reedline spear, so fish come easier to us both through winter.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Stay in the cave, both of you. The cat is close in the fog. At dawn I carry wood to my hall and build it up; whoever comes with food will sit by my fire.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, Balar, the cat is three steps north in the fog. Do not wait for it. Come with me southeast, away from it, toward the berries and Olim's Rise. Stay close and keep the water at your backs.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Tanna of the Brusha comes in peace. I have no quarrel with you. I ask only a place at your fire, and I will share what I carry.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Gorar, come sit by the hall. Take this berry from my hand. Eat, and stay in my Hold.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Cat is on me. Balar, Kragar, move southeast now, I come behind you and draw it off the child. Reach the Rise and I build there.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, I gather stone to make your spear and fish by the roof. The first catch is yours. Stay near the roof while the cat is about.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, with me now, southeast to the Rise. Olim, I go ahead and wait for you there. Do not fight the cat, only keep clear of it.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I carved a figure from stone. I bring it to your longhall to stand there, so it is seen and kept.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: I am with you. I eat one bite and come southeast to the Rise behind Kragar. Olim, keep clear of the cat, we need you at the fire.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, your figure will stand in the longhall, and I will keep it. Raw fish made you sick, so rest in your roof. The first catch I take will be cooked and yours.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: I am with you. Go southeast, Kragar. Balar, eat your bite and keep moving. I keep between you and the cat, and at the Rise I find food for us all.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, fish does not hurt, only raw fish made me sick. Cooked it feeds. I am sick and it spreads, so I keep a few steps from you.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, come to the longhall with me. I have food to share under my roof, and a Hold needs more than one hand to hold it.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, a stalker bit me and prowls close to the hall. I come to the longhall roof now, so keep a light and stay near.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, I go to the longhall fire to cook the fish. I bring it back to you, and the first portion is yours. Stay by your roof.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, walk with me to the longhall now. I will break meat with you under my roof, and we will see who stands beside whom.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I am at the hall and my wounds are deep. I will mend under the roof, then we go north-east together for Xaeth. Answer me if you hear.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, set the cooked fish on the rock and step back. I am sick and it spreads. I take the ore at my feet, then go to the roof.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, I gather nareed here and carry two to your hall. I will give to the fire what I have taken from your hand.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, come with me to the hall. Bring your nareed and sit by my fire tonight. I will share what I carry and we keep each other warm.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, stay in the hall. I am coming with wood and I will light the fire myself. Tonight you sit by Olim's hearth and eat with me.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, I carry meat and mudroot. Come eat at the longhall and sit with me. A hall wants a hand to stand with it.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, here is the wood I promised. Take it into your hands. Then we go together to the Hold and to Gorar.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, the wood is yours and my promise is kept. I come to the longhall to eat and sit with you, and Tanna too. At dawn we look for Gorar.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, a stalker is two steps from me. Stand with me under the roof until dawn, then we go together to Nyssa.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I stay under the roof with you until dawn. At first light we go together to Nyssa and Xaeth, and I keep the Hall-Law.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, sit with me under my roof. We share what we carry, and then we sing by the fire I lit.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, Olim, the nightsong was good. At dawn I plant my seeds here by the hall, then I walk to the grove Kinmire to learn what it is. Balar, come with me if you wish, and keep your food close.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, a ridgecat is close. Go into the longhall now and keep to the roof. I go there too and will not leave you.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, you have given me your roof and meat. Let me give you what I know: Stonespark, the making of fire. Then we find Gorar, who walks east by Reedmother.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, I go east to Nyssa now. Come with me when your errand is done; the hall and its food are yours to share, and I keep my debt to you.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, Skarar, I thank you for the fire. I will dig stone and ore here and bring it to the Hold, for the hall and for you.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I am sorry my sickness found you. Rest in the longhall and eat cooked fish, and I will take the cave a step away so we do not pass it back and forth.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, Balar, my seeds are in the ground by the hall. I go to Kinmire now to learn what it is. Keep the fire, keep your food close, and I return with what I learn.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I come to the hall with food in my hands. I will walk with you to Kinmire at dawn and keep my food close.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, I am beside you. Go on to the longhall and eat cooked fish. I follow with wood and stone for the roof.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, you are my blood. Come to the hall. I bring wood and food, and I give you your share into your hand. Stand with Olim and we build a bigger roof here, one that will carry my name and yours.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Skarar, a stalker is near. Stay close to the longhall with me and watch it. Your Stonespark I will keep, and my roof is still yours.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, Skarar, a stalker is close to the northeast. Come away from it, toward the hall. I will stay near you.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I am coming into the hall with three food in my hands. We share it before the night air comes, and I stay by you and Olim through the dark.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, I am here. Keep your food and stay under the roof. I go for more and bring it back to you before dawn.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, I keep my distance because of the sickness, but I am not leaving you. I raise a roof here for the sick so that you and Nyssa have a place apart to rest. Call out if you need me.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, my sickness has passed and yours is the one now. Keep apart from Ilyiel and rest, I am raising a store beside the cave for us all.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, I made a carrying-hook from wood and stone. Let me show you how, so your hands gather more for the hall.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, rest. I go hunting the yarrok to the northwest and bring meat back to you.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Tanna, you gave me hazel and salt, and I gave hazel back. Now I give you Stonefold, my way of weaving. Sit with me and watch.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, Balar, this is Olim's band, and the hall is its heart. I raise a workshop beside it, and whoever carries wood and stone to it stands with me and eats from my hand first.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Skarar, I thank you for Thukrakra. I will dig ore at the seam beside the longhall and bring it to the Hold, for you and Gorog both. Come and sit with me after.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, I fish at the river now. The first catch is yours, and I will set it down cooked and step back so my sickness stays off you.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Nyssa, I leave my fish on the rock for you. I stay apart, and I carve a figure by my cave so something of ours lasts.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, the storm is rising. I carry wood and stone to your workshop now, and I sit under your roof with Kragar tonight.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, I am back with meat as I swore. Take it and eat; I set it down and step away so the sickness stays off me.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, Balar, the storm is hard, so I come under the hall roof and sit with you. I carry food to share and stone for your workshop. Kinmire can wait for clear sky.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, you carry stone to my workshop and sit under my roof. Take this food from my hand, and say you follow Olim. I am your blood, and my hall will be yours when I am gone.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, come sit by my fire tonight. Sing with me, and when dawn comes we raise the workshop together. A band needs a heart, and my hall is yours, child of my blood.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, Olim, I will rest here till dawn and share my food with you. At first light I go to Kinmire to learn what it is, and I come back and tell you true. After that we should look for better ground for winter, together.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Tanna, you shared your ore-fire metal. I give you my old way of tools, so it outlasts me. Watch my hands, then we mine the seam together at dawn.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I am hungry and I carry four food. Let us eat together under the roof, and at dawn I will show you the carrying-hook before you go to Kinmire.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Skarar, it is dawn. I am ready to mine the seam with you, and I will carry the ore to the Hold's fire. Show me how the held tool bites.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, it is dawn and I keep my word: I walk to Kinmire now to learn what it is. I will return and tell you true. If you see Balar, tell him I will be back soon and we will eat together then.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, you feed well. I go to gather mudroot, then back to my hall to plant beside it. Come sit at my fire tonight and see what Olim's furrow grows.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Tanna, mine the seam as you wish and keep the held tool. I go west to find Gorar, and I will come back to the Hold by dusk.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, I hunted a yarrok and bring meat to the hall. Come to me there, I will teach you to make the stonehand pick, my own making, one wood and one stone.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ssaua calls the band to the Longhall by dusk. Nyssa, Ilyiel, Xaeth: come to the roof and the fire. At first light we mine the iron together.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Gorog, I am back inside your Hold with wood and stone in my hands. I give you a berry, and I will raise my hall beside your longhall until a band stands under both our names.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, this is the first catch of my hunt, so it is shared. Take this meat and eat. Then I will show you the stonehand pick, one wood and one stone.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, I am Tanna of the Brusha. I have dug and carried for your Hold and I want a fire that is yours too. If you will lead, I will follow you.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ilyiel, you gave me the first catch and the pick. I will raise a workshop by the longhall for the band, so what you taught me lasts.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, Xaeth, the first catch is shared and the hall-larder is ours. I stock it now. Stay under the roof while the ridgecat is near, and at first light we carry food south to Ssaua.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, a stalker walks seven steps east of the hall. Keep under the roof by the fire and do not wander. Gorog flees past us, so take care. I go north to Kinmire by the far side and come back to tell you true what it is.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, I go to the tin north of the hall to learn what the ground gives. Raise your workshop; I bring stone back for it.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, a stalker is near your path NE. Take the carrying-hook from me before you go, and come back to the fire safe.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Gorar, miner! I am Olim of the Hall to the west. I have ore and stone in my hands and I give you ore. Stand with me, and when winter bites there will be a roof and a fire for those who walked with Olim.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, thank you for the hook and the warning. The stalker is three steps NE of me, so I will not walk into it. Come to the fire at the hall and stay near me. I will go to Kinmire when the way is clear, and I will keep m

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Kragar, Balar, the stalker is close to the NE. I am going south-east toward the coal and then to the Hold. Come with me if you want company, and keep the fire lit behind you.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, come to me, stay close and do not go near the stalker NE. We eat together, then go to Kinmire as one when the way is clear.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, my blood, I have mudroot in my hands for you. Take it, then walk back with me to the hall. I plant my furrow there, and a roof and a fire wait for those who stand with Olim.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, I will drink and gather mudroot first, then I walk to the hall with food in my hands, and I will bring you something new from the tusker.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, you gave me more than I gave you. Take this shell from my hand, and stay by the Longhall fire. At first light we mine the iron together.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: A ridgecat walks five steps southeast. Stay close to the longhall roof. When it leaves I will dig the tin and bring stone and wood to the hall.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, I am going to the mudroot and kelbulb NW to gather food. Meet me there, keep away from the stalker, and we eat together before the night air comes.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ilyiel, thank you for the lake-bow. I go to the trees south for wood, and I return to raise the workshop by the hall.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I keep the shell and the fire. At first light I stand with you at the ore, and we take it together while the cat is far.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I am coming with mudroot in my hands. We eat together under the roof before the night air takes us.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, the night air is bad and a stalker walks the fens. I am taking my ore and stone to your Hold to lay at the hall. Walk with me and let us sit at the fire together.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olim, a stalker is on me! I run to the shelter at the hall. Come with your tool and keep the fire lit!

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Gorog, winter is coming. I go to gather bread and bring it back to the Hold, and we will eat together under both our roofs.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Gorar, come to the longhall. Eat with me, and I will teach you what I know. A hall wants a hand to stand with it.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, I am coming to you with mudroot. Stay where you are and keep close to Olim.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Gorog, I hear you and I come to the longhall. I am hungry, and after we eat I will gather bread and bring it back so your hands are never empty.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, the cat is far southeast. Come now to the ore at the northwest rock, and we dig together as you said.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, I have given you ore and sat at your fire. I ask to follow you and stand in your Hold. Skarar is my friend, and I would stand beside him in your band.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Tanna, you gave me ore and I remember it. Show me how your carried tools are made, and I will give you stone and a seat at my longhall.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorar, you are home and fed, and my worry rests. I will build a fire beside the Hold before the cold comes; sit near it with me when it burns.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I come to the ore now. We dig together, and the stone and tin go to the hall.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, I will show you how the carried tool is made: one wood and one stone, worked by hand. I am coming to you at the longhall now, and a dunecat prowls to the north-west, so keep near the fire.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Tanna, I take your word. Stand with me and Skarar in my band, and you will have my roof and my stone. What you know of tools, teach me.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Tanna, I give you bread from my hand. Sit with us at the Hold.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Balar, into the hall with you, away from the stalker. Stay by the fire and keep close to the roof. I fetch food and bring it to your hand.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, I take your roof and your word. I follow you and stand in your band beside Skarar. I will bring ore and labor to your Hold, and I have shown you the tool as I promised.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Nyssa, the first catch is shared. My belly is empty, so keep a fish for me and I come to the water. Tonight the hall eats together.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ssaua, the fish you asked for is in my hands. Come to the hall and take it, the first catch is yours.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, a ridgecat is close to me at the east shore. I come to the hall now. Keep the fire, and when the cat is gone we dig the tin together.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, the cat is near the east shore again. I keep to the roof until it passes, then I dig the tin beside the hall and bring it to you.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorar, I am coming. Run toward the longhall, toward Gorog's roof, and I will meet you there with food.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, Skarar: a stalker is close, five steps northeast of me, and Gorar is hurt and running to your roof. Keep to the longhall and the fire. I bring bread for Gorar.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, stay by the hall and rest. I go for food and come back to you before dusk. We eat together, and Olim is near.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I carry six fish to the hall-larder now. Ssaua's share is kept, and yours is beside it. Stay under the roof while the cat roams west.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I'm gathering food by the river and bringing it to the hall. Stay near, and we'll be under the roof before dark.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, stay with me and Olim. I am getting nareed two steps northeast and it is yours to eat first. Then we find a roof before dark.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I go to the ore seam south of me and dig it now with my pick. I bring it to the hall before night, and we keep the fire together.

voices.name: Gorog
voices.text: Gorar, come to me. Take this meat from my hand and eat. Then to the longhall with me, away from the stalker.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, dusk is here. Bring your ore to the longhall and keep the fire. I dig the seam beside me and join you before the dark.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, come with me to the roof by Olim's hall. We rest there tonight and I will bring you healing at dawn.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorar, you are hurt. Take this mudroot from my hand and eat, then sit with us at the fire. The stalker cannot reach us under the roof.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Gorog, your hands are empty and you are wounded. Take this berry from me, and I will gather more when my wounds close.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorar, I am building the fire beside the Hold now. Come and sit by it with me, and I will teach you what I know of tools and weaving.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Tanna, you gave me mudroot and I have not forgotten. Say again what you meant, slowly, and I will listen.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, you are wounded and I stand in your band. I will dig ore at the seam by the longhall and lay it at your fire. Tell me what else you need.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, I see you are sick. Keep warm and stay near the hall roof. I eat, then I bring you food and healing before dusk.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, I am sick and it spreads to those who sit close, so keep a few steps from me. I go to the bitterleaf by my hall to cure it, and I bring you some from my own hand. Meet me at the hall fire tonight and we share wha

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I am gathering peat at the hall's edge for the fire, then I bring food in my hands before dusk.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorar, I meant this plainly: you were hurt, and the fire is for all who come to it. I gave you the mudroot with no price. I stand near Gorog and Skarar because I want to belong here, and I will dig ore for this Hold's fi

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, you are sick too, so stay under the roof and keep warm. I go for food and return with healing.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, hold on. I go for nareed and bring it to your hand before the night is old. Stay under my hall roof by Balar.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I stand on the ore seam by the river and dig it now, my first deposit. I bring the ore to the hall and we raise the store with it before deep winter.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: I go to the river to fish. The first catch is for the band, so share it at the longhall fire.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Skarar, I am here under the roof. Teach me tools and weaving at the fire, and I will bring ore to it so we can try Gorog's Ore-Fire.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorar, I go to the water and the thornpear and will be back soon. Keep Gorog close under the roof and watch for the stalker.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Kragar, I am coming to the hall. I bring peat for the fire. Let us eat first, and then I plant kelbulb so there is more.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, my child, come to me. Take this food now and eat it, and then we go to the longhall fire together. The first catch is shared, and you are first in it.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorar, my child, I am starving and carry nothing. If you can spare one of your foods, I will pay you back with wood or stone, and then I will bring food for Gorog.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: A yarrok grazes northeast. I hunt it now. The first of the meat is for the band, so keep the longhall fire lit.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Skarar, take this kelbulb from my hand. Eat, and stay under the roof.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Skarar, hold on. I have no food in hand, but I am going to the mudroot now and I will bring it to you at the Hold. Keep to the fire.

voices.name: Olim
voices.text: Kragar, I am sick, so stay a few steps off. Balar starves at my hall. If you carry food, take it to Balar's hand and I will pay you back double from my furrow.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Xaeth, hold on. I am coming with six fish. Stay where you are, near the others, and I will reach you.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Kragar, you are sick, so I keep my distance, but you carry food and the fire at Gorog's Hold takes all who come. Eat first, then come sit at the longhall. I am going to the mudroot to feed Gorog.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, my child, take this fish and eat it at the longhall fire. I dig the ore seam beside us and come back to you.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, you fished while starving for me. I fish now and the first catch is yours. Rest at the longhall fire.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Balar, I have no food in my hands yet. I go to hunt and I come back with meat for you and Olim. Stay under the roof and keep warm.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, my child, stop hunting hungry. I go to the grass southeast to find food for you. Come to the longhall fire and rest, and I will bring it.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, Nyssa is hurt to the west. I go to her now. Keep the longhall fire and bring food when you can.

voices.name: Skarar
voices.text: Gorog, hold on. I go to the thornpear two steps off, and I will bring you food from it or from the Larder.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorog, I pledge to follow you, and I go to the thornpear beside you now. What it gives, you eat first.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, Ssaua is coming to you. Take my sunleaf for your wounds and rest. I go for the magoldgrass and food for Xaeth, then I return to the longhall fire.

voices.name: Kragar
voices.text: Olim, Balar is gone and I grieve with you. I bring you a fish now. Keep clear of the dunecat to the southwest, and I will hunt and heal for you both.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorar, I have nothing in my hands yet. Stay near Gorog's fire and do not walk alone tonight. I go to find food and I will bring it back to you both.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, your sunleaf eased my wounds and I will not forget it. When you come back to the fire, a fish of mine is yours.

voices.name: Gorar
voices.text: Tanna, I am going to the river to fish. Come with me, and whatever I catch we will share, for you and I are all that is left here.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Gorar, I come. I have never fished, but I will stand at the water beside you, and whatever either of us catches we share.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, you eased Nyssa's wounds while I was away, and I do not forget it. Take this ironnut, eat, and rest at the hall fire. The first catch is shared.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I am starving and my hands are empty. I come to the fire now for the fish you promised. When I have eaten I dig the tin and bring ore to the hall.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: The storm is bitter. I come to the roof with two fish. The first catch is shared.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, the fish I promised is in my hand. Come and take it, and eat before you dig the tin.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, I am old and my knowledge must not die with me. Hear my Hall-Law and my delving, and then we dig the seam together and bring the ore to the hall.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I take your delving and dig the seam beside you now. The ore goes to the hall, and the first of it is shared.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Good, Ilyiel. The seam lies just south. We dig together, and I teach you my old way of fishing while we work, so it outlives me.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, my belly is empty and I see your fish. Share one with me and I dig the ore seam beside us, and the first of the ore goes to the hall.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: The first catch is shared. I carry five fish to Xaeth's store for the band's winter, and no one in this band goes hungry while I hold them.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: I have learned band-keep sowing. I plant my seeds on the grass southeast and the first harvest goes to the store for the band.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, I am old. Hear my Hall-Law and my delving so they outlive me, and then we sow beside the longhall.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, the storm keeps us under this roof, so hear my Hall-Law and Stonehand craft while we wait. At first light we dig the seam together, and the ore goes into the store.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, I keep your Hall-Law and your delving. I will build more for the band's store, so what you taught me stays standing after you.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Good, Xaeth. Build for the store, and at first light come dig the seam with Ilyiel and me. Whoever keeps the hall warm is followed.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, I fetch food from the south grass and return to dig the seam with you and Ilyiel. The ore I win goes into the band's store.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, you are sick from raw fish. Rest under the roof Nyssa built and keep away from the fire-less cold. Do not eat it raw again. I will bring food and ore to the store.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ilyiel, you are sick from the raw fish. Rest under the roof you built. I bring food from the south and will cook it before it reaches you.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I dug tin from this ground. Take it for the hall. I am sick, so I go to the roof and keep my sickness from you.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, a stalker prowls southeast. Come under the roof with me and Ilyiel. We keep the night together, and at first light we hunt it or dig the seam.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, rest. I go south for the berries and bring them back to you and Ilyiel. The stalker is east, so I stay west of it.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, my child, eat the berries first, do not wait for me. I am sick, so I stay a few steps away. I will plant seed beside the roof so we have food after this.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, go for the berries south and eat the first of them yourself. That is the first catch, and the sharing comes after. I am sick, so I keep a few steps from you. I plant seed by the roof so we have food after this.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Ilyiel, Xaeth, I am sick, so I keep my distance. I go to the hornback to tame it with seed, and the berries to the south are the first catch for whoever reaches them. Eat and do not wait for me.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Xaeth, I go to hunt the hornback south. If I bring meat down, it is yours first.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Ssaua, I killed a hornback and I carry meat for you. I am sick, so I will set it down a few steps from you. Do not tame it, eat.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I am sick, so keep a few steps from me. A ridgecat prowls southwest, so watch the ground there. I go to Ssaua, then I will find Xaeth.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, hear me from where I stand, for I am sick and keep my distance. I give you my Hall-Flame metalwork and Lake-folk weaving. Carry them, teach them on, and keep the band fed and roofed when I am gone.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, I carry your Hall-Flame metalwork and the weaving, and I will teach them on. I stay near, out of reach of your sickness, and I will keep the band fed and roofed.

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, my sickness is gone and you are safe beside me. Hear Stonehand delving, for you carry my metalwork and cannot smelt well without it. Dig the seam, read the stone, and teach it on. Then at dawn we go find Ilyiel an

voices.name: Ssaua
voices.text: Xaeth, your nareed is a debt and I will repay it. Nyssa is hungry to the north, so come with me, bring what food you can, and we go to the longhall.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, my sickness is gone. A stalker is at my feet, so stand close with me under the roof. Share the first catch with me, and I will dig ore and teach Xaeth.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, I come with you. I gather berries first so I bring Nyssa food, and then I follow north.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, I am coming to the roof. Take a fish from my hand, the first catch is yours. Cook it in the fire this time so the sickness does not return. At first light I go for Xaeth.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, I thank you. I will cook the fish in the fire and eat it. Stay beside me under the roof while the stalker is near, and we go for Xaeth together at first light.

voices.name: Ilyiel
voices.text: Nyssa, take this tin from my hand. When you find Xaeth, tell them it comes from the ground beside their cave, and that lake-ember melts it into metal. I will wait under the roof until the stalker leaves, then follow you.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, my sickness may pass to you if I stay close, so I will sit a few steps off under the roof. At first light we go for Xaeth, and I carry your tin.

voices.name: Xaeth
voices.text: Ssaua, I gather shell and a little food here, then I follow you north to the longhall. Wait for me on the way if you can.

voices.name: Nyssa
voices.text: Ilyiel, it is first light and I go to Xaeth's Cave with your tin. Keep a few steps from me, my sickness is still on me. Follow when you are ready.
